====/File: react/UpgradePromptCard.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface UpgradePromptCardProps {
  used: number;
  limit: number;
  planName?: string;
  unit?: string;
  title?: string;
  features?: string[];
  ctaText?: string;
  onUpgrade?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const formatNumber = (value: number) => (typeof value === "number" ? value.toLocaleString("en-US") : String(value));

export const UpgradePromptCard: React.FC<UpgradePromptCardProps> = ({
  used,
  limit,
  planName = "Free",
  unit = "requests",
  title = "Upgrade to keep going",
  features = [],
  ctaText = "See plans",
  onUpgrade,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const safeLimit = limit > 0 ? limit : 1;
  const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((used / safeLimit) * 100)));
  const tone =
    percent >= 90
      ? { bar: "bg-red-500", text: "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400", chip: "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40" }
      : percent >= 70
        ? { bar: "bg-amber-500", text: "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400", chip: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40" }
        : { bar: "bg-emerald-500", text: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400", chip: "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40" };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        <span className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${tone.chip} ${tone.text}`}>
          <UiIcon name="zap" size={16} />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{title}</div>
          <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            You're on the {planName} plan — {percent}% of your {unit} used.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <div className={`h-full rounded-full ${tone.bar} transition-all duration-300`} style={{ width: `${percent}%` }} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <span className="tabular-nums">
          {formatNumber(used)} / {formatNumber(limit)} {unit}
        </span>
        <span className={`ml-auto tabular-nums ${tone.text}`}>{percent}%</span>
      </div>

      {features.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
          {features.map((feature) => (
            <li key={feature} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              <UiIcon name="check" size={12} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-500" />
              <span>{feature}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onUpgrade?.()}
        className="mt-3 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
      >
        {ctaText}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default UpgradePromptCard;

====/File: react/VoiceModePanel.tsx/====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export type VoiceModeState = "idle" | "listening" | "thinking" | "speaking";

export interface VoiceModePanelProps {
  state?: VoiceModeState;
  /** Live user transcript shown under the orb. */
  transcript?: string;
  /** Assistant reply shown while thinking/speaking. */
  reply?: string;
  /** Called when the orb is pressed (start/stop listening). */
  onToggle?: () => void;
  /** Called by the end-session button. */
  onEnd?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const STATE_META: Record<VoiceModeState, { label: string; hint: string; ring: string; orb: string }> = {
  idle: {
    label: "Tap to speak",
    hint: "Voice mode is ready",
    ring: "bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/40",
    orb: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300",
  },
  listening: {
    label: "Listening…",
    hint: "Speak now — tap again to stop",
    ring: "bg-indigo-400/40",
    orb: "bg-indigo-600 text-white",
  },
  thinking: {
    label: "Thinking…",
    hint: "Working on a response",
    ring: "bg-amber-400/40",
    orb: "bg-amber-500 text-white",
  },
  speaking: {
    label: "Speaking…",
    hint: "Tap to interrupt",
    ring: "bg-emerald-400/40",
    orb: "bg-emerald-500 text-white",
  },
};

const BAR_COUNT = 9;

export const VoiceModePanel: React.FC<VoiceModePanelProps> = ({
  state = "idle",
  transcript,
  reply,
  onToggle,
  onEnd,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const meta = STATE_META[state];
  const animated = state === "listening" || state === "speaking";

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex flex-col items-center rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-6 py-8 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="relative flex h-28 w-28 items-center justify-center">
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`absolute inset-0 rounded-full ${meta.ring} ${animated ? "animate-ping" : "opacity-0"}`}
        />
        <span aria-hidden="true" className={`absolute inset-3 rounded-full ${meta.ring} opacity-60`} />
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`absolute inset-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${
            state === "thinking"
              ? "animate-pulse bg-amber-400/50"
              : state === "listening"
                ? "bg-indigo-400/40"
                : state === "speaking"
                  ? "bg-emerald-400/40"
                  : "bg-zinc-200/50 dark:bg-zinc-700/40"
          }`}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggle}
          aria-label={state === "idle" ? "Start voice mode" : "Stop voice mode"}
          aria-pressed={state !== "idle"}
          className={`relative flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 ${meta.orb}`}
        >
          <UiIcon name={state === "idle" ? "mic" : "square"} size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex h-6 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">
        {Array.from({ length: BAR_COUNT }, (_, index) => (
          <span
            key={index}
            className={`w-1 rounded-full ${
              animated
                ? "animate-[voice-bar_0.9s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate] bg-indigo-500"
                : "h-1 bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700"
            }`}
            style={animated ? { animationDelay: `${(index * 0.07).toFixed(2)}s` } : undefined}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <p className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{meta.label}</p>
      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{meta.hint}</p>

      {transcript && (
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          “{transcript}”
        </p>
      )}
      {reply && (
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
          {reply}
        </p>
      )}

      {onEnd && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onEnd}
          className="mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
          End voice session
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default VoiceModePanel;

====/File: vue/Accordion.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    :class="['divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900', $attrs.class]">
    <div v-for="item in items" :key="item.id">
      <h3>
        <button type="button" :id="`accordion-trigger-${item.id}`" :aria-expanded="isOpen(item.id)"
          :aria-controls="`accordion-panel-${item.id}`" @click="toggle(item.id)"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50">
          <span v-if="item.icon" class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
            <UiIcon :name="item.icon" :size="14" />
          </span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ item.title }}</span>
            <span v-if="item.description" class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ item.description }}</span>
          </span>
          <span :class="['shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200', isOpen(item.id) ? 'rotate-180' : '']">
            <UiIcon name="chevron-down" :size="14" />
          </span>
        </button>
      </h3>
      <div v-if="isOpen(item.id)" :id="`accordion-panel-${item.id}`" role="region"
        :aria-labelledby="`accordion-trigger-${item.id}`"
        class="px-4 pb-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
        {{ item.content }}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface AccordionItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  content: string;
  icon?: IconName;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items: AccordionItem[];
    allowMultiple?: boolean;
    defaultOpenIds?: string[];
  }>(),
  { allowMultiple: false }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'toggle', id: string, open: boolean): void }>();

const openIds = ref<string[]>(
  props.defaultOpenIds ?? props.items.filter((item) => item.defaultOpen).map((item) => item.id)
);

const isOpen = (id: string) => openIds.value.includes(id);

const toggle = (id: string) => {
  const wasOpen = isOpen(id);
  if (wasOpen) {
    openIds.value = openIds.value.filter((entry) => entry !== id);
  } else {
    openIds.value = props.allowMultiple ? [...openIds.value, id] : [id];
  }
  emit('toggle', id, !wasOpen);
};
</script>

====/File: vue/AccountSwitcher.vue/====

<template>
  <div ref="rootRef" :class="className" class="relative inline-block text-left">
    <button
      v-if="current"
      type="button"
      aria-haspopup="menu"
      :aria-expanded="open"
      class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
      @click="setOpen(!open)"
    >
      <span
        class="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400"
      >
        <img v-if="current.avatar" :src="current.avatar" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />
        <template v-else>{{ initials(current.name) }}</template>
      </span>
      <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ current.name }}</span>
        <span v-if="current.email" class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ current.email }}</span>
      </span>
      <UiIcon name="chevron-down" :size="12" class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
    </button>

    <div
      v-if="open && current"
      role="menu"
      aria-label="Switch account"
      class="absolute left-0 z-30 mt-1 w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
    >
      <ul class="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto py-1">
        <li v-for="account in accounts" :key="account.id">
          <button
            type="button"
            role="menuitemradio"
            :aria-checked="account.id === current.id"
            class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
            @click="choose(account)"
          >
            <span
              class="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
            >
              <img v-if="account.avatar" :src="account.avatar" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />
              <template v-else>{{ initials(account.name) }}</template>
            </span>
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ account.name }}</span>
              <span class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                {{ [account.role, account.plan].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || account.email }}
              </span>
            </span>
            <UiIcon
              v-if="account.id === current.id"
              name="check"
              :size="12"
              class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"
            />
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>

      <div class="border-t border-zinc-100 py-1 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <button
          type="button"
          role="menuitem"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          @click="addAccount"
        >
          <UiIcon name="plus" :size="12" class="text-zinc-400" />
          Add account
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          role="menuitem"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-red-600 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30"
          @click="signOut"
        >
          <UiIcon name="arrow-right" :size="12" />
          Sign out
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface Account {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  avatar?: string;
  role?: string;
  plan?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    accounts?: Account[];
    currentId?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { accounts: () => [], currentId: '', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'switch', account: Account): void;
  (e: 'add-account'): void;
  (e: 'sign-out'): void;
  (e: 'open-change', open: boolean): void;
}>();

const open = ref(false);
const rootRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);

const current = computed(() => props.accounts.find((account) => account.id === props.currentId) || props.accounts[0]);

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

function setOpen(next: boolean) {
  open.value = next;
  emit('open-change', next);
}

function choose(account: Account) {
  emit('switch', account);
  setOpen(false);
}

function addAccount() {
  emit('add-account');
  setOpen(false);
}

function signOut() {
  emit('sign-out');
  setOpen(false);
}

function onPointerDown(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (rootRef.value && !rootRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
}

function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
}

watch(open, (isOpen) => {
  if (isOpen) {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  } else {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
});
</script>

====/File: vue/AgentRunLog.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
      <UiIcon name="terminal" :size="14" class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" />
      <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ title }}</span>
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ doneCount }}/{{ steps.length }}</span>
    </div>
    <ol class="px-4 py-3">
      <li v-for="(step, index) in steps" :key="step.id" class="relative pl-6">
        <span v-if="index !== steps.length - 1" aria-hidden="true"
          class="absolute left-[6px] top-5 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        <span class="absolute left-0 top-1"><UiIcon :name="statusIcon(step.status)" :size="14" :class="statusClass(step.status)" /></span>
        <div class="pb-3">
          <button type="button" :aria-expanded="step.detail ? expanded.has(step.id) : undefined"
            :class="['flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left', step.detail ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default']"
            @click="step.detail && toggle(step.id)">
            <span :class="['text-xs', step.status === 'pending' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200']">{{ step.label }}</span>
            <span v-if="step.durationMs !== undefined" class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ formatDuration(step.durationMs) }}</span>
            <span v-if="step.detail" class="ml-auto text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
              <UiIcon :name="expanded.has(step.id) ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'" :size="12" />
            </span>
          </button>
          <pre v-if="step.detail && expanded.has(step.id)"
            class="mt-2 max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-300">{{ step.detail }}</pre>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type AgentRunStatus = 'pending' | 'running' | 'done' | 'error';
export interface AgentRunStep { id: string; label: string; status: AgentRunStatus; detail?: string; durationMs?: number }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  steps: AgentRunStep[];
  title?: string;
  autoExpandRunning?: boolean;
}>(), { title: 'Execution log', autoExpandRunning: true });

const expanded = ref(new Set<string>(
  props.autoExpandRunning ? props.steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'running' && s.detail).map((s) => s.id) : []
));

const doneCount = computed(() => props.steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'done').length);

const statusIcon = (status: AgentRunStatus) =>
  status === 'running' ? 'loader' : status === 'done' ? 'check-circle' : status === 'error' ? 'circle-x' : 'clock';
const statusClass = (status: AgentRunStatus) =>
  status === 'running' ? 'animate-spin text-indigo-500' : status === 'done' ? 'text-emerald-500' : status === 'error' ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500';
const formatDuration = (ms?: number) => (typeof ms !== 'number' ? '' : ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);
const toggle = (id: string) => {
  const next = new Set(expanded.value);
  next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id);
  expanded.value = next;
};
</script>

====/File: vue/AgentStepTimeline.vue/====

<template>
  <ol v-if="steps.length > 0" class="relative space-y-4" :class="className">
    <li v-for="(step, i) in steps" :key="step.id" class="relative flex gap-3">
      <span
        v-if="i < steps.length - 1"
        aria-hidden="true"
        class="absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-[-16px] w-px"
        :class="step.status === 'done' ? 'bg-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-800' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700'"
      />
      <span
        class="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-full shrink-0"
        :class="statusMeta(step.status).cls"
      >
        <UiIcon :name="statusMeta(step.status).icon" :size="15" :class="statusMeta(step.status).pulse ? 'animate-spin' : ''" />
      </span>
      <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 pb-1">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span
            class="text-sm font-medium"
            :class="statusMeta(step.status) === STATUS_META.pending ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'"
          >
            {{ step.title }}
          </span>
          <span v-if="step.duration" class="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">{{ step.duration }}</span>
        </div>
        <div v-if="step.description" class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ step.description }}</div>
      </div>
    </li>
  </ol>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface AgentStep {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  status: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "error";
  duration?: string;
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    steps?: AgentStep[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { steps: () => [], className: "" }
);

const STATUS_META: Record<string, { icon: string; cls: string; pulse?: boolean }> = {
  pending: { icon: "clock", cls: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" },
  running: { icon: "loader", cls: "text-indigo-500 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60", pulse: true },
  done: { icon: "check-circle", cls: "text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60" },
  error: { icon: "circle-x", cls: "text-rose-500 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60" },
};

function statusMeta(status: string) {
  return STATUS_META[status] || STATUS_META.pending;
}
</script>

====/File: vue/AgentTaskChecklist.vue/====

<template>
  <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden" :class="className">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
      <UiIcon name="layers" :size="14" class="text-zinc-400" />
      {{ title }}
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-zinc-400">{{ doneCount }}/{{ items.length }}</span>
    </div>
    <ul class="p-1.5 space-y-0.5">
      <li v-for="item in items" :key="item.id">
        <div
          role="button"
          tabindex="0"
          class="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          :class="item.status === 'done' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'"
          @click="emit('toggle', item.id)"
          @keydown.enter.prevent="emit('toggle', item.id)"
          @keydown.space.prevent="emit('toggle', item.id)"
        >
          <UiIcon :name="statusIcon(item.status).icon" :size="15" class="shrink-0" :class="statusIcon(item.status).cls" />
          <span class="flex-1 min-w-0 truncate" :class="item.status === 'done' ? 'line-through' : ''">{{ item.label }}</span>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface AgentTaskItem {
  id: string | number;
  label: string;
  status: "pending" | "active" | "done";
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items?: AgentTaskItem[];
    title?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { items: () => [], title: "Tasks", className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "toggle", id: string | number): void;
}>();

const doneCount = computed(() => props.items.filter((i) => i.status === "done").length);

const STATUS_ICON: Record<string, { icon: string; cls: string }> = {
  pending: { icon: "square", cls: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600" },
  active: { icon: "loader", cls: "text-indigo-500 animate-spin" },
  done: { icon: "check-circle", cls: "text-emerald-500" },
};

function statusIcon(status: string) {
  return STATUS_ICON[status] || STATUS_ICON.pending;
}
</script>

  <div
    v-if="isOpen"
    :class="[
      'fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-full sm:w-[500px] md:w-[680px] z-40 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border-l border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl flex flex-col transition-transform duration-300',
      className
    ]"
  >
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
        <span class="font-semibold text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate max-w-[240px]">
          {{ title }}
        </span>
        <!-- Tabs -->
        <div class="flex items-center bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-800 p-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <button
            type="button"
            @click="tab = 'preview'"
            :class="[
              'flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors',
              tab === 'preview'
                ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs'
                : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
            ]"
          >
            <span>Preview</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            @click="tab = 'code'"
            :class="[
              'flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors',
              tab === 'code'
                ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs'
                : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
            ]"
          >
            <span>Code</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Actions -->
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
        <button
          type="button"
          @click="handleCopy"
          class="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors text-xs font-mono"
          title="Copy Code"
        >
          <span v-if="copied" class="text-emerald-500 font-bold flex items-center gap-1"><UiIcon name="check" :size="14" /> Copied</span>
          <span v-else>Copy</span>
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          @click="$emit('close')"
          class="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors"
          title="Close Panel"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" :size="18" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Content Body -->
    <div class="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative">
      <iframe
        v-if="tab === 'preview'"
        :srcdoc="
          language === 'svg'
            ? `<div style='display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;margin:0;background:#09090b;'>${code}</div>`
            : language === 'html'
            ? `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'><script src='https://cdn.tailwindcss.com'></script><style>body { margin: 0; padding: 1rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }</style></head><body>${code}</body></html>`
            : code
        "
        sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals"
        title="Artifact Preview Frame"
        class="w-full h-full border-0 bg-white"
      ></iframe>
      <pre
        v-else
        class="w-full h-full p-4 m-0 overflow-auto bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100 text-xs font-mono leading-relaxed"
      ><code>{{ code }}</code></pre>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title?: string;
    code: string;
    language?: 'html' | 'svg' | 'react' | 'javascript' | string;
    isOpen?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    title: 'Artifact Preview',
    language: 'html',
    isOpen: true,
    className: ''
  }
);

defineEmits<{
  (e: 'close'): void;
}>();

const tab = ref<'preview' | 'code'>('preview');
const copied = ref(false);

const handleCopy = async () => {
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.code);
  copied.value = true;
  setTimeout(() => (copied.value = false), 2000);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class"
    class="w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-6">
    <div class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">

        <img v-if="provider.icon" :src="provider.icon" alt="" class="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
        <span v-else

          {{ providerFallback(provider.name) }}
        </span>
        <span>Continue with {{ provider.name }}</span>
      </button>

    <div v-if="providers.length" class="my-5 flex items-center gap-3">

      <label v-if="isSignup" class="block">
        <span class="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Name</span>
        <input v-model="name" type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Ada Lovelace" :class="inputClass" />
      </label>

      <label class="block">
        <span class="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Email</span>
        <input v-model="email" type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@company.com"
          :class="inputClass" />
      </label>

      <label class="block">
        <span class="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Password</span>
        <input v-model="password" type="password" name="password"
          :autocomplete="isSignup ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'" placeholder="••••••••" :class="inputClass" />
      </label>

      <div v-if="error" role="alert" class="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 px-3 py-2">
        <UiIcon name="alert-triangle" :size="14" class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-red-500" />
        <span class="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{{ error }}</span>
      </div>

      <button type="submit" :disabled="loading"
        class="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900">
        <UiIcon v-if="loading" name="loader" :size="14" class="animate-spin" />
        {{ submitText || (isSignup ? 'Create account' : 'Sign in') }}
      </button>
    </form>

    <button v-if="footerText" type="button"
      class="mt-4 w-full text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
      @click="emit('footer')">
      {{ footerText }}
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface AuthProvider { name: string; icon?: string }
export interface AuthSubmitPayload { name?: string; email: string; password: string }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  mode?: 'signin' | 'signup';
  providers?: AuthProvider[];
  loading?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  submitText?: string;
  footerText?: string;
}>(), { mode: 'signin', providers: () => [], loading: false });

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'submit', payload: AuthSubmitPayload): void;
  (e: 'provider', provider: AuthProvider): void;
  (e: 'footer'): void;
}>();

const name = ref('');
const email = ref('');
const password = ref('');
const isSignup = computed(() => props.mode === 'signup');
const providerFallback = (value: string) => (value || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();

const inputClass =
  'w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:border-indigo-500 transition-colors';

const handleSubmit = () => {
  if (props.loading) return;
  emit('submit', { ...(isSignup.value ? { name: name.value } : {}), email: email.value, password: password.value });
};
</script>

====/File: vue/AutoScrollAnchor.vue/====

<template>
  <div :ref="(el) => { bottomEl = el as HTMLElement; }" :class="['h-px w-full pointer-events-none', className]"></div>

  <!-- Floating Back to Bottom Button -->
  <button
    v-if="!isAtBottom"
    type="button"
    @click="scrollToBottom"
    class="fixed bottom-24 right-8 z-30 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium"
    title="Scroll to bottom"
  >
    <span>↓</span>
    <span v-if="isStreaming" class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-ping"></span>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isStreaming?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    isStreaming: false,
    className: ''
  }
);

const bottomEl = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);
const isAtBottom = ref(true);

const handleScroll = () => {
  const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
  const documentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
  const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
  const distanceFromBottom = documentHeight - (scrollTop + windowHeight);
  isAtBottom.value = distanceFromBottom < 80;
};

onMounted(() => {
  window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
});

onUnmounted(() => {
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
});

watch(
  () => props.isStreaming,
  (streaming) => {
    if (streaming && isAtBottom.value) {
      bottomEl.value?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }
);

const scrollToBottom = () => {
  bottomEl.value?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
};
</script>

====/File: vue/AvatarGroup.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="['flex items-center -space-x-2', $attrs.class]">
    <button v-for="member in visible" :key="member.id" type="button" :title="member.name" :aria-label="member.name"
      class="relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold text-zinc-600 ring-2 ring-white transition-transform hover:z-10 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:z-10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:ring-zinc-900"
      :class="sizeClass" @click="$emit('member-click', member)">
      <img v-if="member.src" :src="member.src" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />
      <span v-else-if="member.name.trim()" aria-hidden="true">{{ initials(member.name) }}</span>
      <UiIcon v-else name="user" :size="iconSize" />
      <span v-if="member.status" aria-hidden="true"
        :class="['absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900', DOT_CLASS[member.status]]" />
    </button>
    <span v-if="overflow > 0" :title="`${overflow} more`"
      :class="['relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-500 ring-2 ring-white dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:ring-zinc-900', sizeClass]">
      +{{ overflow }}
    </span>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type AvatarStatus = 'online' | 'away' | 'offline';

export interface AvatarMember {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  src?: string;
  status?: AvatarStatus;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    members: AvatarMember[];
    max?: number;
    size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  }>(),
  { max: 4, size: 'md' }
);
defineEmits<{ (e: 'member-click', member: AvatarMember): void }>();

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<'sm' | 'md' | 'lg', string> = {
  sm: 'h-7 w-7 text-[10px]',
  md: 'h-9 w-9 text-xs',
  lg: 'h-11 w-11 text-sm',
};

const DOT_CLASS: Record<AvatarStatus, string> = {
  online: 'bg-emerald-500',
  away: 'bg-amber-400',
  offline: 'bg-zinc-400',
};

const visible = computed(() => props.members.slice(0, Math.max(0, props.max)));
const overflow = computed(() => props.members.length - visible.value.length);
const sizeClass = computed(() => SIZE_CLASS[props.size]);
const iconSize = computed(() => (props.size === 'sm' ? 12 : props.size === 'lg' ? 18 : 14));

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join('');
</script>

====/File: vue/Breadcrumb.vue/====

<template>
  <nav :aria-label="ariaLabel" :class="$attrs.class">
    <ol class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
      <li v-for="(item, index) in trail" :key="item ? item.id ?? `${item.label}-${index}` : `ellipsis-${index}`"
        class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span v-if="index > 0" aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
          <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="11" />
        </span>
        <span v-if="!item" aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-zinc-400">…</span>
        <span v-else-if="index === trail.length - 1" aria-current="page"
          :class="[BASE, 'font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100']">
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="12" />
          <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
        </span>
        <a v-else-if="item.href" :href="item.href" :class="[BASE, LINK_CLASS]"
          @click="onLinkClick($event, item, index)">
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="12" />
          <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
        </a>
        <button v-else type="button" :class="[BASE, LINK_CLASS]" @click="emit('navigate', item, index)">
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="12" />
          <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
        </button>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </nav>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  icon?: IconName;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items: BreadcrumbItem[];
    maxItems?: number;
    ariaLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { maxItems: 0, ariaLabel: 'Breadcrumb' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'navigate', item: BreadcrumbItem, index: number): void }>();

const BASE = 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1 py-0.5 transition-colors';
const LINK_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';

const trail = computed<(BreadcrumbItem | null)[]>(() => {
  const { items, maxItems } = props;
  if (maxItems <= 0 || items.length <= maxItems) return items;
  const tail = Math.max(1, maxItems - 1);
  return [items[0], null, ...items.slice(items.length - tail)];
});

const onLinkClick = (event: MouseEvent, item: BreadcrumbItem, index: number) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  emit('navigate', item, index);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div
    :class="[
      'relative w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/90 shadow-sm focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-zinc-900/10 dark:focus-within:ring-zinc-100/10 focus-within:border-zinc-400 dark:focus-within:border-zinc-600 transition-all',
      className
    ]"
  >
    <!-- Attachments Preview Area -->
    <div v-if="attachments.length > 0" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 p-3 pb-0">
      <div
        v-for="att in attachments"
        :key="att.id"
        class="group relative flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 pr-1.5 py-1 text-xs bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80"
      >
        <span class="max-w-[140px] truncate font-medium">{{ att.name }}</span>
        <button
          type="button"
          @click="$emit('removeAttachment', att.id)"
          class="p-0.5 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" :size="14" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Input Area -->
    <div class="flex items-end px-3 py-2.5 gap-2">
      <template v-if="allowAttachments">
        <input
          ref="fileInputRef"
          type="file"
          multiple
          class="hidden"
          @change="handleFileChange"
          :disabled="disabled || isGenerating"
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          @click="fileInputRef?.click()"
          :disabled="disabled || isGenerating"
          class="p-2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-xl transition-colors disabled:opacity-40"
          title="Add attachment"
        >
          <UiIcon name="paperclip" :size="18" />
        </button>
      </template>

      <textarea
        ref="textareaRef"
        :value="modelValue"
        @input="handleInput"
        @keydown="handleKeyDown"
        :placeholder="placeholder"
        :disabled="disabled"
        rows="1"
        class="flex-1 bg-transparent resize-none border-0 p-1 text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 leading-relaxed max-h-[240px] min-h-[36px]"
      ></textarea>

      <!-- Action Button -->
      <button
        v-if="isGenerating"
        type="button"
        @click="$emit('stop')"
        class="p-2 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 text-white dark:text-zinc-900 rounded-xl hover:opacity-90 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-sm flex-shrink-0"
        title="Stop generation"
      >
        <UiIcon name="square" :size="16" class="fill-current" />
      </button>
      <button
        v-else
        type="button"
        @click="handleSubmit"
        :disabled="!modelValue.trim() || disabled"
        class="p-2 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 text-white dark:text-zinc-900 rounded-xl hover:opacity-90 active:scale-95 transition-all disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none shadow-sm flex-shrink-0"
        title="Send message"
      >
        <UiIcon name="arrow-up" :size="16" />
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Chips Row (model / tools) -->
    <div v-if="chips.length > 0" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 px-3 pt-2 pb-2.5 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <button
        v-for="chip in chips"
        :key="chip.id"
        type="button"
        :aria-pressed="!!chip.active"
        :class="['flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
          chip.active
            ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400'
            : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700']"
        @click="emit('chipClick', chip)"
      >
        <UiIcon v-if="chip.icon" :name="chip.icon" :size="12" />
        {{ chip.label }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch, nextTick } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface Attachment {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  url?: string;
  type: 'image' | 'file';
}

export interface PromptChip {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  active?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    modelValue: string;
    isGenerating?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    allowAttachments?: boolean;
    attachments?: Attachment[];
    chips?: PromptChip[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    isGenerating: false,
    placeholder: 'Ask anything... (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)',
    disabled: false,
    allowAttachments: true,
    attachments: () => [],
    chips: () => [],
    className: ''
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'update:modelValue', value: string): void;
  (e: 'submit'): void;
  (e: 'stop'): void;
  (e: 'addAttachment', file: File): void;
  (e: 'removeAttachment', id: string): void;
  (e: 'chipClick', chip: PromptChip): void;
}>();

const textareaRef = ref<HTMLTextAreaElement | null>(null);
const fileInputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

const adjustHeight = () => {
  const textarea = textareaRef.current;
  if (!textarea) return;
  textarea.style.height = 'auto';
  const nextHeight = Math.min(textarea.scrollHeight, 240);
  textarea.style.height = `${Math.max(nextHeight, 48)}px`;
};

const handleInput = (e: Event) => {
  const val = (e.target as HTMLTextAreaElement).value;
  emit('update:modelValue', val);
  adjustHeight();
};

watch(() => props.modelValue, () => {
  nextTick(adjustHeight);
});

const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
    if (e.isComposing) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!props.isGenerating && props.modelValue.trim() && !props.disabled) {
      emit('submit');
    }
  }
};

const handleFileChange = (e: Event) => {
  const target = e.target as HTMLInputElement;
  const files = target.files;
  if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
  Array.from(files).forEach((file) => emit('addAttachment', file));
  target.value = '';
};

const handleSubmit = () => {
  if (props.modelValue.trim() && !props.disabled) {
    emit('submit');
  }
};
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-col w-64 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden" :class="className">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
      <UiIcon name="sparkles" :size="15" class="text-indigo-500" />
      {{ title }}
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-zinc-400">{{ sessions.length }}</span>
    </div>

    <div v-if="sessions.length === 0" class="p-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ emptyText }}</div>
    <div v-else class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-1.5">

        <button
          v-if="group.label !== 'Recent'"
          type="button"
          :aria-expanded="!collapsedGroups.has(group.label)"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-1 px-2.5 pt-2 pb-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-500 dark:hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors select-none"

        >
          <UiIcon
            name="chevron-down"
            :size="11"
            :class="['transition-transform duration-150', collapsedGroups.has(group.label) ? '-rotate-90' : '']"
          />
          <span class="flex-1 text-left">{{ group.label }}</span>
          <span class="font-mono font-normal">{{ group.items.length }}</span>
        </button>
        <ul v-if="!collapsedGroups.has(group.label)" class="space-y-0.5">
          <li v-for="s in group.items" :key="s.id">
            <div
              role="button"
              tabindex="0"
              class="group w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-left text-sm cursor-pointer transition-colors"
              :class="String(s.id) === String(activeId)
                ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300'
                : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/70'"
              @click="emit('select', s)"
              @keydown.enter.prevent="emit('select', s)"
              @keydown.space.prevent="emit('select', s)"
            >
              <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <span class="block truncate font-medium">{{ s.title }}</span>
                <span v-if="s.timeLabel" class="block text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{{ s.timeLabel }}</span>
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label="Delete session"
                class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-all shrink-0"
                @click.stop="emit('delete', s.id)"
              >
                <UiIcon name="x" :size="13" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Bottom user card -->
    <button
      v-if="user"
      type="button"
      class="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors text-left"
      @click="emit('userClick')"
    >
      <img v-if="user.avatarUrl" :src="user.avatarUrl" alt="" class="h-7 w-7 rounded-full object-cover shrink-0" />
      <span
        v-else
        class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0"
      >
        {{ initials }}
      </span>
      <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <span class="block truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ user.name }}</span>
        <span v-if="user.email" class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{{ user.email }}</span>
      </span>
      <UiIcon name="settings" :size="14" class="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ChatSessionItem {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  timeLabel?: string;
  /** Optional group label (e.g. "Today", "Previous 7 days"); sessions without one go to "Recent". */
  group?: string;
}

export interface ChatSessionUser {
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    sessions?: ChatSessionItem[];
    activeId?: string | number | null;
    user?: ChatSessionUser;
    title?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { sessions: () => [], activeId: null, title: "Chats", emptyText: "No conversations yet", className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "select", session: ChatSessionItem): void;
  (e: "delete", id: string | number): void;
  (e: "userClick"): void;
}>();

const collapsedGroups = ref(new Set<string>());
const toggleGroup = (label: string) => {
  const next = new Set(collapsedGroups.value);
  if (next.has(label)) next.delete(label);
  else next.add(label);
  collapsedGroups.value = next;
};

// Preserve the sessions' original order; group headers appear on first occurrence.
const groups = computed(() => {
  const result: { label: string; items: ChatSessionItem[] }[] = [];
  props.sessions.forEach((s) => {
    const label = s.group || "Recent";
    const existing = result.find((g) => g.label === label);
    if (existing) existing.items.push(s);
    else result.push({ label, items: [s] });
  });
  return result;
});

const initials = computed(() =>
  props.user
    ? (props.user.name || "?")
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .map((w) => w[0])
        .slice(0, 2)
        .join("")
        .toUpperCase()
    : ""
);
</script>

<template>
  <div
    class="group relative rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 overflow-hidden text-sm font-mono"
    :class="className"
  >
    <div
      v-if="language || filename || showCopy"
      class="flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-100/60 dark:bg-zinc-900/60"
    >
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <UiIcon name="terminal" :size="13" class="shrink-0" />
        <span v-if="filename" class="font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 truncate">
          {{ filename }}
        </span>
        <span
          v-if="language"
          class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold tracking-wide shrink-0"
        >
          {{ language }}
        </span>
      </div>
      <button
        v-if="showCopy"
        type="button"
        class="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/70 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors shrink-0"
        aria-label="Copy code"
        @click="handleCopy"
      >
        <UiIcon :name="copied ? 'check' : 'copy'" :size="13" :class="copied ? 'text-emerald-500' : ''" />
        <span class="hidden sm:inline">{{ copied ? "Copied" : "Copy" }}</span>
      </button>
    </div>

    <div
      class="overflow-auto p-3.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
      :style="maxHeight ? { maxHeight } : undefined"
    >
      <pre class="whitespace-pre"><code v-if="showLineNumbers"><div v-for="(line, idx) in lines" :key="idx" class="flex"><span class="w-8 shrink-0 select-none text-right pr-3 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600">{{ idx + 1 }}</span><span class="flex-1">{{ line || " " }}</span></div></code><code v-else>{{ code }}</code></pre>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    code: string;
    language?: string;
    filename?: string;
    showLineNumbers?: boolean;
    showCopy?: boolean;
    maxHeight?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    language: "",
    showLineNumbers: false,
    showCopy: true,
    className: "",
  }
);

const copied = ref(false);

const lines = computed(() => String(props.code ?? "").replace(/\n$/, "").split("\n"));

async function handleCopy() {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.code);
    copied.value = true;
    setTimeout(() => (copied.value = false), 2000);
  } catch {
    copied.value = false;
  }
}
</script>

====/File: vue/CommandPalette.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    v-if="isOpen"
    class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center pt-[15vh] bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm"
    role="dialog"
    aria-modal="true"
    aria-label="Command palette"
    @click="emit('close')"
  >
    <div
      class="w-full max-w-lg mx-4 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
      :class="className"
      @click.stop
    >
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <UiIcon name="search" :size="16" class="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
        <input
          ref="inputRef"
          v-model="query"
          type="text"
          :placeholder="placeholder"
          class="w-full bg-transparent border-none text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
        />
        <kbd class="hidden sm:inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">ESC</kbd>
      </div>

      <div class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto p-1.5" role="listbox">
        <div v-if="filtered.length === 0" class="p-4 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400">No results found</div>
        <template v-else v-for="(item, idx) in filtered" :key="item.id">
          <div
            v-if="item.group && item.group !== filtered[idx - 1]?.group"
            class="px-2.5 pt-2.5 pb-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400"
          >
            {{ item.group }}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            role="option"
            :aria-selected="idx === activeIndex"
            class="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-left text-sm transition-colors"
            :class="idx === activeIndex
              ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
              : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'"
            @click="select(item)"
            @mouseenter="activeIndex = idx"
          >
            <span v-if="item.icon" class="p-1 rounded-md bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0">
              <UiIcon :name="item.icon" :size="14" />
            </span>
            <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <span class="block truncate font-medium">{{ item.label }}</span>
              <span v-if="item.hint" class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{{ item.hint }}</span>
            </span>
            <kbd v-if="item.shortcut" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shrink-0">
              {{ item.shortcut }}
            </kbd>
          </button>
        </template>
      </div>

      <!-- Shortcut hint bar -->
      <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 px-4 py-2 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/30 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
        <span v-for="hint in shortcutHints" :key="hint.label" class="flex items-center gap-1">
          <kbd
            v-for="k in hint.keys"
            :key="k"
            class="inline-flex min-w-[1.25rem] justify-center px-1 py-0.5 font-mono bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700"
          >
            {{ k }}
          </kbd>
          <span>{{ hint.label }}</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch, nextTick, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface CommandItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  icon?: string;
  group?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items?: CommandItem[];
    isOpen: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { items: () => [], placeholder: "Type a command or search...", className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "select", item: CommandItem): void;
  (e: "close"): void;
}>();

const query = ref("");
const activeIndex = ref(0);
const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

const shortcutHints = [
  { keys: ["↑", "↓"], label: "Navigate" },
  { keys: ["↵"], label: "Select" },
  { keys: ["esc"], label: "Close" },
] as const;

const filtered = computed(() => {
  if (!query.value.trim()) return props.items;
  const q = query.value.toLowerCase();
  return props.items.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (i.hint && i.hint.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
      (i.group && i.group.toLowerCase().includes(q))
  );
});

function select(item: CommandItem) {
  emit("select", item);
  emit("close");
}

watch(
  () => props.isOpen,
  async (open) => {
    if (open) {
      query.value = "";
      activeIndex.value = 0;
      await nextTick();
      inputRef.value?.focus();
    }
  }
);
watch(query, () => (activeIndex.value = 0));

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!props.isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    emit("close");
  } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
    e.preventDefault();
    activeIndex.value = Math.min(filtered.value.length - 1, activeIndex.value + 1);
  } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
    e.preventDefault();
    activeIndex.value = Math.max(0, activeIndex.value - 1);
  } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
    e.preventDefault();
    const item = filtered.value[activeIndex.value];
    if (item) select(item);
  }
}

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey));
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey));
</script>

====/File: vue/CommentThread.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="className">
    <p v-if="comments.length === 0" class="py-4 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{{ emptyText }}</p>
    <ul v-else class="space-y-2.5">
      <li
        v-for="row in rows"
        :key="row.comment.id"
        :class="row.depth > 0 ? 'border-l border-zinc-200 pl-3 dark:border-zinc-700' : ''"
      >
        <div class="flex items-start gap-2">
          <span
            :class="[
              'flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200',
              row.depth > 0 ? 'h-5 w-5' : 'h-6 w-6',
            ]"
          >
            <img v-if="row.comment.avatar" :src="row.comment.avatar" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />
            <template v-else>{{ initials(row.comment.author) }}</template>
          </span>
          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5">
              <span class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ row.comment.author }}</span>
              <span v-if="row.comment.time" class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ row.comment.time }}</span>
              <span
                v-if="row.comment.resolved"
                class="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400"
              >
                <UiIcon name="check" :size="9" />
                Resolved
              </span>
            </div>
            <p class="mt-0.5 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {{ row.comment.text }}
            </p>

            <div class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
              <button
                type="button"
                :aria-label="`Like comment by ${row.comment.author}`"
                class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400"
                @click="emit('like', row.comment)"
              >
                <UiIcon name="thumbs-up" :size="11" />
                <span class="tabular-nums">{{ row.comment.likes || 0 }}</span>

              <button

                :aria-expanded="replyTo === row.comment.id"

                @click="toggleReply(row.comment.id)"
              >
                Reply
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                class="transition-colors hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-emerald-400"
                @click="emit('resolve', row.comment)"
              >
                {{ row.comment.resolved ? 'Reopen' : 'Resolve' }}
              </button>
            </div>

            <div v-if="replyTo === row.comment.id" class="mt-2 flex items-end gap-1.5">
              <textarea
                v-model="replyDraft"
                rows="2"
                :placeholder="`Reply to ${row.comment.author}...`"
                :aria-label="`Reply to ${row.comment.author}`"
                class="flex-1 resize-none rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-200"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                :disabled="!replyDraft.trim()"
                class="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                @click="submitReply(row.comment.id)"
              >
                Reply
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ul>

    <div v-if="allowComment" class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <textarea
        v-model="draft"
        rows="2"
        :placeholder="placeholder"
        :aria-label="placeholder"
        class="w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-200"
      />
      <div class="mt-1.5 flex justify-end">
        <button
          type="button"
          :disabled="!draft.trim()"
          class="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
          @click="submitRoot"
        >
          {{ submitText }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface CommentItem {
  id: string | number;
  /** Parent comment id; omit or null for a root comment. */
  parentId?: string | number | null;
  author: string;
  /** Image URL; falls back to initials. */
  avatar?: string;
  text: string;
  time?: string;
  likes?: number;
  resolved?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    comments?: CommentItem[];
    placeholder?: string;
    submitText?: string;
    allowComment?: boolean;
    emptyText?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    comments: () => [],
    placeholder: 'Write a comment...',
    submitText: 'Comment',
    allowComment: true,
    emptyText: 'No comments yet. Start the conversation.',
    className: '',
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'submit', text: string, parentId: string | number | null): void;
  (e: 'like', comment: CommentItem): void;
  (e: 'resolve', comment: CommentItem): void;
}>();

const draft = ref('');
const replyTo = ref<string | number | null>(null);
const replyDraft = ref('');

/** Flat comments + parentId → depth-tagged render order (parents before children). */
const rows = computed(() => {
  const children = new Map<string, CommentItem[]>();
  const roots: CommentItem[] = [];
  props.comments.forEach((comment) => {
    if (comment.parentId == null) {
      roots.push(comment);
      return;
    }
    const key = String(comment.parentId);
    children.set(key, [...(children.get(key) || []), comment]);
  });

  const out: Array<{ comment: CommentItem; depth: number }> = [];
  const walk = (list: CommentItem[], depth: number) => {
    list.forEach((comment) => {
      out.push({ comment, depth });
      // Cap nesting at 3 levels so deep threads never break the layout.
      if (depth < 2) walk(children.get(String(comment.id)) || [], depth + 1);
      else (children.get(String(comment.id)) || []).forEach((child) => out.push({ comment: child, depth: depth + 1 }));
    });
  };
  walk(roots, 0);
  return out;
});

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? '')
    .join('');

function toggleReply(id: string | number) {
  replyTo.value = replyTo.value === id ? null : id;
  replyDraft.value = '';
}

function submitRoot() {
  const text = draft.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  emit('submit', text, null);
  draft.value = '';
}

function submitReply(parentId: string | number) {
  const text = replyDraft.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  emit('submit', text, parentId);
  replyDraft.value = '';
  replyTo.value = null;
}
</script>
