<template>
  <div
    v-if="isOpen"
    class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm"
    role="dialog"
    aria-modal="true"
    :aria-label="title"
    @click="!loading && emit('cancel')"
  >
    <div
      :class="className"
      class="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-5 shadow-2xl"
      @click.stop
    >
      <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
        <span :class="['flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full', tone.chip]">
          <UiIcon :name="tone.icon" :size="18" />
        </span>
        <div class="min-w-0 pt-0.5">
          <h2 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ title }}</h2>
          <p v-if="description" class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {{ description }}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div v-if="requireText" class="mt-4">
        <label class="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          Type <span class="font-mono font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ requireText }}</span> to confirm
        </label>
        <input
          ref="inputRef"
          v-model="typed"
          type="text"
          :placeholder="requireText"
          class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          :disabled="loading"
          class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:opacity-50"
          @click="emit('cancel')"
        >
          {{ cancelText }}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          :disabled="!canConfirm"
          :class="tone.button"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
          @click="canConfirm && emit('confirm')"
        >
          <UiIcon v-if="loading" name="loader" :size="12" class="animate-spin" />
          {{ confirmText }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch, nextTick, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

type Tone = "danger" | "warning" | "default";

const TONE_META: Record<Tone, { chip: string; button: string; icon: string }> = {
  danger: {
    chip: "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400",
    button: "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 focus-visible:ring-red-500",
    icon: "alert-triangle",
  },
  warning: {
    chip: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400",
    button: "bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 focus-visible:ring-amber-500",
    icon: "alert-triangle",
  },
  default: {
    chip: "bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400",
    button: "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500",
    icon: "info",
  },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    confirmText?: string;
    cancelText?: string;
    tone?: Tone;
    requireText?: string;
    loading?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    confirmText: "Confirm",
    cancelText: "Cancel",
    tone: "default",
    loading: false,
    className: "",
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "confirm"): void;
  (e: "cancel"): void;
}>();

const typed = ref("");
const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

const tone = computed(() => TONE_META[props.tone] ?? TONE_META.default);
const blocked = computed(() => Boolean(props.requireText) && typed.value !== props.requireText);
const canConfirm = computed(() => !blocked.value && !props.loading);

watch(
  () => props.isOpen,
  async (open) => {
    typed.value = "";
    if (open && props.requireText) {
      await nextTick();
      inputRef.value?.focus();
    }
  }
);

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!props.isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    emit("cancel");
  }
}

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey));
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey));
</script>

====/File: vue/ContextUsageBadge.vue/====

<template>
  <div class="relative inline-block text-xs font-sans select-none" :class="className">
    <button
      type="button"
      @click="showPopover = !showPopover"
      @blur="onBlur"
      class="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-colors shadow-sm"
      aria-label="Context Window Usage"
      :aria-expanded="showPopover"
    >
      <UiIcon name="cpu" :size="14" class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
      <span
        v-if="modelName && !compact"
        class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium truncate max-w-[120px]"
      >
        {{ modelName }}
      </span>
      <div class="w-16 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
        <div
          class="h-full transition-all duration-300"
          :class="barColor"
          :style="{ width: `${percentage}%` }"
        ></div>
      </div>
      <span class="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
        {{ percentage }}%
      </span>
    </button>

    <div
      v-if="showPopover"
      class="absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-2 w-64 p-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-xl z-30 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
    >
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">Context Window</span>
        <span class="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
          {{ formatNumber(safeUsed) }} / {{ formatNumber(safeMax) }}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div v-if="modelName" class="pt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 flex justify-between">
        <span>Model</span>
        <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium">{{ modelName }}</span>
      </div>

      <div v-if="breakdown && breakdown.length > 0" class="pt-2.5 space-y-1.5">
        <div class="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-zinc-400 tracking-wider">Breakdown</div>
        <div
          v-for="(item, idx) in breakdown"
          :key="idx"
          class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]"
        >
          <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" :class="item.colorClass || 'bg-zinc-400'"></span>
            {{ item.label }}
          </span>
          <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
            {{ formatNumber(item.count) }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ContextUsageTokenBreakdown {
  label: string;
  count: number;
  colorClass?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    usedTokens: number;
    maxTokens: number;
    modelName?: string;
    breakdown?: ContextUsageTokenBreakdown[];
    compact?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    compact: false,
    className: "",
    breakdown: () => [],
  }
);

const showPopover = ref(false);

const safeMax = computed(() => Math.max(1, props.maxTokens));
const safeUsed = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.usedTokens));
const percentage = computed(() =>
  Math.min(100, Math.round((safeUsed.value / safeMax.value) * 100))
);

const barColor = computed(() => {
  if (percentage.value >= 90) return "bg-rose-500";
  if (percentage.value >= 70) return "bg-amber-500";
  return "bg-emerald-500";
});

function formatNumber(num: number): string {
  if (num >= 1_000_000) return `${(num / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (num >= 1_000) return `${(num / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(num);
}

function onBlur() {
  setTimeout(() => {
    showPopover.value = false;
  }, 200);
}
</script>

====/File: vue/DataTable.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class" class="relative">
    <div class="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <table class="w-full text-xs">
        <thead class="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60">
          <tr>
            <th v-if="selectable" class="w-10 px-3 py-2">
              <input type="checkbox" :checked="allSelected" @change="toggleAll" aria-label="Select all rows"
                class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600" />
            </th>
            <th v-for="column in columns" :key="column.key" :style="column.width ? { width: column.width } : undefined"
              :class="['px-3 py-2 font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400', alignClass(column.align)]">
              <button type="button" @click="toggleSort(column.key)"
                class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">
                {{ column.label }}
                <span class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
                  <UiIcon :name="sortIcon(column.key)" :size="11" />
                </span>
              </button>
            </th>
            <th v-if="actions.length" class="w-20 px-3 py-2" />
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
          <tr v-if="sortedRows.length === 0">
            <td :colspan="columns.length + (selectable ? 1 : 0) + (actions.length ? 1 : 0)"
              class="px-3 py-10 text-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ emptyText }}</td>
          </tr>
          <tr v-for="(row, index) in sortedRows" :key="index" class="group hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors">
            <td v-if="selectable" class="px-3 py-2">
              <input type="checkbox" :checked="selected.has(index)" @change="toggleRow(index)"
                :aria-label="`Select row ${index + 1}`" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600" />
            </td>
            <td v-for="column in columns" :key="column.key"
              :class="['px-3 py-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200', alignClass(column.align), column.align === 'right' ? 'tabular-nums' : '']">
              {{ row[column.key] ?? '—' }}
            </td>
            <td v-if="actions.length" class="px-3 py-2">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                <button v-for="action in actions" :key="action.label" type="button" :aria-label="action.label" :title="action.label"
                  class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
                  @click="action.onClick(row)">
                  <UiIcon :name="action.icon || 'more-horizontal'" :size="14" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div v-if="selectable && selected.size > 0"
      class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-20 flex -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 px-4 py-2 shadow-lg">
      <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ selected.size }} selected</span>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
        <button v-for="action in actions" :key="action.label" type="button"
          class="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors"
          @click="runBatch(action)">{{ action.label }}</button>
      </div>
      <button type="button" aria-label="Clear selection" class="rounded-full p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
        @click="selected = new Set()">
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="13" />
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, reactive } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface DataTableColumn { key: string; label: string; align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right'; width?: string }
export type DataTableRow = Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;
export interface DataTableAction { label: string; icon?: string; onClick: (row: DataTableRow) => void }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  columns: DataTableColumn[];
  rows: DataTableRow[];
  selectable?: boolean;
  onSort?: (key: string, direction: 'asc' | 'desc') => void;
  actions?: DataTableAction[];
  emptyText?: string;
}>(), { selectable: false, actions: () => [], emptyText: 'No results' });

const sortKey = ref<string | null>(null);
const sortDir = ref<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
const selected = ref(new Set<number>());

const alignClass = (align?: DataTableColumn['align']) =>
  align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : align === 'center' ? 'text-center' : 'text-left';

const sortedRows = computed(() => {
  if (props.onSort || !sortKey.value) return props.rows;
  const key = sortKey.value;
  const dir = sortDir.value === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
  return [...props.rows].sort((a, b) => {
    const av = a[key]; const bv = b[key];
    if (av === bv) return 0;
    return (String(av ?? '') > String(bv ?? '') ? 1 : -1) * dir;
  });
});

const allSelected = computed(() => sortedRows.value.length > 0 && selected.value.size === sortedRows.value.length);

const toggleSort = (key: string) => {
  const nextDir = sortKey.value === key && sortDir.value === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
  sortKey.value = key; sortDir.value = nextDir; props.onSort?.(key, nextDir);
};
const sortIcon = (key: string) => (sortKey.value === key ? (sortDir.value === 'asc' ? 'arrow-up' : 'arrow-down') : 'chevron-down');
const toggleAll = () => { selected.value = allSelected.value ? new Set() : new Set(sortedRows.value.map((_, i) => i)); };
const toggleRow = (index: number) => {
  const next = new Set(selected.value);
  next.has(index) ? next.delete(index) : next.add(index);
  selected.value = next;
};
const runBatch = (action: DataTableAction) => {
  selected.value.forEach((index) => action.onClick(sortedRows.value[index]));
  selected.value = new Set();
};
</script>

====/File: vue/DatePicker.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    :class="className"
    class="w-full max-w-[17rem] rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-3"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Previous month"
        class="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        @click="shift(-1)"
      >
        <UiIcon name="chevron-left" :size="14" />
      </button>
      <span class="flex-1 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
        {{ MONTHS[view.month] }} {{ view.year }}
      </span>
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Next month"
        class="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        @click="shift(1)"
      >
        <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="14" />
      </button>
    </div>

    <div class="mt-2 grid grid-cols-7 gap-0.5">
      <span v-for="label in weekdays" :key="label" class="py-1 text-center text-[10px] font-medium uppercase text-zinc-400">
        {{ label }}
      </span>

      <template v-for="(day, index) in cells" :key="day === null ? `blank-${index}` : iso(day)">
        <span v-if="day === null" />
        <button
          v-else
          type="button"
          :disabled="isDisabled(day)"
          :aria-pressed="value === iso(day)"
          :aria-label="iso(day)"
          :class="[
            'flex h-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[11px] tabular-nums transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 disabled:hover:bg-transparent dark:disabled:text-zinc-600',
            value === iso(day)
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'
              : iso(day) === today
                ? 'font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40'
                : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800',
          ]"
          @click="selectDay(day)"
        >
          {{ day }}
        </button>
      </template>
    </div>

    <div v-if="showToday" class="mt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="w-full rounded-md py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40"
        @click="selectToday"
      >
        Today
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];
const WEEKDAYS = ['Su', 'Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa'];

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** Selected date as YYYY-MM-DD. */
    value?: string;
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    weekStartsOn?: 0 | 1;
    showToday?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { weekStartsOn: 1, showToday: true, disabled: false, className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', isoDate: string): void }>();

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
const toIso = (year: number, month: number, day: number) => `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-${pad(day)}`;

const parseIso = (iso?: string) => {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(iso || '');
  if (!match) return null;
  return { year: Number(match[1]), month: Number(match[2]) - 1, day: Number(match[3]) };
};

const now = new Date();
const today = toIso(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());

const selected = computed(() => parseIso(props.value));
const initial = selected.value || parseIso(today)!;
const view = ref({ year: initial.year, month: initial.month });

watch(
  () => props.value,
  () => {
    if (selected.value) view.value = { year: selected.value.year, month: selected.value.month };
  }
);

const cells = computed(() => {
  const first = new Date(view.value.year, view.value.month, 1).getDay();
  const lead = (first - props.weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
  const total = new Date(view.value.year, view.value.month + 1, 0).getDate();
  const out: Array<number | null> = Array.from({ length: lead }, () => null);
  for (let day = 1; day <= total; day += 1) out.push(day);
  while (out.length % 7 !== 0) out.push(null);
  return out;
});

const weekdays = computed(() => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => WEEKDAYS[(i + props.weekStartsOn) % 7]));

const iso = (day: number) => toIso(view.value.year, view.value.month, day);

function shift(delta: number) {
  const next = new Date(view.value.year, view.value.month + delta, 1);
  view.value = { year: next.getFullYear(), month: next.getMonth() };
}

function isDisabled(day: number) {
  if (props.disabled) return true;
  const value = iso(day);
  if (props.min && value < props.min) return true;
  if (props.max && value > props.max) return true;
  return false;
}

function selectDay(day: number) {
  if (isDisabled(day)) return;
  emit('change', iso(day));
}

function selectToday() {
  if (props.disabled) return;
  if ((props.min && today < props.min) || (props.max && today > props.max)) return;
  emit('change', today);
}
</script>

====/File: vue/DiffViewer.vue/====

<template>
  <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden" :class="className">
    <!-- Multi-file tab bar -->
    <div
      v-if="files.length"
      role="tablist"
      class="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 px-1.5 pt-1.5"
    >
      <button
        v-for="(file, idx) in files"
        :key="file.filename"
        type="button"
        role="tab"
        :aria-selected="idx === activeIdx"
        @click="activeIdx = idx"
        :class="[
          'flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-t-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] transition-colors',
          idx === activeIdx
            ? 'border border-b-0 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'
            : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
        ]"
      >
        <span class="max-w-[10rem] truncate">{{ file.filename }}</span>
        <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{{ countType(file.lines, 'add') }}</span>
        <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-{{ countType(file.lines, 'remove') }}</span>
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Active file header -->
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs">
      <UiIcon name="git-branch" :size="14" class="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
      <span v-if="activeFilename" class="font-mono font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 truncate">{{ activeFilename }}</span>
      <span
        v-if="activeLanguage"
        class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700/70 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
      >
        {{ activeLanguage }}
      </span>
      <span class="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
        <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{{ added }}</span>
        <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-{{ removed }}</span>
      </span>
    </div>

    <div class="overflow-x-auto text-[13px] font-mono leading-relaxed">
      <div v-if="activeLines.length === 0" class="p-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No changes</div>

      <template v-for="row in rows" :key="row.key">
        <!-- Collapsed gap: toggle button, or the revealed hidden lines -->
        <button
          v-if="row.kind === 'collapsed' && !expandedGaps.has(row.key)"
          type="button"
          @click="toggleGap(row.key)"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none"
        >
          <UiIcon name="chevron-down" :size="12" />
          <span class="font-mono">⋯ {{ row.count }} unchanged lines</span>
        </button>
        <template v-else-if="row.kind === 'collapsed'">
          <div
            v-for="(entry, i) in row.hidden"
            :key="`${row.key}-${i}`"
            class="flex text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400"
          >
            <span
              v-if="showLineNumbers"
              class="w-16 shrink-0 select-none px-2 text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 tabular-nums"
            >
              {{ entry.oldNo }} {{ entry.newNo }}
            </span>
            <span class="w-5 shrink-0 select-none text-center text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">&nbsp;</span>
            <span class="flex-1 min-w-0 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words pr-3">{{ entry.line.content }}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            @click="toggleGap(row.key)"
            class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none"
          >
            <UiIcon name="minus" :size="12" />
            <span class="font-mono">Collapse unchanged lines</span>
          </button>
        </template>

        <!-- Regular diff line -->
        <div v-else class="flex" :class="row.meta.row">
          <span
            v-if="showLineNumbers"
            class="w-16 shrink-0 select-none px-2 text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 tabular-nums"
          >
            {{ row.oldNo }} {{ row.newNo }}
          </span>
          <span class="w-5 shrink-0 select-none text-center" :class="row.meta.gutter">{{ row.meta.sign }}</span>
          <span class="flex-1 min-w-0 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words pr-3">{{ row.line.content }}</span>
        </div>
      </template>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface DiffLine {
  type: "add" | "remove" | "context";
  content: string;
}

export interface DiffFile {
  filename: string;
  language?: string;
  lines: DiffLine[];
}

const LINE_STYLE: Record<string, { row: string; gutter: string; sign: string }> = {
  add: { row: "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300", gutter: "text-emerald-500", sign: "+" },
  remove: { row: "bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300", gutter: "text-rose-500", sign: "-" },
  context: { row: "text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400", gutter: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600", sign: " " },
};

interface HiddenLine {
  line: DiffLine;
  oldNo: number;
  newNo: number;
}

interface RenderRow {
  kind: "line" | "collapsed";
  line?: DiffLine;
  meta?: { row: string; gutter: string; sign: string };
  oldNo?: number | "";
  newNo?: number | "";
  count?: number;
  hidden?: HiddenLine[];
  key: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** Legacy single-diff API (kept for backward compatibility). */
    lines?: DiffLine[];
    filename?: string;
    language?: string;
    /** Multi-file API: renders a tab bar when 1+ files are provided. */
    files?: DiffFile[];
    /** Context lines kept visible around each collapsed gap (default 3). */
    contextSize?: number;
    showLineNumbers?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { lines: () => [], files: () => [], contextSize: 3, showLineNumbers: true, className: "" }
);

const activeIdx = ref(0);
const expandedGaps = ref(new Set<string>());

watch(
  () => props.files,
  () => {
    activeIdx.value = 0;
    expandedGaps.value = new Set();
  }
);

const activeFile = computed(() => (props.files.length ? props.files[Math.min(activeIdx.value, props.files.length - 1)] : null));
const activeLines = computed(() => (activeFile.value ? activeFile.value.lines : props.lines));
const activeFilename = computed(() => (activeFile.value ? activeFile.value.filename : props.filename));
const activeLanguage = computed(() => (activeFile.value ? activeFile.value.language : props.language));

const countType = (lines: DiffLine[], type: DiffLine["type"]) => lines.filter((l) => l.type === type).length;

const added = computed(() => countType(activeLines.value, "add"));
const removed = computed(() => countType(activeLines.value, "remove"));

const toggleGap = (key: string) => {
  const next = new Set(expandedGaps.value);
  if (next.has(key)) next.delete(key);
  else next.add(key);
  expandedGaps.value = next;
};

/**
 * Walks the diff once and produces render rows. Long runs of context lines
 * (> contextSize*2) become a collapsible gap that keeps `contextSize` lines
 * visible on each side; the hidden middle travels with the row so expanding
 * needs no second pass over the source.
 */
const buildRows = (lines: DiffLine[], contextSize: number): RenderRow[] => {
  const rows: RenderRow[] = [];
  let oldNo = 0;
  let newNo = 0;
  let contextRun: HiddenLine[] = [];

  const pushLine = (entry: HiddenLine) => {
    rows.push({ kind: "line", line: entry.line, meta: LINE_STYLE.context, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` });
  };

  const flushContext = (isTail: boolean) => {
    if (contextRun.length <= contextSize * 2) {
      contextRun.forEach(pushLine);
    } else {
      const hidden = isTail
        ? contextRun.slice(contextSize)
        : contextRun.slice(contextSize, contextRun.length - contextSize);
      contextRun.slice(0, contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
      rows.push({ kind: "collapsed", count: hidden.length, hidden, key: `gap-${rows.length}-${hidden.length}` });
      if (!isTail) contextRun.slice(contextRun.length - contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
    }
    contextRun = [];
  };

  lines.forEach((line) => {
    if (line.type !== "add") oldNo += 1;
    if (line.type !== "remove") newNo += 1;

    if (line.type === "context") {
      contextRun.push({ line, oldNo, newNo });
      return;
    }
    flushContext(false);
    rows.push({
      kind: "line",
      line,
      meta: LINE_STYLE[line.type] || LINE_STYLE.context,
      oldNo: line.type !== "add" ? oldNo : "",
      newNo: line.type !== "remove" ? newNo : "",
      key: `c-${rows.length}`,
    });
  });

  flushContext(true);
  return rows;
};

const rows = computed(() => buildRows(activeLines.value, props.contextSize));
</script>

====/File: vue/FileAttachmentList.vue/====

<template>
  <div v-if="files.length > 0" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2" :class="className">
    <div
      v-for="f in files"
      :key="f.id"
      class="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 pr-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
    >
      <UiIcon :name="iconForType(f.type, f.name)" :size="14" class="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
      <span class="max-w-40 truncate font-medium">{{ f.name }}</span>
      <span v-if="formatFileSize(f.size)" class="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 shrink-0">{{ formatFileSize(f.size) }}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        :aria-label="`Remove ${f.name}`"
        class="p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-colors shrink-0"
        @click="emit('remove', f.id)"
      >
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="12" />
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface AttachmentItem {
  id: string | number;
  name: string;
  size?: number;
  type?: string;
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    files?: AttachmentItem[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { files: () => [], className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "remove", id: string | number): void;
}>();

function formatFileSize(bytes?: number): string {
  if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null || Number.isNaN(bytes)) return "";
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

function iconForType(type?: string, name?: string): string {
  if (type?.startsWith("image/")) return "image";
  const ext = name?.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
  if (["js", "ts", "tsx", "jsx", "py", "java", "go", "rs", "vue", "html", "css", "json", "sh"].includes(ext)) return "code";
  return "paperclip";
}
</script>

====/File: vue/FileDropzone.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="className">
    <div
      role="button"
      :tabindex="disabled ? -1 : 0"
      :aria-label="hint || 'Drop files here or browse'"
      :aria-disabled="disabled || undefined"
      :class="[
        'flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-7 text-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
        dragging
          ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30'
          : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600',
        disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : '',
      ]"
      @click="openPicker"
      @keydown.enter.prevent="openPicker"
      @keydown.space.prevent="openPicker"
      @dragover.prevent="!disabled && (dragging = true)"
      @dragleave="dragging = false"
      @drop.prevent="onDrop"
    >
      <span class="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <UiIcon name="upload" :size="16" />
      </span>
      <p class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
        Drag & drop {{ multiple ? 'files' : 'a file' }} here, or
        <span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">browse</span>
      </p>
      <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{{ hintText }}</p>
      <input
        ref="inputRef"
        type="file"
        hidden
        :accept="accept"
        :multiple="multiple"
        :disabled="disabled"
        @change="onChange"
      />
    </div>

    <p v-if="error" role="alert" class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">
      <UiIcon name="alert-triangle" :size="12" />
      {{ error }}
    </p>

    <ul v-if="files.length" class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
      <li
        v-for="(file, index) in files"
        :key="file.id ?? `${file.name}-${index}`"
        class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1.5"
      >
        <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
          <UiIcon :name="fileIcon(file)" :size="14" />
        </span>
        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ file.name }}</span>
          <span class="block text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">{{ formatBytes(file.size) }}</span>
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          :aria-label="`Remove ${file.name}`"
          class="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          @click.stop="emit('remove', file, index)"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" :size="12" />
        </button>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface DropzoneFile {
  id?: string | number;
  name: string;
  size: number;
  type?: string;
}

export interface RejectedFile {
  name: string;
  reason: 'type' | 'size';
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    files?: DropzoneFile[];
    accept?: string;
    multiple?: boolean;
    maxSizeMb?: number;
    hint?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { files: () => [], multiple: true, disabled: false, className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'files', files: File[]): void;
  (e: 'reject', rejected: RejectedFile[]): void;
  (e: 'remove', file: DropzoneFile, index: number): void;
}>();

const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
const dragging = ref(false);
const error = ref<string | null>(null);

const hintText = computed(() => {
  const parts = [props.accept ? `Accepts ${props.accept}` : null, props.maxSizeMb ? `up to ${props.maxSizeMb} MB` : null];
  return props.hint || parts.filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'Any file type';
});

const formatBytes = (bytes: number) => {
  if (!bytes) return '0 B';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const exp = Math.min(units.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)));
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exp;
  return `${value >= 10 || exp === 0 ? Math.round(value) : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[exp]}`;
};

const matchesAccept = (file: { name: string; type?: string }) => {
  if (!props.accept) return true;
  return props.accept
    .split(',')
    .map((token) => token.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .some((token) => {
      if (token.startsWith('.')) return file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(token);
      if (token.endsWith('/*')) return Boolean(file.type && file.type.toLowerCase().startsWith(token.slice(0, -1)));
      return file.type?.toLowerCase() === token;
    });
};

const fileIcon = (file: DropzoneFile) => {
  if (file.type?.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';
  if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|rs|json|css|html)$/i.test(file.name)) return 'code';
  return 'paperclip';
};

function handleFiles(incoming: FileList | File[] | null) {
  const list = Array.from(incoming || []);
  if (!list.length) return;

  const rejected: RejectedFile[] = [];
  const accepted = list.filter((file) => {
    if (!matchesAccept(file)) {
      rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'type' });
      return false;
    }
    if (props.maxSizeMb && file.size > props.maxSizeMb * 1024 * 1024) {
      rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'size' });
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  if (rejected.length) {
    const first = rejected[0];
    error.value =
      first.reason === 'size' ? `${first.name} is larger than ${props.maxSizeMb} MB` : `${first.name} is not an accepted file type`;
    emit('reject', rejected);
  } else {
    error.value = null;
  }

  if (accepted.length) emit('files', props.multiple ? accepted : accepted.slice(0, 1));
}

const openPicker = () => {
  if (!props.disabled) inputRef.value?.click();
};

function onDrop(event: DragEvent) {
  dragging.value = false;
  if (props.disabled) return;
  handleFiles(event.dataTransfer?.files ?? null);
}

function onChange(event: Event) {
  const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
  handleFiles(input.files);
  input.value = '';
}
</script>

====/File: vue/FilterBar.vue/====

<template>
  <div ref="rootRef" :class="['flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5', $attrs.class]">
    <div v-for="filter in filters" :key="filter.id" class="relative">
      <button type="button" :aria-expanded="openId === filter.id" aria-haspopup="true"
        @click="openId = openId === filter.id ? null : filter.id"
        :class="['inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
          (localSelected[filter.id] || []).length > 0
            ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300'
            : 'border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600']">
        <span>{{ filter.label }}</span>
        <span v-if="(localSelected[filter.id] || []).length > 0"
          class="rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-1 text-[9px] tabular-nums text-white">{{ (localSelected[filter.id] || []).length }}</span>
        <UiIcon name="chevron-down" :size="11" :class="openId === filter.id ? 'rotate-180 transition-transform' : 'transition-transform'" />
      </button>

      <div v-if="openId === filter.id"
        class="absolute left-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 w-48 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <button v-for="option in filter.options" :key="option.value" type="button"
          :aria-pressed="(localSelected[filter.id] || []).includes(option.value)"
          @click="toggleOption(filter.id, option.value)"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
          <span
            :class="['flex h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border',
              (localSelected[filter.id] || []).includes(option.value)
                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                : 'border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600']">
            <UiIcon v-if="(localSelected[filter.id] || []).includes(option.value)" name="check" :size="9" :stroke-width="3" />
          </span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{{ option.label }}</span>
          <span v-if="option.count !== undefined" class="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ option.count }}</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <button v-if="activeCount > 0" type="button" @click="clearAll"
      class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">
      <UiIcon name="x" :size="11" />
      Clear all
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface FilterOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

export interface FilterDefinition {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  options: FilterOption[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    filters: FilterDefinition[];
    selected?: Record<string, string[]>;
  }>(),
  { selected: () => ({}) }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', selected: Record<string, string[]>): void; (e: 'clear'): void }>();

const rootRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
const openId = ref<string | null>(null);
const localSelected = ref<Record<string, string[]>>({ ...props.selected });

watch(
  () => props.selected,
  (value) => {
    localSelected.value = { ...(value ?? {}) };
  },
  { deep: true }
);

const activeCount = computed(() =>
  Object.values(localSelected.value).reduce((total, values) => total + values.length, 0)
);

const commit = (next: Record<string, string[]>) => {
  localSelected.value = next;
  emit('change', next);
};

const toggleOption = (filterId: string, value: string) => {
  const values = localSelected.value[filterId] ?? [];
  const nextValues = values.includes(value) ? values.filter((entry) => entry !== value) : [...values, value];
  const next = { ...localSelected.value };
  if (nextValues.length > 0) next[filterId] = nextValues;
  else delete next[filterId];
  commit(next);
};

const clearAll = () => {
  commit({});
  emit('clear');
};

const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  if (rootRef.value && !rootRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) openId.value = null;
};
const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'Escape') openId.value = null;
};

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
});
</script>

        <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';

/**
 * HomepageDashboard — Vue 3 (SFC)
 * A copy-paste, zero-blackbox single-file homelab dashboard with the iconic
 * gethomepage/homepage look: header (title + live clock + search) + responsive
 * grouped service cards with status dots/pills + version footer.
 *
 * ORIGINAL implementation of the visual design language of
 * https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage (GPL-3.0). No GPL source copied.
 */
export type HomepageStatus = 'online' | 'up' | 'down' | 'offline' | 'warn' | 'error' | 'unknown';

export interface HomepageService {
  /** Optional stable key — used for v-for reconciliation; falls back to name+index */
  id?: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  /** Only http(s), mailto, protocol-relative, root-relative and dot-relative URLs are rendered as a link */
  href?: string;
  pingText?: string;
  status?: HomepageStatus;
}

export interface HomepageGroup {
  name: string;
  icon?: string;
  services: HomepageService[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title?: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    version?: string;
    groups?: HomepageGroup[];
    headerStyle?: 'underlined' | 'boxed' | 'clean';
    statusStyle?: 'pill' | 'dot' | 'none';
    showClock?: boolean;
    showSearch?: boolean;
    searchPlaceholder?: string;
    collapsible?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    title: 'Homepage',
    subtitle: 'A highly customizable homelab dashboard',
    version: 'Homepage · awesome-ui',
    groups: () => [],
    headerStyle: 'underlined',
    statusStyle: 'pill',
    showClock: true,
    showSearch: false,
    searchPlaceholder: 'Search services…',
    collapsible: true,
    className: '',
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ 'group-toggle': [group: string, collapsed: boolean] }>();

/* ---------- clock: starts/stops when showClock toggles, always cleaned up ---------- */
const now = ref(new Date());
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

const stopClock = () => {
  if (timer) {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = null;
  }
};
const startClock = () => {
  if (props.showClock && !timer) {
    timer = setInterval(() => (now.value = new Date()), 1000);
  }
};

watch(() => props.showClock, (v) => (v ? startClock() : stopClock()));
onMounted(startClock);
onBeforeUnmount(stopClock);

const time = computed(() => now.value.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
const date = computed(() =>
  now.value.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
);

/* ---------- search & collapse ---------- */
const query = ref('');

const trimmedQuery = computed(() => query.value.trim().toLowerCase());

const filteredGroups = computed<HomepageGroup[]>(() => {
  const q = trimmedQuery.value;
  if (!q) return props.groups;
  return props.groups
    .map((g) => ({
      ...g,
      services: (g.services || []).filter(
        (s) =>
          (s.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (s.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ),
    }))
    .filter((g) => g.services.length > 0);
});

const collapsed = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});

const emptyMessage = computed(() => {
  if (props.groups.length === 0) return 'No services configured yet.';
  if (trimmedQuery.value) return `No matching services for “${trimmedQuery.value}”.`;
  return 'No services configured yet.';
});

const toggleGroup = (name: string) => {
  if (!props.collapsible) return;
  collapsed.value = { ...collapsed.value, [name]: !collapsed.value[name] };
  emit('group-toggle', name, collapsed.value[name]);
};

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const effectiveStatusStyle = computed<'pill' | 'dot' | 'none'>(() =>
  ['pill', 'dot', 'none'].includes(props.statusStyle) ? props.statusStyle : 'pill'
);

/** Hide an icon <img> on load failure (parity: letter monogram space is kept by container) */
const onIconError = (e: Event) => {
  const el = e.target as HTMLImageElement;
  el.style.display = 'none';
};

const headerCls = computed(() =>
  props.headerStyle === 'boxed'
    ? 'm-3 sm:m-5 mb-0 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-white/5 shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 p-4'
    : props.headerStyle === 'clean'
      ? 'm-3 sm:m-5 mb-0'
      : 'm-3 sm:m-5 mb-1 border-b-2 border-zinc-300/70 dark:border-zinc-700 pb-4'
);

const statusConfig = (status: HomepageStatus = 'unknown') => {
  switch (status) {
    case 'online':
    case 'up':
      return { dot: 'bg-emerald-500', pill: 'text-emerald-500/90', label: 'UP' };
    case 'down':
    case 'offline':
      return { dot: 'bg-rose-500', pill: 'text-rose-500/90', label: 'DOWN' };
    case 'warn':
      return { dot: 'bg-amber-500', pill: 'text-amber-500', label: 'WARN' };
    case 'error':
      return { dot: 'bg-orange-500', pill: 'text-orange-500', label: 'ERROR' };
    default:
      return { dot: 'bg-zinc-400/60 dark:bg-zinc-500/60', pill: 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400', label: '—' };
  }
};

/** Only allow safe URL protocols into the anchor. Blocks javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file: … */
const isSafeHref = (href?: string): boolean => {
  if (typeof href !== 'string') return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith('//') || t.startsWith('/') || t.startsWith('./') || t.startsWith('../')) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

const serviceHref = (service: HomepageService) => (isSafeHref(service.href) ? service.href : undefined);

const isImageIcon = (icon?: string) => !!icon && /^(https?:|data:|\.|\/)/i.test(icon);

const monogram = (name?: string) => (name || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();

const statusLabel = (service: HomepageService) => service.pingText || statusConfig(service.status).label;
</script>

====/File: vue/KanbanBoard.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="className" class="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
    <section
      v-for="column in columns"
      :key="column.id"
      :aria-label="column.title"
      :class="[
        'flex w-64 shrink-0 flex-col rounded-xl border p-2 transition-colors dark:bg-zinc-900/40',
        overColumn === column.id
          ? 'border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/20'
          : 'border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800',
      ]"
      @dragover.prevent="overColumn = column.id"
      @dragleave="overColumn = overColumn === column.id ? null : overColumn"
      @drop.prevent="drop(column.id)"
    >
      <header class="mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1">
        <span :class="['h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', column.accent || 'bg-zinc-400']" aria-hidden="true" />
        <h3 class="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          {{ column.title }}
        </h3>
        <span
          class="ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-200/70 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400"
        >
          {{ column.limit ? `${cardsIn(column.id).length}/${column.limit}` : cardsIn(column.id).length }}
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          :aria-label="`Add card to ${column.title}`"
          class="shrink-0 rounded-md p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          @click="emit('add-card', column.id)"
        >
          <UiIcon name="plus" :size="12" />
        </button>
      </header>

      <div class="flex min-h-[3rem] flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
        <p
          v-if="cardsIn(column.id).length === 0"
          class="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-2 py-4 text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700"
        >
          Drop cards here
        </p>
        <div
          v-for="card in cardsIn(column.id)"
          :key="card.id"
          role="button"
          tabindex="0"
          draggable="true"
          :class="[
            'cursor-grab rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-2.5 text-left shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-zinc-300 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 active:cursor-grabbing dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600',
            draggingId === card.id ? 'opacity-40' : '',
          ]"
          @dragstart="startDrag($event, card.id)"
          @dragend="resetDrag"
          @click="emit('card-click', card)"
          @keydown="onKeydown($event, card)"
        >
          <div class="flex items-start gap-1.5">
            <p class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[11px] font-medium leading-snug text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {{ card.title }}
            </p>
            <span
              v-if="card.priority"
              :class="['shrink-0 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium', PRIORITY_META[card.priority].cls]"
            >
              {{ PRIORITY_META[card.priority].label }}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p v-if="card.description" class="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {{ card.description }}
          </p>
          <div v-if="card.tags?.length || card.assignee" class="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
            <span
              v-for="tag in (card.tags || []).slice(0, 2)"
              :key="tag"
              class="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400"
            >
              {{ tag }}
            </span>
            <span
              v-if="card.assignee"
              :title="card.assignee"
              class="ml-auto flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[8px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
            >
              {{ initials(card.assignee) }}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface KanbanColumn {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  accent?: string;
  limit?: number;
}

export interface KanbanCard {
  id: string;
  columnId: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  assignee?: string;
  priority?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
}

const PRIORITY_META: Record<NonNullable<KanbanCard['priority']>, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  low: { label: 'Low', cls: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400' },
  medium: { label: 'Medium', cls: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400' },
  high: { label: 'High', cls: 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400' },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    columns?: KanbanColumn[];
    cards?: KanbanCard[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { columns: () => [], cards: () => [], className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'move-card', cardId: string, toColumnId: string): void;
  (e: 'card-click', card: KanbanCard): void;
  (e: 'add-card', columnId: string): void;
}>();

const draggingId = ref<string | null>(null);
const overColumn = ref<string | null>(null);

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

const cardsIn = (columnId: string) => props.cards.filter((card) => card.columnId === columnId);

function move(cardId: string, toColumnId: string) {
  const card = props.cards.find((entry) => entry.id === cardId);
  if (!card || card.columnId === toColumnId) return;
  emit('move-card', cardId, toColumnId);
}

function startDrag(event: DragEvent, cardId: string) {
  event.dataTransfer?.setData('text/plain', cardId);
  if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
  draggingId.value = cardId;
}

function resetDrag() {
  draggingId.value = null;
  overColumn.value = null;
}

function drop(columnId: string) {
  const cardId = draggingId.value;
  if (cardId) move(cardId, columnId);
  resetDrag();
}

function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent, card: KanbanCard) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
    event.preventDefault();
    emit('card-click', card);
    return;
  }
  if (event.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
  const index = props.columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === card.columnId);
  const next = props.columns[index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1)];
  if (!next) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  move(card.id, next.id);
}
</script>

====/File: vue/MessageActionToolbar.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="['flex items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 text-xs mt-1.5 select-none', className]">
    <!-- Branch Navigator -->
    <div
      v-if="totalBranches && totalBranches > 1 && branchIndex !== undefined"
      class="flex items-center gap-0.5 mr-2 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400"
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        :disabled="branchIndex <= 0"
        @click="$emit('branchChange', branchIndex - 1)"
        class="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5"
        title="Previous version"
      >
        <UiIcon name="chevron-left" :size="14" />
      </button>
      <span>{{ branchIndex + 1 }}/{{ totalBranches }}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        :disabled="branchIndex >= totalBranches - 1"
        @click="$emit('branchChange', branchIndex + 1)"
        class="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5"
        title="Next version"
      >
        <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="14" />
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Copy -->
    <button
      type="button"
      @click="handleCopy"
      class="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors"
      title="Copy response"
    >
      <UiIcon v-if="copied" name="check" :size="16" class="text-emerald-500" />
      <UiIcon v-else name="copy" :size="16" />
    </button>

    <!-- Retry / Regenerate -->
    <button
      v-if="showRetry"
      type="button"
      @click="$emit('retry')"
      class="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors"
      title="Regenerate response"
    >
      <UiIcon name="refresh" :size="16" />
    </button>

    <!-- Thumbs Up / Down -->
    <template v-if="role === 'assistant'">
      <button
        type="button"
        @click="handleThumb('up')"
        :class="[
          'p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors',
          feedback === 'up' ? 'text-blue-500' : 'hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
        ]"
        title="Good response"
      >
        <UiIcon name="thumbs-up" :size="16" />
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        @click="handleThumb('down')"
        :class="[
          'p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors',
          feedback === 'down' ? 'text-rose-500' : 'hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
        ]"
        title="Bad response"
      >
        <UiIcon name="thumbs-down" :size="16" />
      </button>
    </template>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    content: string;
    role?: 'assistant' | 'user' | string;
    showRetry?: boolean;
    branchIndex?: number;
    totalBranches?: number;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    role: 'assistant',
    showRetry: true,
    className: ''
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'retry'): void;
  (e: 'feedback', type: 'up' | 'down'): void;
  (e: 'branchChange', index: number): void;
}>();

const copied = ref(false);
const feedback = ref<'up' | 'down' | null>(null);

const handleCopy = async () => {
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.content);
  copied.value = true;
  setTimeout(() => (copied.value = false), 2000);
};

const handleThumb = (type: 'up' | 'down') => {
  const next = feedback.value === type ? null : type;
  feedback.value = next;
  if (next) emit('feedback', next);
};
</script>

              </span>
            </div>
            <p v-if="model.description" class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">
              {{ model.description }}
            </p>
          </div>

          <UiIcon
            v-if="model.id === selectedId"
            name="check"
            :size="14"
            class="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5"
          />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ModelOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  provider?: string;
  description?: string;
  contextLength?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  isDefault?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    models?: ModelOption[];
    selectedId: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    showSearch?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    models: () => [],
    placeholder: "Select model...",
    showSearch: true,
    disabled: false,
    className: "",
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "select", model: ModelOption): void;
  (e: "update:selectedId", id: string): void;
}>();

const isOpen = ref(false);
const searchQuery = ref("");
const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);

const selectedModel = computed(
  () => props.models.find((m) => m.id === props.selectedId) || null
);

const filteredModels = computed(() => {
  if (!searchQuery.value.trim()) return props.models;
  const q = searchQuery.value.toLowerCase();
  return props.models.filter(
    (m) =>
      m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (m.provider && m.provider.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
      (m.description && m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
      (m.tags && m.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
  );
});

function handleSelect(model: ModelOption) {
  emit("select", model);
  emit("update:selectedId", model.id);
  isOpen.value = false;
  searchQuery.value = "";
}

function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (containerRef.value && !containerRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) {
    isOpen.value = false;
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
  document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
});
</script>

<template>
  <div
    v-if="isOpen"
    :class="className"
    class="w-full max-w-sm overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg"
    role="region"
    :aria-label="title"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-2.5">
      <UiIcon name="bell" :size="14" class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
      <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ title }}</h3>
      <span
        v-if="unreadIds.length"
        class="rounded-full bg-indigo-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400"
      >
        {{ unreadIds.length }} new
      </span>
      <button
        type="button"
        :disabled="unreadIds.length === 0"
        class="ml-auto text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:disabled:text-zinc-600"
        @click="emit('mark-all-read')"
      >
        Mark all read
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Close notifications"
        class="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        @click="emit('close')"
      >
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="12" />
      </button>
    </div>

    <div v-if="showFilter" class="flex gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-1.5">
      <button
        v-for="key in (['all', 'unread'] as const)"
        :key="key"
        type="button"
        :aria-pressed="filter === key"
        :class="[
          'rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium capitalize transition-colors',
          filter === key
            ? 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'
            : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200',
        ]"
        @click="filter = key"
      >
        {{ key }}
        <span class="ml-1 tabular-nums text-zinc-400">{{ key === 'all' ? notifications.length : unreadIds.length }}</span>
      </button>
    </div>

    <div class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
      <div v-if="visible.length === 0" class="px-3 py-8 text-center">
        <UiIcon name="check-circle" :size="20" class="mx-auto mb-1.5 text-emerald-500" />
        <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{{ emptyText }}</p>
      </div>
      <ul v-else class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        <li v-for="item in visible" :key="item.id">
          <button
            type="button"
            class="flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50"
            @click="select(item)"
          >
            <span :class="['mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full', TYPE_META[item.type || 'info'].chip]">
              <UiIcon :name="item.icon || TYPE_META[item.type || 'info'].icon" :size="13" />
            </span>
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span class="truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ item.title }}</span>
                <span v-if="item.unread" class="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" aria-label="Unread" />
              </span>
              <span v-if="item.description" class="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 block text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {{ item.description }}
              </span>
              <span v-if="item.time" class="mt-0.5 block text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ item.time }}</span>
            </span>
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

type NotificationType = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

export interface NotificationItem {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  time?: string;
  icon?: string;
  unread?: boolean;
  type?: NotificationType;
}

const TYPE_META: Record<NotificationType, { chip: string; icon: string }> = {
  info: { chip: 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400', icon: 'info' },
  success: { chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', icon: 'check-circle' },
  warning: { chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', icon: 'alert-triangle' },
  error: { chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', icon: 'circle-x' },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    notifications?: NotificationItem[];
    title?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
    showFilter?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    notifications: () => [],
    title: 'Notifications',
    emptyText: "You're all caught up",
    showFilter: true,
    className: '',
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', notification: NotificationItem): void;
  (e: 'mark-read', ids: Array<string | number>): void;
  (e: 'mark-all-read'): void;
  (e: 'close'): void;
}>();

const filter = ref<'all' | 'unread'>('all');

const unreadIds = computed(() => props.notifications.filter((item) => item.unread).map((item) => item.id));
const visible = computed(() => (filter.value === 'unread' ? props.notifications.filter((item) => item.unread) : props.notifications));

watch(
  () => props.isOpen,
  (open) => {
    if (open) filter.value = 'all';
  }
);

function select(item: NotificationItem) {
  if (item.unread) emit('mark-read', [item.id]);
  emit('select', item);
}
</script>

              ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white'

          @click="emit('toggle', task)">
          <UiIcon name="check" :size="10" />
        </button>

        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div :class="['text-xs', task.done ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 line-through' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200']">
            {{ task.title }}
          </div>
          <div v-if="task.description" class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {{ task.description }}
          </div>
        </div>

        <button v-if="!task.done && task.actionText" type="button"
          class="shrink-0 rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
          @click="emit('action', task)">
          {{ task.actionText }}
        </button>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface OnboardingTask {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  done: boolean;
  actionText?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  tasks: OnboardingTask[];
  title?: string;
}>(), { title: 'Get started' });

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'toggle', task: OnboardingTask): void;
  (e: 'action', task: OnboardingTask): void;
}>();

const total = computed(() => props.tasks.length);
const doneCount = computed(() => props.tasks.filter((task) => task.done).length);
const percent = computed(() => (total.value === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((doneCount.value / total.value) * 100)));
const allDone = computed(() => total.value > 0 && doneCount.value === total.value);
</script>

====/File: vue/Pagination.vue/====

<template>
  <nav :aria-label="ariaLabel" :class="['flex items-center gap-1', $attrs.class]">
    <button v-if="showEdges" type="button" aria-label="First page" :disabled="page <= 1" :class="[BASE, EDGE_CLASS]"
      @click="go(1)">
      <UiIcon name="chevron-left" :size="13" />
    </button>
    <button type="button" aria-label="Previous page" :disabled="page <= 1" :class="[BASE, EDGE_CLASS]"
      @click="go(page - 1)">
      <UiIcon name="chevron-left" :size="13" />
    </button>
    <template v-for="(slot, index) in slots" :key="slot === 'gap' ? `gap-${index}` : slot">
      <span v-if="slot === 'gap'" aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">…</span>
      <button v-else type="button" :aria-label="`Page ${slot}`" :aria-current="slot === page ? 'page' : undefined"
        :class="[BASE, 'tabular-nums', slot === page ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : PAGE_CLASS]" @click="go(slot)">
        {{ slot }}
      </button>
    </template>
    <button type="button" aria-label="Next page" :disabled="page >= pageCount" :class="[BASE, EDGE_CLASS]"
      @click="go(page + 1)">
      <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="13" />
    </button>
    <button v-if="showEdges" type="button" aria-label="Last page" :disabled="page >= pageCount"
      :class="[BASE, EDGE_CLASS]" @click="go(pageCount)">
      <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="13" />
    </button>
  </nav>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type PaginationSlot = number | 'gap';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    page: number;
    pageCount: number;
    siblingCount?: number;
    showEdges?: boolean;
    ariaLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { siblingCount: 1, showEdges: true, ariaLabel: 'Pagination' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', page: number): void }>();

const BASE =
  'inline-flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40';
const EDGE_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';
const PAGE_CLASS = EDGE_CLASS;

const slots = computed<PaginationSlot[]>(() => {
  const { page, pageCount, siblingCount } = props;
  if (pageCount <= 0) return [];
  const seen = new Set<number>([1, pageCount, page]);
  for (let offset = 1; offset <= siblingCount; offset += 1) {
    seen.add(page - offset);
    seen.add(page + offset);
  }
  const sorted = Array.from(seen)
    .filter((entry) => entry >= 1 && entry <= pageCount)
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const result: PaginationSlot[] = [];
  let previous = 0;
  for (const entry of sorted) {
    if (previous > 0 && entry - previous > 1) result.push('gap');
    result.push(entry);
    previous = entry;
  }
  return result;
});

const go = (next: number) => {
  if (next < 1 || next > props.pageCount || next === props.page) return;
  emit('change', next);
};
</script>

      <span v-if="plan.highlighted" class="absolute -top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-white">{{ plan.badge || 'Most popular' }}</span>
      <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ plan.name }}</div>

<template>

        <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
            <span v-for="tag in (prompt.tags || []).slice(0, 3)" :key="tag" class="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ tag }}</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" @click="$emit('use', prompt)"
            class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
            Use
            <UiIcon name="arrow-right" :size="10" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface PromptItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  prompt: string;
  category?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  favorite?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    prompts?: PromptItem[];
    categories?: string[];
    searchable?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { prompts: () => [], categories: () => [], searchable: true }
);
defineEmits<{ (e: 'use', prompt: PromptItem): void; (e: 'toggle-favorite', prompt: PromptItem): void }>();

const query = ref('');
const activeCategory = ref('all');

const categoryOptions = computed(() => {
  const seen = new Set<string>(props.categories);
  for (const prompt of props.prompts) if (prompt.category) seen.add(prompt.category);
  return ['all', ...Array.from(seen)];
});

const visible = computed(() => {
  const needle = query.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  return props.prompts.filter((prompt) => {
    const inCategory = activeCategory.value === 'all' || prompt.category === activeCategory.value;
    if (!inCategory) return false;
    if (!needle) return true;
    return [prompt.title, prompt.description, prompt.prompt, ...(prompt.tags || [])]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ')
      .toLowerCase()
      .includes(needle);
  });
});
</script>
