====/File: vue/SchedulerSlots.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="className" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <header class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <span
        class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400"
      >
        <UiIcon name="calendar" :size="14" />
      </span>
      <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ humanDate(date) }}</h3>
        <p v-if="timezone" class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">All times in {{ timezone }}</p>
      </div>
      <span
        class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400"
      >
        {{ openCount }} open
      </span>
    </header>

    <p v-if="groups.length === 0" class="py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
      No slots available for this day.
    </p>

    <div v-else class="mt-2 space-y-3">
      <fieldset v-for="group in groups" :key="group.period.key">
        <legend class="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{{ group.period.label }}</legend>
        <div class="mt-1 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
          <button
            v-for="slot in group.slots"
            :key="slot.id"
            type="button"
            :disabled="slot.available === false"
            :aria-pressed="slot.id === selectedId"
            :class="[
              'flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
              slot.id === selectedId
                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 font-medium text-white'
                : slot.available === false
                  ? 'cursor-not-allowed border-zinc-100 text-zinc-300 line-through dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-600'
                  : 'border-zinc-200 text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:border-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/20',
            ]"
            @click="emit('select', slot)"
          >
            <span class="tabular-nums">{{ amPm(slot.time) }}</span>
            <UiIcon v-if="slot.id === selectedId" name="check" :size="11" />
            <UiIcon v-else-if="slot.available === false" name="lock" :size="11" />
          </button>
        </div>
        <p v-if="group.slots.some((slot) => slot.note)" class="mt-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
          {{ group.slots.filter((slot) => slot.note).map((slot) => slot.note).join(' · ') }}
        </p>
      </fieldset>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface SchedulerSlot {
  id: string;
  time: string;
  available?: boolean;
  note?: string;
}

const PERIODS = [
  { key: 'morning', label: 'Morning', range: [6, 12] },
  { key: 'afternoon', label: 'Afternoon', range: [12, 17] },
  { key: 'evening', label: 'Evening', range: [17, 24] },
] as const;

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    date: string;
    slots?: SchedulerSlot[];
    selectedId?: string;
    timezone?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { slots: () => [], selectedId: '', timezone: '', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'select', slot: SchedulerSlot): void }>();

const humanDate = (iso: string) => {
  const [year, month, day] = iso.split('-').map(Number);
  if (!year || !month || !day) return iso;
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
};

const hourOf = (time: string) => {
  const [hour] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  return Number.isFinite(hour) ? hour : -1;
};

const amPm = (time: string) => {
  const [hour, minute] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || !Number.isFinite(minute)) return time;
  const suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const display = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
  return `${display}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')} ${suffix}`;
};

const groups = computed(() =>
  PERIODS.map((period) => ({
    period,
    slots: props.slots.filter((slot) => {
      const hour = hourOf(slot.time);
      return hour >= period.range[0] && hour < period.range[1];
    }),
  })).filter((group) => group.slots.length > 0)
);

const openCount = computed(() => props.slots.filter((slot) => slot.available !== false).length);
</script>

====/File: vue/SettingsPanel.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class" class="md:flex md:gap-6">
    <nav class="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-2 md:w-44 md:shrink-0 md:flex-col md:overflow-visible md:pb-0">
      <button v-for="item in sections" :key="item.id" type="button" :aria-current="item.id === currentSection?.id ? 'page' : undefined"
        :class="['flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
          item.id === currentSection?.id
            ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
            : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200']"
        @click="select(item.id)">
        <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="14" class="shrink-0" />
        <span class="whitespace-nowrap">{{ item.title }}</span>
      </button>
    </nav>

    <div v-if="currentSection"
      class="mt-3 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 md:mt-0">
      <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
        <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ currentSection.title }}</div>
        <div v-if="currentSection.description" class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {{ currentSection.description }}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        <div v-for="item in currentSection.items" :key="item.id" class="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3">
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <div class="text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ item.label }}</div>
            <div v-if="item.description" class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              {{ item.description }}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
            <span v-if="item.value" class="max-w-[12rem] truncate text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              {{ item.value }}
            </span>
            <button v-if="item.actionText" type="button"
              class="rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
              @click="emit('item-action', currentSection.id, item)">
              {{ item.actionText }}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div v-if="showSave" class="flex justify-end border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
        <button type="button" :disabled="saving"
          class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
          @click="emit('save', currentSection.id)">
          <UiIcon v-if="saving" name="loader" :size="12" class="animate-spin" />
          {{ saveText }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

type IconName = 'user' | 'users' | 'credit-card' | 'bell' | 'settings' | 'zap' | 'lock' | 'sliders' | 'globe';

export interface SettingsItem { id: string; label: string; description?: string; value?: string; actionText?: string }
export interface SettingsSection { id: string; title: string; icon?: IconName; description?: string; items: SettingsItem[] }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  sections: SettingsSection[];
  activeId?: string;
  saving?: boolean;
  saveText?: string;
  showSave?: boolean;
}>(), { saving: false, saveText: 'Save changes', showSave: true });

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'section-change', id: string): void;
  (e: 'item-action', sectionId: string, item: SettingsItem): void;
  (e: 'save', id: string): void;
}>();

const currentId = ref(props.activeId || props.sections[0]?.id || '');
const currentSection = computed(() => props.sections.find((item) => item.id === currentId.value) || props.sections[0]);

const select = (id: string) => {
  currentId.value = id;
  emit('section-change', id);
};
</script>

      </div>

      <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/30 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1">
          <kbd class="inline-flex min-w-[1.4rem] items-center justify-center rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">esc</kbd>
          <span>Close</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch, nextTick, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ShortcutItem {
  keys: string[];
  label: string;
  group?: string;
}

export interface ShortcutGroup {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  items: ShortcutItem[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    groups?: ShortcutGroup[];
    shortcuts?: ShortcutItem[];
    title?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    groups: () => [],
    shortcuts: () => [],
    title: "Keyboard shortcuts",
    placeholder: "Search shortcuts...",
    className: "",
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: "close"): void }>();

const query = ref("");
const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

// Flat list → buckets by item.group (or "General").
const normalized = computed<ShortcutGroup[]>(() => {
  if (props.groups.length > 0) return props.groups;
  const buckets: ShortcutGroup[] = [];
  props.shortcuts.forEach((item) => {
    const label = item.group || "General";
    const bucket = buckets.find((g) => g.label === label);
    if (bucket) bucket.items.push(item);
    else buckets.push({ id: label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-"), label, items: [item] });
  });
  return buckets;
});

const filtered = computed<ShortcutGroup[]>(() => {
  const q = query.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return normalized.value;
  return normalized.value
    .map((group) => ({
      ...group,
      items: group.items.filter(
        (item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.keys.join("").toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ),
    }))
    .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
});

const total = computed(() => normalized.value.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.items.length, 0));

watch(
  () => props.isOpen,
  async (open) => {
    query.value = "";
    if (open) {
      await nextTick();
      inputRef.value?.focus();
    }
  }
);

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!props.isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    emit("close");
  }
}

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey));
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey));
</script>

    title: string;
    description?: string;

    size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

          {{ item.snippet }}

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface SourceItem {

  title: string;
  url: string;
  snippet?: string;
  siteName?: string;
  favicon?: string;

  defineProps<{
    sources: SourceItem[];
    className?: string;

const getDomain = (url: string, siteName?: string) => {

====/File: vue/StatCard.vue/====

<template>
  <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4" :class="$attrs.class">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
      <span class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ label }}</span>
      <span v-if="icon" class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"><UiIcon :name="icon" :size="16" /></span>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
      <div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ value }}</div>
        <div v-if="typeof delta === 'number'" class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
          <UiIcon :name="positive ? 'trending-up' : 'trending-down'" :size="13" :class="positive ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-500'" />
          <span :class="['text-[11px] font-medium', positive ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-500']">
            {{ positive ? '+' : '' }}{{ delta }}%
          </span>
          <span v-if="deltaLabel" class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ deltaLabel }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <svg v-if="trendPoints" viewBox="0 0 96 28" class="h-7 w-24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
        <polyline :points="trendPoints" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
          :class="positive ? 'stroke-emerald-500' : 'stroke-red-500'" />
      </svg>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

type IconName = 'trending-up' | 'trending-down' | 'zap' | 'cpu' | 'clock' | 'users' | 'credit-card' | 'sparkles' | 'check-circle';

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  delta?: number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  trend?: number[];
  icon?: IconName;
}>(), { trend: undefined, icon: undefined });

const positive = computed(() => (props.delta ?? 0) >= 0);

const trendPoints = computed(() => {
  const data = props.trend;
  if (!data || data.length < 2) return '';
  const width = 96;
  const height = 28;
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const span = max - min || 1;
  return data
    .map((value, index) => {
      const x = (index / (data.length - 1)) * width;
      const y = height - ((value - min) / span) * (height - 4) - 2;
      return `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`;
    })
    .join(' ');
});
</script>

====/File: vue/StatusIndicator.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    :class="[
      'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border text-xs font-medium',
      config.badgeBg,
      config.text,
      className
    ]"
  >
    <span v-if="showDot" class="relative flex h-2 w-2">
      <span
        v-if="status === 'online'"
        :class="['animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75', config.pingBg]"
      ></span>
      <span :class="['relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2', config.dotBg]"></span>
    </span>
    <span class="font-semibold">{{ label || config.defaultLabel }}</span>
    <span v-if="pingMs !== undefined" class="font-mono text-[10px] opacity-75 ml-0.5">
      ({{ pingMs }}ms)
    </span>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

export type StatusType = 'online' | 'offline' | 'busy' | 'connecting' | 'error';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    status: StatusType;
    label?: string;
    pingMs?: number;
    showDot?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    showDot: true,
    className: ''
  }
);

const config = computed(() => {
  switch (props.status) {
    case 'online':
      return {
        dotBg: 'bg-emerald-500',
        pingBg: 'bg-emerald-400',
        text: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400',
        badgeBg: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-200/80 dark:border-emerald-800/60',
        defaultLabel: 'Online'
      };
    case 'connecting':
    case 'busy':
      return {
        dotBg: 'bg-amber-500',
        pingBg: 'bg-amber-400',
        text: 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400',
        badgeBg: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800/60',
        defaultLabel: props.status === 'busy' ? 'Busy' : 'Connecting'
      };
    case 'error':
    case 'offline':
    default:
      return {
        dotBg: 'bg-rose-500',
        pingBg: 'bg-rose-400',
        text: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400',
        badgeBg: 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800/60',
        defaultLabel: props.status === 'error' ? 'Error' : 'Offline'
      };
  }
});
</script>

====/File: vue/StreamMarkdown.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    ref="containerRef"
    @click="handleContainerClick"
    :class="['prose prose-zinc dark:prose-invert max-w-none text-sm leading-relaxed', className]"
  >
    <div v-html="htmlContent" class="inline-block w-full"></div>
    <span
      v-if="isStreaming"
      class="inline-block w-2 h-4 ml-1 -mb-0.5 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 animate-pulse rounded-sm"
    ></span>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { marked } from 'marked';
import Prism from 'prismjs';
import 'prismjs/themes/prism-tomorrow.css';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    content: string;
    isStreaming?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    isStreaming: false,
    className: ''
  }
);

const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);

const handleContainerClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
  const target = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.copy-btn');
  if (!target) return;
  const rawCode = target.getAttribute('data-code');
  if (rawCode) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(decodeURIComponent(rawCode));
    target.textContent = 'Copied';
    setTimeout(() => {
      target.textContent = 'Copy';
    }, 2000);
  }
};

const htmlContent = computed(() => {
  const renderer = new marked.Renderer();

  renderer.code = function ({ text, lang }: { text: string; lang?: string }) {
    const language = lang && Prism.languages[lang] ? lang : 'javascript';
    let highlighted = text;
    try {
      if (Prism.languages[language]) {
        highlighted = Prism.highlight(text, Prism.languages[language], language);
      }
    } catch {
      highlighted = text;
    }

    return `
      <div class="relative group my-4 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900/80 border-b border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">
          <span>${lang || 'code'}</span>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            data-code="${encodeURIComponent(text)}" 
            class="copy-btn hover:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
          >
            Copy
          </button>
        </div>
        <pre class="p-4 overflow-x-auto text-sm text-zinc-100 font-mono leading-normal m-0 bg-transparent"><code>${highlighted}</code></pre>
      </div>
    `;
  };

  return marked.parse(props.content || '', { renderer, breaks: true, gfm: true });
});
</script>

====/File: vue/StreamingProgressBar.vue/====

<template>
  <div class="w-full" :class="className">
    <div v-if="label || !indeterminate" class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
      <span class="truncate">{{ label }}</span>
      <span v-if="!indeterminate" class="tabular-nums shrink-0">{{ Math.round(clamped!) }}%</span>
    </div>
    <div
      role="progressbar"
      :aria-valuemin="0"
      :aria-valuemax="100"
      :aria-valuenow="indeterminate ? undefined : Math.round(clamped!)"
      :aria-label="label || 'Progress'"
      class="h-1 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden"
    >
      <div v-if="indeterminate" class="h-full w-1/3 rounded-full animate-pulse" :class="barColor" />
      <div v-else class="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300" :class="barColor" :style="{ width: `${clamped}%` }" />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: number | null;
    label?: string;
    status?: "streaming" | "done" | "error";
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { value: null, status: "streaming", className: "" }
);

const clamped = computed(() =>
  props.value === null || props.value === undefined ? null : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, props.value))
);
const indeterminate = computed(() => clamped.value === null);

const STATUS_BAR: Record<string, string> = {
  streaming: "bg-indigo-500",
  done: "bg-emerald-500",
  error: "bg-rose-500",
};
const barColor = computed(() => STATUS_BAR[props.status] || STATUS_BAR.streaming);
</script>

====/File: vue/Tabs.vue/====

<template>
  <div role="tablist" :aria-label="ariaLabel"
    :class="[variant === 'pills' ? 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800' : 'flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800', $attrs.class]">
    <button v-for="(tab, index) in tabs" :key="tab.id" :ref="(el) => setRef(tab.id, el)" type="button" role="tab"
      :id="`tab-${tab.id}`" :aria-selected="tab.id === current" :aria-controls="`panel-${tab.id}`"
      :tabindex="tab.id === current ? 0 : -1" :disabled="tab.disabled" @click="select(tab)"
      @keydown="move($event, index)"
      :class="['inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40',
        variant === 'pills' ? 'rounded-md px-3 py-1.5' : 'border-b-2 px-3 py-2',
        variant === 'pills'
          ? (tab.id === current ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100' : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200')
          : (tab.id === current ? '-mb-px border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400' : '-mb-px border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200')]">
      <UiIcon v-if="tab.icon" :name="tab.icon" :size="13" />
      <span>{{ tab.label }}</span>
      <span v-if="tab.badge !== undefined"
        class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ tab.badge }}</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface TabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName;
  badge?: string | number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    tabs: TabItem[];
    activeId?: string;
    defaultActiveId?: string;
    variant?: 'underline' | 'pills';
    ariaLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { variant: 'underline', ariaLabel: 'Tabs' }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', id: string): void }>();

const internalId = ref(props.defaultActiveId ?? props.tabs[0]?.id ?? '');
const current = computed(() => props.activeId ?? internalId.value);
const refs: Record<string, HTMLButtonElement | null> = {};

const setRef = (id: string, el: unknown) => {
  refs[id] = (el as HTMLButtonElement) ?? null;
};

const select = (tab: TabItem) => {
  if (tab.disabled) return;
  if (props.activeId === undefined) internalId.value = tab.id;
  emit('change', tab.id);
};

const move = (event: KeyboardEvent, index: number) => {
  const keys = ['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End'];
  if (!keys.includes(event.key)) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  const enabled = props.tabs.map((tab, i) => ({ tab, i })).filter((entry) => !entry.tab.disabled);
  if (enabled.length === 0) return;
  const position = enabled.findIndex((entry) => entry.i === index);
  let next = position;
  if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') next = (position + 1) % enabled.length;
  if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = (position - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
  if (event.key === 'Home') next = 0;
  if (event.key === 'End') next = enabled.length - 1;
  const target = enabled[next];
  if (target) {
    select(target.tab);
    refs[target.tab.id]?.focus();
  }
};
</script>

====/File: vue/TestimonialGrid.vue/====

    No testimonials yet.
  </div>
  <div v-else :class="['grid gap-4', columns === 2 ? 'sm:grid-cols-2' : 'sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3', $attrs.class]">
    <figure v-for="testimonial in testimonials" :key="testimonial.id" @click="$emit('select', testimonial)"
      class="flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 transition-shadow hover:shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div v-if="ratingOf(testimonial) > 0" class="flex items-center gap-0.5" :aria-label="`${ratingOf(testimonial)} out of 5 stars`">
        <UiIcon v-for="index in 5" :key="index" name="star" :size="13"
          :class="index <= ratingOf(testimonial) ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-200 dark:text-zinc-700'" />
      </div>

      <blockquote class="mt-2 flex-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">“{{ testimonial.quote }}”</blockquote>

      <figcaption class="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2">
        <img v-if="testimonial.avatar" :src="testimonial.avatar" alt="" class="h-7 w-7 shrink-0 rounded-full object-cover" />
        <span v-else
          class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          {{ initials(testimonial.name) }}
        </span>
        <span class="min-w-0">
          <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ testimonial.name }}</span>
          <span v-if="testimonial.role || testimonial.company" class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
            {{ [testimonial.role, testimonial.company].filter(Boolean).join(', ') }}
          </span>
        </span>
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface Testimonial {
  id: string;
  quote: string;
  name: string;
  role?: string;
  company?: string;
  avatar?: string;
  rating?: number;
}

withDefaults(defineProps<{ testimonials?: Testimonial[]; columns?: 2 | 3 }>(), {
  testimonials: () => [],
  columns: 3,
});
defineEmits<{ (e: 'select', testimonial: Testimonial): void }>();

const ratingOf = (testimonial: Testimonial) => Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.round(testimonial.rating ?? 0)));

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');
</script>

====/File: vue/ThemeToggle.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    :class="[
      'inline-flex items-center p-1 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 select-none',
      className
    ]"
    role="group"
    aria-label="Theme toggle"
  >
    <button
      type="button"
      @click="applyTheme('auto')"
      :class="[
        'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all',
        mode === 'auto'
          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      ]"
      title="Follow System/Time"
    >
      <span>💻</span>
      <span>Auto</span>
    </button>

    <button
      type="button"
      @click="applyTheme('light')"
      :class="[
        'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all',
        mode === 'light'
          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      ]"
      title="Light Mode"
    >
      <span>☀️</span>
      <span>Light</span>
    </button>

    <button
      type="button"
      @click="applyTheme('dark')"
      :class="[
        'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all',
        mode === 'dark'
          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      ]"
      title="Dark Mode"
    >
      <span>🌙</span>
      <span>Dark</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';

export type ThemeMode = 'auto' | 'light' | 'dark';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    storageKey?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    storageKey: 'mango-theme',
    className: ''
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', mode: ThemeMode, resolved: 'light' | 'dark'): void;
}>();

const mode = ref<ThemeMode>('auto');

const resolveTheme = (m: ThemeMode): 'light' | 'dark' => {
  if (m === 'light' || m === 'dark') return m;
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  const isNight =
    (typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) ||
    hour >= 19 ||
    hour < 7;
  return isNight ? 'dark' : 'light';
};

const applyTheme = (nextMode: ThemeMode) => {
  const resolved = resolveTheme(nextMode);
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextMode;
  document.documentElement.dataset.resolvedTheme = resolved;
  document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = resolved;
  if (resolved === 'dark') {
    document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
  } else {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
  }
  mode.value = nextMode;
  localStorage.setItem(props.storageKey, nextMode);
  emit('change', nextMode, resolved);
};

onMounted(() => {
  const saved = (localStorage.getItem(props.storageKey) as ThemeMode) || 'auto';
  applyTheme(saved);
});
</script>

<template>
  <div
    v-if="content || isThinking || steps.length"
    :class="[
      'my-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 text-xs overflow-hidden transition-all',
      className
    ]"
  >
    <!-- Header Bar -->

      type="button"

      class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 hover:bg-zinc-100/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-medium transition-colors select-none text-left"
    >

          {{ isThinking ? 'Deeply thinking...' : durationSeconds ? `Thought for ${durationSeconds}s` : 'Thought process' }}
        </span>
      </div>
      <UiIcon name="chevron-down" :size="14" :class="['transition-transform duration-200', isExpanded ? 'rotate-180' : '']" />
    </button>

            class="absolute left-[5px] top-4 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
          <span class="absolute left-0 top-1.5">
            <span v-if="step.durationMs !== undefined" class="block h-[11px] w-[11px] rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
            <span v-else class="block h-[11px] w-[11px] rounded-full border-2 border-amber-400 animate-pulse" />
          </span>
          <div class="pb-2.5 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span :class="['truncate', step.durationMs !== undefined ? 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300' : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500']">
              {{ step.label }}
            </span>

              {{ formatDuration(step.durationMs) }}
            </span>
          </div>
        </li>
      </ol>
      <div
        :class="['px-4 py-3 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap text-[13px]',
          steps.length ? 'border-t border-zinc-200/50 dark:border-zinc-800/50' : '']"
      >
        <span v-if="!content" class="italic text-zinc-400">Processing thoughts...</span>
        <span v-else>{{ content }}</span>
      </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface ThinkingStep {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  durationMs?: number;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    content: string;
    isThinking?: boolean;
    durationSeconds?: number;
    steps?: ThinkingStep[];
    defaultExpanded?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    isThinking: false,
    steps: () => [],
    defaultExpanded: false,
    className: ''
  }
);

const isExpanded = ref(props.defaultExpanded || props.isThinking);

const runningStep = computed(() => props.steps.find((step) => step.durationMs === undefined));

const formatDuration = (ms?: number) => {
  if (typeof ms !== 'number') return '';
  return ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`;
};
</script>

====/File: vue/ToastStack.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    v-if="toasts.length > 0"
    class="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]"
    :class="className"
    aria-live="polite"
  >
    <div
      v-for="toast in toasts"
      :key="toast.id"
      class="relative overflow-hidden flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 animate-in slide-in-from-right fade-in duration-200"
      role="alert"
      @mouseenter="pause(toast.id)"
      @mouseleave="resume(toast.id)"
    >
      <UiIcon :name="typeMeta(toast.type).icon" :size="16" class="shrink-0" :class="typeMeta(toast.type).color" />
      <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">{{ toast.message }}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        class="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors shrink-0"
        aria-label="Dismiss"
        @click="emit('dismiss', toast.id)"
      >
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="14" />
      </button>
      <span
        v-if="duration > 0"
        aria-hidden="true"
        class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 transition-[width] duration-100 ease-linear"
        :class="[typeMeta(toast.type).bar, remaining.get(toast.id) !== undefined ? '' : '']"
        :style="{ width: `${remaining.get(toast.id) ?? 100}%` }"
      />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, watch, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ToastItem {
  id: string | number;
  message: string;
  type?: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info";
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    toasts?: ToastItem[];
    duration?: number;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { toasts: () => [], duration: 4000, className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "dismiss", id: string | number): void;
}>();

const META: Record<string, { icon: string; color: string; bar: string }> = {
  success: { icon: "check-circle", color: "text-emerald-500", bar: "bg-emerald-500" },
  error: { icon: "circle-x", color: "text-rose-500", bar: "bg-rose-500" },
  warning: { icon: "alert-triangle", color: "text-amber-500", bar: "bg-amber-500" },
  info: { icon: "sparkles", color: "text-sky-500", bar: "bg-sky-500" },
};

function typeMeta(type?: string) {
  return META[type || "info"] || META.info;
}

interface ToastClock {
  started: number;
  /** Percent (0-100) remaining when the clock (re)started. */
  startPct: number;
  /** ms budget corresponding to startPct. */
  total: number;
  timer?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
  ticker?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
}

const clocks = new Map<string | number, ToastClock>();
const remaining = reactive(new Map<string | number, number>());

function stopClock(id: string | number) {
  const clock = clocks.get(id);
  if (clock) {
    if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
    if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
    clocks.delete(id);
  }
}

function startClock(id: string | number) {
  const clock = clocks.get(id);
  if (!clock || clock.total <= 0 || props.duration <= 0) return;
  const started = Date.now();
  clock.started = started;
  clock.timer = setTimeout(() => {
    remaining.set(id, 0);
    stopClock(id);
    emit("dismiss", id);
  }, clock.total);
  clock.ticker = setInterval(() => {
    const elapsed = Date.now() - started;
    remaining.set(id, Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - elapsed / clock.total)));
  }, 100);
}

function pause(id: string | number) {
  const clock = clocks.get(id);
  if (!clock) return;
  if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
  if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
  const elapsed = Date.now() - clock.started;
  const nextPct = Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - elapsed / clock.total));
  clock.startPct = nextPct;
  clock.total = Math.max(0, clock.total - elapsed);
  remaining.set(id, nextPct);
}

function resume(id: string | number) {
  startClock(id);
}

watch(
  () => props.toasts.map((t) => t.id).join(","),
  () => {
    if (props.duration <= 0) {
      for (const id of [...clocks.keys()]) stopClock(id);
      return;
    }
    const alive = new Set(props.toasts.map((t) => t.id));
    for (const id of [...clocks.keys()]) {
      if (!alive.has(id)) stopClock(id);
    }
    for (const t of props.toasts) {
      if (!clocks.has(t.id)) {
        clocks.set(t.id, { started: Date.now(), startPct: 100, total: props.duration });
        remaining.set(t.id, 100);
        startClock(t.id);
      }
    }
  },
  { immediate: true }
);

onUnmounted(() => {
  for (const id of [...clocks.keys()]) stopClock(id);
});
</script>

          : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'"

<template>

      :class="['pointer-events-none absolute z-30 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white opacity-0 shadow-lg transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-within:opacity-100 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900', SIDE_CLASS[side]]">

====/File: vue/TypingIndicator.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    class="inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
    :class="className"
    role="status"
    :aria-label="label || 'Loading'"
  >
    <span class="inline-flex items-center" :class="gapClass">
      <span
        v-for="i in 3"
        :key="i"
        class="rounded-full bg-current"
        :class="[dotClass, variant === 'pulse' ? 'animate-pulse' : 'animate-bounce']"
        :style="{ animationDelay: `${(i - 1) * 160}ms` }"
      ></span>
    </span>
    <span v-if="label" class="text-xs font-sans">{{ label }}</span>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    label?: string;
    variant?: "dots" | "pulse";
    size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    variant: "dots",
    size: "md",
    className: "",
  }
);

const dotClass = computed(() =>
  props.size === "sm" ? "w-1.5 h-1.5" : props.size === "lg" ? "w-2.5 h-2.5" : "w-2 h-2"
);
const gapClass = computed(() =>
  props.size === "sm" ? "gap-1" : props.size === "lg" ? "gap-2" : "gap-1.5"
);
</script>

====/File: vue/UpgradePromptCard.vue/====

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4">
    <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
      <span :class="['flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg', tone.chip, tone.text]">
        <UiIcon name="zap" :size="16" />
      </span>
      <div class="min-w-0">
        <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ title }}</div>
        <div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          You're on the {{ planName }} plan — {{ percent }}% of your {{ unit }} used.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="mt-3 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
      <div :class="['h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300', tone.bar]" :style="{ width: `${percent}%` }" />
    </div>

    <div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
      <span class="tabular-nums">{{ formatNumber(used) }} / {{ formatNumber(limit) }} {{ unit }}</span>
      <span :class="['ml-auto tabular-nums', tone.text]">{{ percent }}%</span>
    </div>

    <ul v-if="features.length" class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
      <li v-for="feature in features" :key="feature" class="flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
        <UiIcon name="check" :size="12" class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-500" />
        <span>{{ feature }}</span>
      </li>
    </ul>

    <button type="button"
      class="mt-3 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
      @click="emit('upgrade')">
      {{ ctaText }}
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  used: number;
  limit: number;
  planName?: string;
  unit?: string;
  title?: string;
  features?: string[];
  ctaText?: string;
}>(), {
  planName: 'Free',
  unit: 'requests',
  title: 'Upgrade to keep going',
  features: () => [],
  ctaText: 'See plans',
});

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'upgrade'): void }>();

const formatNumber = (value: number) => (typeof value === 'number' ? value.toLocaleString('en-US') : String(value));
const percent = computed(() => {
  const safeLimit = props.limit > 0 ? props.limit : 1;
  return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((props.used / safeLimit) * 100)));
});
const tone = computed(() =>
  percent.value >= 90
    ? { bar: 'bg-red-500', text: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40' }
    : percent.value >= 70
      ? { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40' }
      : { bar: 'bg-emerald-500', text: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40' }
);
</script>

====/File: vue/VoiceModePanel.vue/====

<template>
  <div
    class="flex flex-col items-center rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-6 py-8 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
    :class="$attrs.class">
    <div class="relative flex h-28 w-28 items-center justify-center">
      <span aria-hidden="true" :class="['absolute inset-0 rounded-full', meta.ring, animated ? 'animate-ping' : 'opacity-0']" />
      <span aria-hidden="true" :class="['absolute inset-3 rounded-full', meta.ring, 'opacity-60']" />
      <span aria-hidden="true" :class="['absolute inset-6 rounded-full transition-colors', innerTone]" />
      <button type="button" @click="$emit('toggle')" :aria-label="state === 'idle' ? 'Start voice mode' : 'Stop voice mode'"
        :aria-pressed="state !== 'idle'"
        :class="['relative flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900', meta.orb]">
        <UiIcon :name="state === 'idle' ? 'mic' : 'square'" :size="24" />
      </button>
    </div>

    <div class="mt-4 flex h-6 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">
      <span v-for="index in 9" :key="index"
        :class="['w-1 rounded-full', animated ? 'animate-[voice-bar_0.9s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate] bg-indigo-500' : 'h-1 bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700']"
        :style="animated ? { animationDelay: `${((index - 1) * 0.07).toFixed(2)}s` } : undefined" />
    </div>

    <p class="mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ meta.label }}</p>
    <p class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ meta.hint }}</p>

    <p v-if="transcript" class="mt-4 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">“{{ transcript }}”</p>
    <p v-if="reply" class="mt-2 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">{{ reply }}</p>

    <button v-if="showEnd" type="button" @click="$emit('end')"
      class="mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
      <UiIcon name="x" :size="12" />
      End voice session
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type VoiceModeState = 'idle' | 'listening' | 'thinking' | 'speaking';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    state?: VoiceModeState;
    transcript?: string;
    reply?: string;
    showEnd?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { state: 'idle', showEnd: true }
);
defineEmits<{ (e: 'toggle'): void; (e: 'end'): void }>();

const STATE_META: Record<VoiceModeState, { label: string; hint: string; ring: string; orb: string }> = {
  idle: { label: 'Tap to speak', hint: 'Voice mode is ready', ring: 'bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/40', orb: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300' },
  listening: { label: 'Listening…', hint: 'Speak now — tap again to stop', ring: 'bg-indigo-400/40', orb: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' },
  thinking: { label: 'Thinking…', hint: 'Working on a response', ring: 'bg-amber-400/40', orb: 'bg-amber-500 text-white' },
  speaking: { label: 'Speaking…', hint: 'Tap to interrupt', ring: 'bg-emerald-400/40', orb: 'bg-emerald-500 text-white' },
};

const meta = computed(() => STATE_META[props.state]);
const animated = computed(() => props.state === 'listening' || props.state === 'speaking');
const innerTone = computed(() => {
  if (props.state === 'thinking') return 'animate-pulse bg-amber-400/50';
  if (props.state === 'listening') return 'bg-indigo-400/40';
  if (props.state === 'speaking') return 'bg-emerald-400/40';
  return 'bg-zinc-200/50 dark:bg-zinc-700/40';
});
</script>

====/File: vanilla/Accordion.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * Accordion - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <accordion-list allow-multiple></accordion-list>
 * Properties: items (AccordionItem[])
 * Events: toggle (detail: { id, open })
 */
export class AccordionElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['allow-multiple', 'default-open-ids'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
    this._openIds = null;
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    if (this._openIds === null) {
      this._openIds = this._items.filter((item) => item.defaultOpen).map((item) => item.id);
    }
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _openList() {
    if (this._openIds !== null) return this._openIds;
    const raw = this.getAttribute('default-open-ids');
    if (!raw) return [];
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.map(String) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  _toggle(id) {
    const openIds = this._openList();
    const wasOpen = openIds.includes(id);
    const allowMultiple = this.hasAttribute('allow-multiple');
    this._openIds = wasOpen
      ? openIds.filter((entry) => entry !== id)
      : allowMultiple
        ? [...openIds, id]
        : [id];
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id, open: !wasOpen } }));
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const openIds = this._openList();

    const rows = this._items
      .map((item) => {
        const open = openIds.includes(item.id);
        return `<div>
          <h3>
            <button type="button" data-accordion-id="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" aria-expanded="${open}"
              aria-controls="accordion-panel-${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
              class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50">
              ${item.icon ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span class="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}</span>
                ${item.description ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.description)}</span>` : ''}
              </span>
              <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 14 })}</span>
            </button>
          </h3>
          ${
            open
              ? `<div id="accordion-panel-${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-trigger-${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
                  class="px-4 pb-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.content)}</div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${rows}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-accordion-id]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this._toggle(node.getAttribute('data-accordion-id')));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('accordion-list')) {
  customElements.define('accordion-list', AccordionElement);
}
export default AccordionElement;

====/File: vanilla/AccountSwitcher.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const initials = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/**
 * AccountSwitcher - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <account-switcher current-id="a1"></account-switcher>
 * Properties: accounts (Account[])
 * Events: switch (detail: account), add-account, sign-out, open-change (detail: boolean)
 */
export class AccountSwitcherElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['current-id'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._accounts = [];
    this._open = false;
    this._onPointerDown = this._onPointerDown.bind(this);
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
  }

  get accounts() {
    return this._accounts;
  }

  set accounts(value) {
    this._accounts = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get open() {
    return this._open;
  }

  set open(value) {
    this._setOpen(Boolean(value));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this._detachGlobal();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _current() {
    const currentId = this.getAttribute('current-id');
    return this._accounts.find((account) => String(account.id) === String(currentId)) || this._accounts[0];
  }

  _setOpen(next) {
    if (this._open === next) return;
    this._open = next;
    if (next) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    } else {
      this._detachGlobal();
    }
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-change', { detail: next }));
  }

  _detachGlobal() {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  _onPointerDown(event) {
    if (!this.contains(event.target)) this._setOpen(false);
  }

  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') this._setOpen(false);
  }

  _avatar(account, sizeClass) {
    const inner = account.avatar
      ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(account.avatar)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />`
      : escapeAttribute(initials(account.name));
    return `<span class="flex ${sizeClass} shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full ${sizeClass.includes('h-6') ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400' : 'bg-zinc-200 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200'} text-[10px] font-semibold">${inner}</span>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('inline-block');

    const current = this._current();
    if (!current) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const rows = this._accounts
      .map((account) => {
        const active = String(account.id) === String(current.id);
        const meta = [account.role, account.plan].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || account.email || '';
        return `<li>
          <button type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="${active}" data-account="${escapeAttribute(account.id)}"
            class="account-row flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
            ${this._avatar(account, 'h-6 w-6')}
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(account.name)}</span>
              <span class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(meta)}</span>
            </span>
            ${active ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon('check', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}
          </button>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="relative inline-block text-left">
        <button type="button" class="account-trigger flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="${this._open}">
          ${this._avatar(current, 'h-6 w-6')}
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(current.name)}</span>
            ${current.email ? `<span class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(current.email)}</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 12 })}</span>
        </button>

        ${
          this._open
            ? `<div role="menu" aria-label="Switch account" class="account-menu absolute left-0 z-30 mt-1 w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                <ul class="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto py-1">${rows}</ul>
                <div class="border-t border-zinc-100 py-1 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <button type="button" role="menuitem" class="account-add flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
                    <span class="text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('plus', { size: 12 })}</span>Add account
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" role="menuitem" class="account-signout flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-red-600 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30">
                    <span>${uiIcon('arrow-right', { size: 12 })}</span>Sign out
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>`
            : ''
        }
      </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.account-trigger').addEventListener('click', () => this._setOpen(!this._open));

    this.querySelectorAll('.account-row').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-account');
        const account = this._accounts.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (!account) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('switch', { detail: account }));
        this._setOpen(false);
      });
    });

    const add = this.querySelector('.account-add');
    if (add) {
      add.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-account'));
        this._setOpen(false);
      });
    }

    const signOut = this.querySelector('.account-signout');
    if (signOut) {
      signOut.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sign-out'));
        this._setOpen(false);
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('account-switcher')) {
  customElements.define('account-switcher', AccountSwitcherElement);
}
export default AccountSwitcherElement;

====/File: vanilla/AgentRunLog.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const statusIcon = (status) =>
  status === 'running' ? 'loader' : status === 'done' ? 'check-circle' : status === 'error' ? 'circle-x' : 'clock';

const statusClass = (status) =>
  status === 'running'
    ? 'animate-spin text-indigo-500'
    : status === 'done'
      ? 'text-emerald-500'
      : status === 'error'
        ? 'text-red-500'
        : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500';

const formatDuration = (ms) => (typeof ms !== 'number' ? '' : ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);

export class AgentRunLogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['steps', 'title', 'auto-expand-running'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
    this._expanded = new Set();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get steps() {
    if (this._steps.length) return this._steps;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('steps') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    const auto = this.getAttribute('auto-expand-running') !== 'false';
    this._expanded = new Set(
      auto ? this._steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'running' && s.detail).map((s) => s.id) : []
    );
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const steps = this.steps;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Execution log';
    const doneCount = steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'done').length;

    this._applyHostClass('rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900');

    const items = steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;
        const isOpen = this._expanded.has(step.id);
        return `
          <li class="relative pl-6">
            ${isLast ? '' : '<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[6px] top-5 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>'}
            <span class="absolute left-0 top-1 ${statusClass(step.status)}">${uiIcon(statusIcon(step.status), { size: 14 })}</span>
            <div class="pb-3">
              <button type="button" data-step="${escapeAttribute(step.id)}" ${step.detail ? `aria-expanded="${isOpen}"` : ''} class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left ${step.detail ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'}">
                <span class="text-xs ${step.status === 'pending' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(step.label)}</span>
                ${step.durationMs !== undefined ? `<span class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${formatDuration(step.durationMs)}</span>` : ''}
                ${step.detail ? `<span class="ml-auto text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${uiIcon(isOpen ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}
              </button>
              ${step.detail && isOpen ? `<pre class="mt-2 max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(step.detail)}</pre>` : ''}
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
        <span class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${uiIcon('terminal', { size: 14 })}</span>
        <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</span>
        <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${doneCount}/${steps.length}</span>
      </div>
      <ol class="px-4 py-3">${items}</ol>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-step]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-step');
        const step = steps.find((s) => s.id === id);
        if (!step?.detail) return;
        this._expanded.has(id) ? this._expanded.delete(id) : this._expanded.add(id);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id, expanded: this._expanded.has(id) } }));
        this.render();
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('agent-run-log')) {
  customElements.define('agent-run-log', AgentRunLogElement);
}
export default AgentRunLogElement;

====/File: vanilla/AgentStepTimeline.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const STATUS_META = {
  pending: { icon: 'clock', cls: 'text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800' },
  running: { icon: 'loader', cls: 'text-indigo-500 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60', pulse: true },
  done: { icon: 'check-circle', cls: 'text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60' },
  error: { icon: 'circle-x', cls: 'text-rose-500 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60' },
};

export class AgentStepTimelineElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
  }

  get steps() {
    return this._steps;
  }

  set steps(val) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    if (this._steps.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const items = this._steps
      .map((step, i) => {
        const meta = STATUS_META[step.status] || STATUS_META.pending;
        const isLast = i === this._steps.length - 1;
        return `
          <li class="relative flex gap-3">
            ${
              !isLast
                ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-[-16px] w-px ${
                    step.status === 'done' ? 'bg-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-800' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700'
                  }"></span>`
                : ''
            }
            <span class="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-full shrink-0 ${meta.cls}">
              ${uiIcon(meta.icon, { size: 15, className: meta.pulse ? 'animate-spin' : '' })}
            </span>
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 pb-1">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class="text-sm font-medium ${
                  meta === STATUS_META.pending ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'
                }">${escapeAttribute(step.title)}</span>
                ${step.duration ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(step.duration)}</span>` : ''}
              </div>
              ${step.description ? `<div class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(step.description)}</div>` : ''}
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<ol class="relative space-y-4">${items}</ol>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('agent-step-timeline')) {
  customElements.define('agent-step-timeline', AgentStepTimelineElement);
}
export default AgentStepTimelineElement;

====/File: vanilla/AgentTaskChecklist.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const STATUS_ICON = {
  pending: { icon: 'square', cls: 'text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600' },
  active: { icon: 'loader', cls: 'text-indigo-500 animate-spin' },
  done: { icon: 'check-circle', cls: 'text-emerald-500' },
};

export class AgentTaskChecklistElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(val) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Tasks';
    const doneCount = this._items.filter((i) => i.status === 'done').length;

    const itemsHtml = this._items
      .map((item) => {
        const meta = STATUS_ICON[item.status] || STATUS_ICON.pending;
        const isDone = item.status === 'done';
        return `
          <li>
            <div
              role="button"
              tabindex="0"
              data-task-id="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
              class="task-item flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 ${
                isDone ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
              }"
            >
              ${uiIcon(meta.icon, { size: 15, className: `shrink-0 ${meta.cls}` })}
              <span class="flex-1 min-w-0 truncate ${isDone ? 'line-through' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this._applyHostClass('block rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden');
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
        ${uiIcon('layers', { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-400' })}
        ${escapeAttribute(title)}
        <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-zinc-400">${doneCount}/${this._items.length}</span>
      </div>
      <ul class="p-1.5 space-y-0.5">${itemsHtml}</ul>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.task-item').forEach((row) => {
      const id = row.getAttribute('data-task-id');
      const item = this._items.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(id));
      if (!item) return;
      const toggle = () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id: item.id } }));
      row.addEventListener('click', toggle);
      row.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          toggle();
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('agent-task-checklist')) {
  customElements.define('agent-task-checklist', AgentTaskChecklistElement);
}
export default AgentTaskChecklistElement;

====/File: vanilla/AlertBanner.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE = {
  info: {
    icon: 'info',
    iconClass: 'text-indigo-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-900/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300',
    actionClass: 'text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:hover:text-indigo-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-500 dark:hover:text-indigo-300',
    role: 'status',
  },
  success: {
    icon: 'check-circle',
    iconClass: 'text-emerald-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300',
    actionClass: 'text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:hover:text-emerald-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500 dark:hover:text-emerald-300',
    role: 'status',
  },
  warning: {
    icon: 'alert-triangle',
    iconClass: 'text-amber-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-900/60 dark:bg-amber-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300',
    actionClass: 'text-amber-600 hover:text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 dark:hover:text-amber-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-500 dark:hover:text-amber-300',
    role: 'alert',
  },
  danger: {
    icon: 'circle-x',
    iconClass: 'text-rose-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300',
    actionClass: 'text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 dark:hover:text-rose-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-500 dark:hover:text-rose-300',
    role: 'alert',
  },
};

/**
 * AlertBanner - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <alert-banner tone="warning" title="…" description="…"></alert-banner>
 * Properties: (none; driven by attributes)
 * Attributes: tone, title, description, action-text, dismissible
 * Events: action, dismiss
 */
export class AlertBannerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tone', 'title', 'description', 'action-text', 'dismissible'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._title = null;
    this._description = null;
    this._actionText = null;
  }

  get title() {
    return this._title ?? this.getAttribute('title') ?? '';
  }

  set title(value) {
    this._title = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get description() {
    return this._description ?? this.getAttribute('description') ?? '';
  }

  set description(value) {
    this._description = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get actionText() {
    return this._actionText ?? this.getAttribute('action-text') ?? '';
  }

  set actionText(value) {
    this._actionText = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get tone() {
    const value = this.getAttribute('tone') || 'info';
    return TONE[value] ? value : 'info';
  }

  get dismissible() {
    return this.hasAttribute('dismissible');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const styles = TONE[this.tone];
    const title = this.title;
    const description = this.description;
    const actionText = this.actionText;

    const actions = [
      actionText
        ? `<button type="button" data-alert-action class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${styles.actionClass}">${escapeAttribute(actionText)}</button>`
        : '',
      this.dismissible
        ? `<button type="button" data-alert-dismiss aria-label="Dismiss" class="rounded p-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${styles.dismissClass}">${uiIcon('x', { size: 13 })}</button>`
        : '',
    ].join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div role="${styles.role}" class="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-3 ${styles.wrapClass}">
      ${uiIcon(styles.icon, { size: 16, className: `mt-0.5 shrink-0 ${styles.iconClass}` })}
      <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p class="text-[13px] font-semibold ${styles.titleClass}">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
        ${description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed ${styles.bodyClass}">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${actions ? `<div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5">${actions}</div>` : ''}
    </div>`;

    const actionButton = this.querySelector('[data-alert-action]');
    if (actionButton) {
      actionButton.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action')));
    }
    const dismissButton = this.querySelector('[data-alert-dismiss]');
    if (dismissButton) {
      dismissButton.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss')));
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('alert-banner')) {
  customElements.define('alert-banner', AlertBannerElement);
}
export default AlertBannerElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

/**
 * ArtifactCanvas - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <artifact-canvas title="Preview" language="html" code="<h1>Hello</h1>"></artifact-canvas>
 */
class ArtifactCanvas extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["title", "language", "code", "is-open"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.tab = "preview";
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const isOpen = this.hasAttribute("is-open");
    if (!isOpen) {
      this.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    const title = this.getAttribute("title") || "Artifact Preview";
    const language = this.getAttribute("language") || "html";
    const code = this.getAttribute("code") || "";

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-full sm:w-[500px] md:w-[680px] z-40 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border-l border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl flex flex-col transition-transform duration-300">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span class="font-semibold text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate max-w-[240px]">${title}</span>
            <div class="flex items-center bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-800 p-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
              <button type="button" id="tab-preview" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${this.tab === 'preview' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100' : ''}">Preview</button>
              <button type="button" id="tab-code" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${this.tab === 'code' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100' : ''}">Code</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button type="button" id="copy-btn" class="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors text-xs font-mono">Copy</button>
            <button type="button" id="close-btn" class="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Close panel">${uiIcon('x', { size: 18 })}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative">
          <iframe id="preview-frame" class="w-full h-full border-0 bg-white ${this.tab === 'preview' ? '' : 'hidden'}" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals"></iframe>
          <pre id="code-view" class="w-full h-full p-4 m-0 overflow-auto bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100 text-xs font-mono leading-relaxed ${this.tab === 'code' ? '' : 'hidden'}"><code>${this.escapeHtml(code)}</code></pre>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    let sandboxedDoc = code;
    if (language === "svg") {
      sandboxedDoc = `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;margin:0;background:#09090b;">${code}</div>`;
    } else if (language === "html") {
      sandboxedDoc = `
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
