          <head>
            <meta charset="utf-8">
            <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
            <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
            <style>body { margin: 0; padding: 1rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }</style>
          </head>
          <body>
            ${code}
          </body>
        </html>
      `;
    }

    this.querySelector("#tab-preview").addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.tab = "preview";
      this.render();
    });

    this.querySelector("#tab-code").addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.tab = "code";
      this.render();
    });

    this.querySelector("#copy-btn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
      const btn = this.querySelector("#copy-btn");
      btn.innerHTML = `${uiIcon('check', { size: 14 })} Copied`;
      setTimeout(() => (btn.innerHTML = "Copy"), 2000);
    });

    this.querySelector("#close-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.removeAttribute("is-open");
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("close"));
    });
  }

  escapeHtml(str) {
    return str.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("artifact-canvas")) {
  customElements.define("artifact-canvas", ArtifactCanvas);
}
export default ArtifactCanvas;

====/File: vanilla/AudioWaveVisualizer.js/====

/**
 * AudioWaveVisualizer - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <audio-wave-visualizer is-active bar-count="16"></audio-wave-visualizer>
 */
class AudioWaveVisualizer extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["is-active", "bar-count", "color"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const isActive = this.hasAttribute("is-active");
    const barCount = parseInt(this.getAttribute("bar-count") || "16", 10);
    const color = this.getAttribute("color") || "bg-amber-500";

    const bars = [];
    for (let idx = 0; idx < barCount; idx++) {
      const delay = ((idx * 0.08) % 0.8).toFixed(2);
      const duration = (0.6 + ((idx % 4) * 0.15)).toFixed(2);
      bars.push(`
        <span style="animation-delay:${delay}s; animation-duration:${duration}s;" class="w-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${color} ${isActive ? 'h-full animate-[audio-pulse_0.8s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate]' : 'h-1.5 opacity-40'}"></span>
      `);
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 h-8 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 select-none" role="status" aria-label="${isActive ? 'Audio active' : 'Audio idle'}">
        ${bars.join("")}
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("audio-wave-visualizer")) {
  customElements.define("audio-wave-visualizer", AudioWaveVisualizer);
}
export default AudioWaveVisualizer;

====/File: vanilla/AuthForm.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AuthFormElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['mode', 'title', 'subtitle', 'submit-text', 'error', 'loading', 'footer-text', 'providers'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get providers() {
    if (this._providers) return this._providers;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('providers') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set providers(value) {
    this._providers = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get mode() {
    return this.getAttribute('mode') === 'signup' ? 'signup' : 'signin';
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const isSignup = this.mode === 'signup';
    const providers = this.providers;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || (isSignup ? 'Create your account' : 'Welcome back');
    const subtitle =
      this.getAttribute('subtitle') || (isSignup ? 'Start free, no card required.' : 'Sign in to continue to your workspace.');
    const error = this.getAttribute('error') || '';
    const loading = this.getAttribute('loading') === 'true';
    const submitText = this.getAttribute('submit-text') || (isSignup ? 'Create account' : 'Sign in');
    const footerText = this.getAttribute('footer-text');

    this._applyHostClass('block w-full max-w-sm');

    const providerButtons = providers
      .map((provider) => {
        const fallback = (provider.name || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();
        return `
          <button type="button" data-provider="${escapeAttribute(provider.name)}"
            class="auth-provider flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
            ${
              provider.icon
                ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(provider.icon)}" alt="" class="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />`
                : `<span class="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(fallback)}</span>`
            }
            <span>Continue with ${escapeAttribute(provider.name)}</span>
          </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const providerBlock = providers.length
      ? `<div class="mt-5 space-y-2">${providerButtons}</div>
         <div class="my-5 flex items-center gap-3">
           <span class="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"></span>
           <span class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">or</span>
           <span class="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"></span>
         </div>`
      : '';

    const inputAttrs =
      'w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:border-indigo-500 transition-colors';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-6">
        <div class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</div>
        <div class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(subtitle)}</div>
        ${providerBlock}
        <form class="${providers.length ? 'space-y-3' : 'mt-5 space-y-3'}" novalidate>
          ${
            isSignup
              ? `<label class="block">
                   <span class="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Name</span>
                   <input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Ada Lovelace" class="${inputAttrs}" />
                 </label>`
              : ''
          }
          <label class="block">
            <span class="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Email</span>
            <input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@company.com" class="${inputAttrs}" />
          </label>
          <label class="block">
            <span class="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Password</span>
            <input type="password" name="password" autocomplete="${isSignup ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'}"
              placeholder="••••••••" class="${inputAttrs}" />
          </label>
          ${
            error
              ? `<div role="alert" class="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 px-3 py-2">
                   <span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-red-500">${uiIcon('alert-triangle', { size: 14 })}</span>
                   <span class="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">${escapeAttribute(error)}</span>
                 </div>`
              : ''
          }
          <button type="submit" ${loading ? 'disabled' : ''}
            class="auth-submit flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900">
            ${loading ? `<span class="animate-spin inline-flex">${uiIcon('loader', { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
            ${escapeAttribute(submitText)}
          </button>
        </form>
        ${
          footerText
            ? `<button type="button" class="auth-footer mt-4 w-full text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">${escapeAttribute(footerText)}</button>`
            : ''
        }
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.auth-provider').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const provider = providers.find((p) => p.name === btn.getAttribute('data-provider'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('provider', { detail: provider }));
      });
    });

    const form = this.querySelector('form');
    form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      // Keep the raw DOM event from bubbling to host listeners: hosts should
      // only ever observe the normalized `submit` CustomEvent below.
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (loading) return;
      const values = new FormData(form);
      const payload = {
        ...(isSignup ? { name: String(values.get('name') || '') } : {}),
        email: String(values.get('email') || ''),
        password: String(values.get('password') || ''),
      };
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('submit', { detail: payload }));
    });

    const footerBtn = this.querySelector('.auth-footer');
    if (footerBtn) footerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('footer')));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('auth-form')) {
  customElements.define('auth-form', AuthFormElement);
}
export default AuthFormElement;

====/File: vanilla/AutoScrollAnchor.js/====

/**
 * AutoScrollAnchor - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <auto-scroll-anchor is-streaming></auto-scroll-anchor>
 */
class AutoScrollAnchor extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["is-streaming"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.isAtBottom = true;
    this.render();
    this.bindEvents();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._scrollHandler) {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", this._scrollHandler);
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (name === "is-streaming" && newValue !== null && this.isAtBottom) {
      this.scrollToBottom();
    }
  }

  render() {
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div id="anchor" class="h-px w-full pointer-events-none"></div>
      <button type="button" id="back-to-bottom" class="hidden fixed bottom-24 right-8 z-30 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium" title="Scroll to bottom">
        <span>↓</span>
      </button>
    `;
  }

  bindEvents() {
    const btn = this.querySelector("#back-to-bottom");
    this._scrollHandler = () => {
      const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
      const documentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
      const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      const distanceFromBottom = documentHeight - (scrollTop + windowHeight);
      this.isAtBottom = distanceFromBottom < 80;

      btn.classList.toggle("hidden", this.isAtBottom);
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", this._scrollHandler, { passive: true });
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => this.scrollToBottom());
  }

  scrollToBottom() {
    this.querySelector("#anchor")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("auto-scroll-anchor")) {
  customElements.define("auto-scroll-anchor", AutoScrollAnchor);
}
export default AutoScrollAnchor;

====/File: vanilla/AvatarGroup.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const SIZE_CLASS = {
  sm: 'h-7 w-7 text-[10px]',
  md: 'h-9 w-9 text-xs',
  lg: 'h-11 w-11 text-sm',
};

const DOT_CLASS = {
  online: 'bg-emerald-500',
  away: 'bg-amber-400',
  offline: 'bg-zinc-400',
};

const initials = (name) =>
  name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/**
 * AvatarGroup - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <avatar-group max="4" size="md"></avatar-group>
 * Properties: members (AvatarMember[])
 * Events: member-click (detail: member)
 */
export class AvatarGroupElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['max', 'size'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._members = [];
  }

  get members() {
    return this._members;
  }

  set members(value) {
    this._members = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex items-center -space-x-2');

    const size = SIZE_CLASS[this.getAttribute('size')] ? this.getAttribute('size') : 'md';
    const rawMax = this.getAttribute('max');
    const max = rawMax !== null && Number.isFinite(Number(rawMax)) ? Math.max(0, Number(rawMax)) : 4;
    const visible = this._members.slice(0, max);
    const overflow = this._members.length - visible.length;
    const sizeClass = SIZE_CLASS[size];
    const iconSize = size === 'sm' ? 12 : size === 'lg' ? 18 : 14;

    const avatars = visible
      .map((member) => {
        const inner = member.src
          ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(member.src)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />`
          : member.name && member.name.trim()
            ? `<span aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(initials(member.name))}</span>`
            : uiIcon('user', { size: iconSize });
        const dot = member.status && DOT_CLASS[member.status]
          ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900 ${DOT_CLASS[member.status]}"></span>`
          : '';
        return `<button type="button" data-member-id="${escapeAttribute(member.id)}" title="${escapeAttribute(member.name)}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(member.name)}"
          class="avatar-member relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold text-zinc-600 ring-2 ring-white transition-transform hover:z-10 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:z-10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}">
          ${inner}${dot}
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `${avatars}${
      overflow > 0
        ? `<span title="${overflow} more" class="relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-500 ring-2 ring-white dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}">+${overflow}</span>`
        : ''
    }`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.avatar-member').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const member = this._members.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === node.getAttribute('data-member-id'));
        if (member) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('member-click', { detail: member }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('avatar-group')) {
  customElements.define('avatar-group', AvatarGroupElement);
}
export default AvatarGroupElement;

====/File: vanilla/Breadcrumb.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const BASE = 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1 py-0.5 transition-colors';
const LINK_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';

/**
 * Breadcrumb - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <breadcrumb-trail max-items="4"></breadcrumb-trail>
 * Properties: items ({ id?, label, href?, icon? }[])
 * Attributes: max-items, aria-label
 * Events: navigate (detail: { item, index })
 */
export class BreadcrumbElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['max-items', 'aria-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = null;
  }

  get items() {
    if (this._items !== null) return this._items;
    const raw = this.getAttribute('items');
    if (!raw) return [];
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get maxItems() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('max-items');
    const value = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 0;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _trail() {
    const items = this.items;
    const maxItems = this.maxItems;
    if (maxItems <= 0 || items.length <= maxItems) return items;
    const tail = Math.max(1, maxItems - 1);
    return [items[0], null, ...items.slice(items.length - tail)];
  }

  _content(item) {
    return `${item.icon ? uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 12 }) : ''}<span>${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const trail = this._trail();
    const ariaLabel = this.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Breadcrumb';

    const rows = trail
      .map((item, index) => {
        const last = index === trail.length - 1;
        const separator =
          index > 0
            ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 11 })}</span>`
            : '';

        let body;
        if (!item) {
          body = '<span aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-zinc-400">…</span>';
        } else if (last) {
          body = `<span aria-current="page" class="${BASE} font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${this._content(item)}</span>`;
        } else if (item.href) {
          body = `<a href="${escapeAttribute(item.href)}" data-breadcrumb-index="${index}" class="${BASE} ${LINK_CLASS}">${this._content(item)}</a>`;
        } else {
          body = `<button type="button" data-breadcrumb-index="${index}" class="${BASE} ${LINK_CLASS}">${this._content(item)}</button>`;
        }

        return `<li class="flex items-center gap-1.5">${separator}${body}</li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<nav aria-label="${escapeAttribute(ariaLabel)}"><ol class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">${rows}</ol></nav>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-breadcrumb-index]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const index = Number(node.getAttribute('data-breadcrumb-index'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('navigate', { detail: { item: trail[index], index } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('breadcrumb-trail')) {
  customElements.define('breadcrumb-trail', BreadcrumbElement);
}
export default BreadcrumbElement;

====/File: vanilla/ChatMessageRow.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ChatMessageRowElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['role', 'name', 'avatar', 'timestamp', 'content'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._content = '';
    this._appliedLayout = '';
  }

  get content() {
    return this._content;
  }

  set content(val) {
    this._content = String(val ?? '');
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._content) {
      const attr = this.getAttribute('content');
      if (attr !== null) this._content = attr;
      else if (this.textContent.trim()) this._content = this.textContent;
    }
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
    if (name === 'content' && newVal !== null && newVal !== oldVal) {
      this._content = newVal;
    }
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const role = this.getAttribute('role') || 'assistant';
    const name = this.getAttribute('name') || '';
    const avatar = this.getAttribute('avatar') || '';
    const timestamp = this.getAttribute('timestamp') || '';

    if (role === 'system') {
      this._applyHostClass('flex justify-center py-2');
      this.innerHTML = `
        <span class="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 px-3 py-1 rounded-full">${escapeAttribute(this._content)}</span>
      `;
      return;
    }

    const isUser = role === 'user';

    const avatarHtml = avatar
      ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(avatar)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(name || role)}" class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg object-cover shrink-0 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700" />`
      : `<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
          isUser
            ? 'bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400'
            : 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
        }">${uiIcon(isUser ? 'user' : 'sparkles', { size: 16 })}</div>`;

    this._applyHostClass(`flex gap-3 py-3 ${isUser ? 'flex-row-reverse' : ''}`);
    this.innerHTML = `
      ${avatarHtml}
      <div class="flex flex-col min-w-0 max-w-[85%] ${isUser ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}">
        ${(name || timestamp) ? `
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            ${name ? `<span class="font-medium">${escapeAttribute(name)}</span>` : ''}
            ${timestamp ? `<span class="font-mono">${escapeAttribute(timestamp)}</span>` : ''}
          </div>
        ` : ''}
        <div class="rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed break-words whitespace-pre-wrap ${
          isUser
            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-tr-sm'
            : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 rounded-tl-sm'
        }">${escapeAttribute(this._content)}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('chat-message-row')) {
  customElements.define('chat-message-row', ChatMessageRowElement);
}
export default ChatMessageRowElement;

====/File: vanilla/ChatPromptInput.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * ChatPromptInput - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <chat-prompt-input placeholder="Ask anything..."></chat-prompt-input>
 * Events: submit (detail: text), stop, attachments (detail: File[]), chip (detail: chip)
 */
class ChatPromptInput extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['placeholder', 'is-generating', 'disabled'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.attachments = [];
    this.isGenerating = false;
    this._chips = [];
  }

  get chips() {
    return this._chips;
  }

  set chips(val) {
    this._chips = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute("placeholder") || "Ask anything... (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)";
    const isGenerating = this.isGenerating || this.hasAttribute('is-generating');

    const chipsHtml = this.chips
      .map((chip) => {
        return `<button type="button" data-chip-id="${escapeAttribute(chip.id)}" aria-pressed="${!!chip.active}"
          class="prompt-chip flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${
            chip.active
              ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400'
              : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700'
          }">${chip.icon ? uiIcon(chip.icon, { size: 12 }) : ''}${escapeAttribute(chip.label)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="relative w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/90 shadow-sm focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-zinc-900/10 focus-within:border-zinc-400 transition-all">
        <div id="attachments-container" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 p-3 pb-0 hidden"></div>
        <div class="flex items-end px-3 py-2.5 gap-2">
          <input type="file" multiple class="hidden" id="file-input" />
          <button type="button" id="attach-btn" class="p-2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-xl transition-colors" title="Add attachment">${uiIcon('paperclip', { size: 16 })}</button>
          <textarea id="prompt-textarea" rows="1" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}" class="flex-1 bg-transparent resize-none border-0 p-1 text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 leading-relaxed max-h-[240px] min-h-[36px]"></textarea>
          <button type="button" id="submit-btn" class="p-2 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 text-white dark:text-zinc-900 rounded-xl hover:opacity-90 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-sm flex-shrink-0" title="Send message">${uiIcon('arrow-up', { size: 16 })}</button>
        </div>
        ${chipsHtml ? `<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 px-3 pt-2 pb-2.5 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">${chipsHtml}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
    `;

    const textarea = this.querySelector("#prompt-textarea");
    const submitBtn = this.querySelector("#submit-btn");
    const fileInput = this.querySelector("#file-input");
    const attachBtn = this.querySelector("#attach-btn");

    textarea.addEventListener("input", () => {
      textarea.style.height = "auto";
      textarea.style.height = `${Math.max(Math.min(textarea.scrollHeight, 240), 48)}px`;
    });

    textarea.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
        if (e.isComposing) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        this.triggerSubmit();
      }
    });

    attachBtn.addEventListener("click", () => fileInput.click());
    fileInput.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      const files = Array.from(e.target.files);
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("attachments", { detail: files }));
      e.target.value = "";
    });

    submitBtn.addEventListener("click", () => this.triggerSubmit());

    this.querySelectorAll(".prompt-chip").forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const chip = this.chips.find((c) => String(c.id) === String(btn.getAttribute("data-chip-id")));
        if (chip) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("chip", { detail: chip }));
      });
    });
  }

  triggerSubmit() {
    const textarea = this.querySelector("#prompt-textarea");
    const val = textarea.value.trim();
    if (val) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("submit", { detail: val }));
      textarea.value = "";
      textarea.style.height = "48px";
    }
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("chat-prompt-input")) {
  customElements.define("chat-prompt-input", ChatPromptInput);
}
export default ChatPromptInput;

====/File: vanilla/ChatSessionList.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * ChatSessionList - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <chat-session-list active-id="2"></chat-session-list>
 * Sessions: property [{ id, title, timeLabel?, group? }] — optional `group`
 * labels (e.g. "Today") render collapsible headers; sessions without one go
 * to an uncollapsible "Recent" bucket. `user` property { name, email?,
 * avatarUrl? } renders a bottom user card. Events: select (detail: session),
 * delete (detail: { id }), user-click. Group collapse is internal view state.
 */
export class ChatSessionListElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['active-id', 'title', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._sessions = [];
    this._user = null;
    this._collapsedGroups = new Set();
  }

  get sessions() {
    return this._sessions;
  }

  set sessions(val) {
    this._sessions = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get user() {
    return this._user;
  }

  set user(val) {
    this._user = val && typeof val === 'object' ? val : null;
    this.render();
  }

  get activeId() {
    return this.getAttribute('active-id');
  }

  set activeId(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) this.removeAttribute('active-id');
    else this.setAttribute('active-id', String(val));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _sessionRow(s) {
    const isActive = String(s.id) === String(this.activeId);
    return `
      <li>
        <div
          role="button"
          tabindex="0"
          data-session-id="${escapeAttribute(s.id)}"
          class="session-item group w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-left text-sm cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
            isActive
              ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300'
              : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/70'
          }"
        >
          <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <span class="block truncate font-medium">${escapeAttribute(s.title)}</span>
            ${s.timeLabel ? `<span class="block text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(s.timeLabel)}</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-delete-id="${escapeAttribute(s.id)}"
            aria-label="Delete session"
            class="session-delete opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-all shrink-0"
          >${uiIcon('x', { size: 13 })}</button>
        </div>
      </li>`;
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Chats';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No conversations yet';

    const headerHtml = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
        ${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 15, className: 'text-indigo-500' })}
        ${escapeAttribute(title)}
        <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-zinc-400">${this._sessions.length}</span>
      </div>`;

    // Bottom user card
    let userHtml = '';
    if (this._user) {
      const initials = (this._user.name || '?')
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .map((w) => w[0])
        .slice(0, 2)
        .join('')
        .toUpperCase();
      userHtml = `
        <button type="button" class="user-card flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors text-left">
          ${
            this._user.avatarUrl
              ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(this._user.avatarUrl)}" alt="" class="h-7 w-7 rounded-full object-cover shrink-0" />`
              : `<span class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0">${escapeAttribute(initials)}</span>`
          }
          <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <span class="block truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(this._user.name)}</span>
            ${this._user.email ? `<span class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._user.email)}</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          ${uiIcon('settings', { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
        </button>`;
    }

    if (this._sessions.length === 0) {
      this._applyHostClass('flex flex-col w-64 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden');
      this.innerHTML = `${headerHtml}<div class="p-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</div>${userHtml}`;
      this._bindUserCard();
      return;
    }

    // Preserve the sessions' original order; group headers appear on first occurrence.
    const groups = [];
    this._sessions.forEach((s) => {
      const label = s.group || 'Recent';
      const existing = groups.find((g) => g.label === label);
      if (existing) existing.items.push(s);
      else groups.push({ label, items: [s] });
    });

    const groupsHtml = groups
      .map((group) => {
        if (group.label === 'Recent') {
          return `<div class="mb-1 last:mb-0"><ul class="space-y-0.5">${group.items.map((s) => this._sessionRow(s)).join('')}</ul></div>`;
        }
        const isCollapsed = this._collapsedGroups.has(group.label);
        return `
          <div class="mb-1 last:mb-0">
            <button type="button" data-group-label="${escapeAttribute(group.label)}" aria-expanded="${!isCollapsed}"
              class="group-toggle flex w-full items-center gap-1 px-2.5 pt-2 pb-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-500 dark:hover:text-zinc-300 transition-colors select-none">
              <span class="inline-flex transition-transform duration-150 ${isCollapsed ? '-rotate-90' : ''}">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 11 })}</span>
              <span class="flex-1 text-left">${escapeAttribute(group.label)}</span>
              <span class="font-mono font-normal">${group.items.length}</span>
            </button>
            ${isCollapsed ? '' : `<ul class="space-y-0.5">${group.items.map((s) => this._sessionRow(s)).join('')}</ul>`}
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this._applyHostClass('flex flex-col w-64 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden');
    this.innerHTML = `${headerHtml}<div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-1.5">${groupsHtml}</div>${userHtml}`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.group-toggle').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const label = btn.getAttribute('data-group-label');
        if (this._collapsedGroups.has(label)) this._collapsedGroups.delete(label);
        else this._collapsedGroups.add(label);
        this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.session-item').forEach((row) => {
      const id = row.getAttribute('data-session-id');
      const session = this._sessions.find((s) => String(s.id) === String(id));
      if (!session) return;
      const select = () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: session }));
      row.addEventListener('click', select);
      row.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          select();
        }
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.session-delete').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-delete-id');
        const session = this._sessions.find((s) => String(s.id) === String(id));
        if (session) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('delete', { detail: { id: session.id } }));
      });
    });

    this._bindUserCard();
  }

  _bindUserCard() {
    const card = this.querySelector('.user-card');
    if (card) {
      card.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('user-click')));
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('chat-session-list')) {
  customElements.define('chat-session-list', ChatSessionListElement);
}
export default ChatSessionListElement;

====/File: vanilla/CodeBlock.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const escapeText = escapeAttribute;

export class CodeBlockElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['language', 'filename', 'show-line-numbers', 'show-copy', 'max-height'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._code = '';
    this._copied = false;
  }

  get code() {
    return this._code;
  }

  set code(val) {
    this._code = String(val ?? '');
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._code && this.textContent.trim()) {
      this._code = this.textContent;
    }
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  async _handleCopy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(this._code);
      this._copied = true;
      this.render();
      setTimeout(() => {
        this._copied = false;
        this.render();
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      this._copied = false;
    }
  }

  render() {
    const language = this.getAttribute('language') || '';
    const filename = this.getAttribute('filename') || '';
    const showLineNumbers = this.hasAttribute('show-line-numbers');
    const showCopy = this.getAttribute('show-copy') !== 'false';
    const maxHeight = this.getAttribute('max-height') || '';
    const customClass = this.getAttribute('class') || '';

    const lines = this._code.replace(/\n$/, '').split('\n');

    const bodyHtml = showLineNumbers
      ? `<code>${lines
          .map(
            (line, idx) =>
              `<div class="flex"><span class="w-8 shrink-0 select-none text-right pr-3 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600">${idx + 1}</span><span class="flex-1">${escapeText(line) || ' '}</span></div>`
          )
          .join('')}</code>`
      : `<code>${escapeText(this._code)}</code>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="group relative rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 overflow-hidden text-sm font-mono ${escapeAttribute(customClass)}">
        ${(language || filename || showCopy) ? `
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-100/60 dark:bg-zinc-900/60">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              ${uiIcon('terminal', { size: 13, className: 'shrink-0' })}
              ${filename ? `<span class="font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 truncate">${escapeText(filename)}</span>` : ''}
              ${language ? `<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold tracking-wide shrink-0">${escapeText(language)}</span>` : ''}
            </div>
            ${showCopy ? `
              <button
                type="button"
                class="cb-copy-btn flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/70 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors shrink-0"
                aria-label="Copy code"
              >
                ${uiIcon(this._copied ? 'check' : 'copy', { size: 13, className: this._copied ? 'text-emerald-500' : '' })}
                <span class="hidden sm:inline">${this._copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</span>
              </button>
            ` : ''}
          </div>
        ` : ''}
        <div class="overflow-auto p-3.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200" ${maxHeight ? `style="max-height: ${escapeAttribute(maxHeight)}"` : ''}>
          <pre class="whitespace-pre">${bodyHtml}</pre>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    const copyBtn = this.querySelector('.cb-copy-btn');
    if (copyBtn) {
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this._handleCopy());
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('code-block')) {
  customElements.define('code-block', CodeBlockElement);
}
export default CodeBlockElement;

====/File: vanilla/CommandPalette.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class CommandPaletteElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'placeholder'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._activeIndex = 0;
    this._handleKey = this._handleKey.bind(this);
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(val) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get open() {
    return this.hasAttribute('open');
  }

  set open(val) {
    if (val) this.setAttribute('open', '');
    else this.removeAttribute('open');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._handleKey);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._handleKey);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
    if (name === 'open' && this.open && oldVal !== newVal) {
      this._query = '';
      this._activeIndex = 0;
    }
    this.render();
    if (name === 'open' && this.open) {
      const input = this.querySelector('.cmd-input');
      if (input) input.focus();
    }
  }

  _getFiltered() {
    if (!this._query.trim()) return this._items;
    const q = this._query.toLowerCase();
    return this._items.filter(
      (i) =>
        (i.label && i.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (i.hint && i.hint.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (i.group && i.group.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }

  _handleKey(e) {
    if (!this.open) return;
    const filtered = this._getFiltered();
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._close();
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._activeIndex = Math.min(filtered.length - 1, this._activeIndex + 1);
      this._renderList();
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._activeIndex = Math.max(0, this._activeIndex - 1);
      this._renderList();
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const item = filtered[this._activeIndex];
      if (item) this._select(item);
    }
  }

  _close() {
    this.open = false;
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
  }

  _select(item) {
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: item }));
    this._close();
  }

  _itemHtml(item, idx, showGroup) {
    const isActive = idx === this._activeIndex;
    return `
      ${showGroup ? `<div class="px-2.5 pt-2.5 pb-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.group)}</div>` : ''}
      <button
        type="button"
        data-item-id="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
        class="cmd-item w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-left text-sm transition-colors ${
          isActive ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
        }"
        role="option"
        aria-selected="${isActive}"
      >
        ${item.icon ? `<span class="p-1 rounded-md bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0">${uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
        <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <span class="block truncate font-medium">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
          ${item.hint ? `<span class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.hint)}</span>` : ''}
        </span>
        ${item.shortcut ? `<kbd class="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shrink-0">${escapeAttribute(item.shortcut)}</kbd>` : ''}
      </button>
    `;
  }

  _renderList() {
    const listbox = this.querySelector('[role="listbox"]');
    if (!listbox) return;
    const filtered = this._getFiltered();
    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      listbox.innerHTML = '<div class="p-4 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400">No results found</div>';
      return;
    }
    let lastGroup;
    listbox.innerHTML = filtered
      .map((item, idx) => {
        const showGroup = item.group && item.group !== lastGroup;
        lastGroup = item.group;
        return this._itemHtml(item, idx, showGroup);
      })
      .join('');
    this._bindItems();
  }

  _bindItems() {
    this.querySelectorAll('.cmd-item').forEach((btn, idx) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const item = this._items.find((i) => i.id === btn.getAttribute('data-item-id'));
        if (item) this._select(item);
      });
      btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        this._activeIndex = idx;
        this.querySelectorAll('.cmd-item').forEach((b, i) => {
          b.classList.toggle('bg-zinc-100', i === idx);
          b.classList.toggle('dark:bg-zinc-800', i === idx);
        });
      });
    });
  }

  render() {
    if (!this.open) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Type a command or search...';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="cmd-backdrop fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center pt-[15vh] bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Command palette">
        <div class="w-full max-w-lg mx-4 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
            ${uiIcon('search', { size: 16, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
            <input
              type="text"
              class="cmd-input w-full bg-transparent border-none text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
              placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}"
              value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}"
            />
            <kbd class="hidden sm:inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">ESC</kbd>
          </div>
          <div class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto p-1.5" role="listbox"></div>
          <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 px-4 py-2 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/30 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            ${[
              { keys: ['↑', '↓'], label: 'Navigate' },
              { keys: ['↵'], label: 'Select' },
              { keys: ['esc'], label: 'Close' },
            ]
              .map(
                ({ keys, label }) => `<span class="flex items-center gap-1">
                  ${keys.map((k) => `<kbd class="inline-flex min-w-[1.25rem] justify-center px-1 py-0.5 font-mono bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">${k}</kbd>`).join('')}
                  <span>${label}</span>
                </span>`
              )
              .join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    const backdrop = this.querySelector('.cmd-backdrop');
    const panel = backdrop?.querySelector('div');
    if (backdrop && panel) {
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', () => this._close());
      panel.addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    }

    const input = this.querySelector('.cmd-input');
    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        this._query = e.target.value;
        this._activeIndex = 0;
        this._renderList();
      });
    }

    this._renderList();
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('command-palette')) {
  customElements.define('command-palette', CommandPaletteElement);
}
export default CommandPaletteElement;

====/File: vanilla/CommentThread.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const initials = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/** Flat comments + parentId → depth-tagged render order (parents before children). */
const flattenComments = (comments) => {
  const children = new Map();
  const roots = [];
  comments.forEach((comment) => {
    if (comment.parentId == null) {
      roots.push(comment);
      return;
    }
    const key = String(comment.parentId);
    children.set(key, [...(children.get(key) || []), comment]);
  });
  const out = [];
  const walk = (list, depth) => {
    list.forEach((comment) => {
      out.push({ comment, depth });
      const replies = children.get(String(comment.id)) || [];
      if (depth < 2) walk(replies, depth + 1);
      else replies.forEach((child) => out.push({ comment: child, depth: depth + 1 }));
    });
  };
  walk(roots, 0);
  return out;
};

/**
 * CommentThread - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <comment-thread></comment-thread>
 * Properties: comments (CommentItem[], flat list linked by parentId)
 * Events: submit (detail: {text, parentId}), like (detail: comment), resolve (detail: comment)
 */
export class CommentThreadElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['placeholder', 'submit-text', 'allow-comment', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._comments = [];
    this._draft = '';
    this._replyTo = null;
    this._replyDraft = '';
  }

  get comments() {
    return this._comments;
  }

  set comments(value) {
    this._comments = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _submit(text, parentId) {
    const value = String(text || '').trim();
    if (!value) return;
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('submit', { detail: { text: value, parentId } }));
    if (parentId == null) this._draft = '';
    else {
      this._replyDraft = '';
      this._replyTo = null;
    }
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Write a comment...';
    const submitText = this.getAttribute('submit-text') || 'Comment';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No comments yet. Start the conversation.';
    const allowComment = this.getAttribute('allow-comment') !== 'false';
    const rows = flattenComments(this._comments);

    const list = rows.length
      ? `<ul class="space-y-2.5">
          ${rows
            .map(({ comment, depth }) => {
              const replying = this._replyTo != null && String(this._replyTo) === String(comment.id);
              const avatar = comment.avatar
                ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(comment.avatar)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />`
                : escapeAttribute(initials(comment.author));
              return `<li class="${depth > 0 ? 'border-l border-zinc-200 pl-3 dark:border-zinc-700' : ''}" data-comment="${escapeAttribute(comment.id)}">
                <div class="flex items-start gap-2">
                  <span class="flex ${depth > 0 ? 'h-5 w-5' : 'h-6 w-6'} shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${avatar}</span>
                  <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5">
                      <span class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(comment.author)}</span>
                      ${comment.time ? `<span class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(comment.time)}</span>` : ''}
                      ${
                        comment.resolved
                          ? `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400">${uiIcon('check', { size: 9 })}Resolved</span>`
                          : ''
                      }
                    </div>
                    <p class="mt-0.5 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(comment.text)}</p>
                    <div class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                      <button type="button" class="comment-like inline-flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400" aria-label="Like comment by ${escapeAttribute(comment.author)}">${uiIcon('thumbs-up', { size: 11 })}<span class="tabular-nums">${comment.likes || 0}</span></button>
                      <button type="button" class="comment-reply transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400" aria-expanded="${replying}">Reply</button>
                      <button type="button" class="comment-resolve transition-colors hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-emerald-400">${comment.resolved ? 'Reopen' : 'Resolve'}</button>
                    </div>
                    ${
                      replying
                        ? `<div class="mt-2 flex items-end gap-1.5">
                            <textarea class="comment-reply-input flex-1 resize-none rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-200" rows="2" placeholder="Reply to ${escapeAttribute(comment.author)}..." aria-label="Reply to ${escapeAttribute(comment.author)}">${escapeAttribute(this._replyDraft)}</textarea>
                            <button type="button" class="comment-reply-send rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50" ${this._replyDraft.trim() ? '' : 'disabled'}>Reply</button>
                          </div>`
                        : ''
                    }
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </ul>`
      : `<p class="py-4 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>`;

    const composer = allowComment
      ? `<div class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <textarea class="comment-input w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-200" rows="2" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}">${escapeAttribute(this._draft)}</textarea>
          <div class="mt-1.5 flex justify-end">
            <button type="button" class="comment-send rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50" ${this._draft.trim() ? '' : 'disabled'}>${escapeAttribute(submitText)}</button>
          </div>
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = list + composer;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-comment]').forEach((node) => {
      const id = node.getAttribute('data-comment');
      const comment = this._comments.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
      if (!comment) return;

      node.querySelector('.comment-like').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('like', { detail: comment }));
      });

      node.querySelector('.comment-reply').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._replyTo = this._replyTo != null && String(this._replyTo) === String(id) ? null : comment.id;
        this._replyDraft = '';
        this.render();
      });

      node.querySelector('.comment-resolve').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('resolve', { detail: comment }));
      });

      const replyInput = node.querySelector('.comment-reply-input');
      if (replyInput) {
        replyInput.focus();
        replyInput.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
          this._replyDraft = event.target.value;
          node.querySelector('.comment-reply-send').disabled = !this._replyDraft.trim();
        });
        node.querySelector('.comment-reply-send').addEventListener('click', () => {
          this._submit(this._replyDraft, comment.id);
          this.render();
        });
      }
    });

    const input = this.querySelector('.comment-input');
    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        this._draft = event.target.value;
        this.querySelector('.comment-send').disabled = !this._draft.trim();
      });
      this.querySelector('.comment-send').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._submit(this._draft, null);
        this.render();
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('comment-thread')) {
  customElements.define('comment-thread', CommentThreadElement);
}
export default CommentThreadElement;

====/File: vanilla/ConfirmDialog.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE_META = {
  danger: {
    chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400',
    button: 'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 focus-visible:ring-red-500',
    icon: 'alert-triangle',
  },
  warning: {
    chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400',
    button: 'bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 focus-visible:ring-amber-500',
    icon: 'alert-triangle',
  },
  default: {
    chip: 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400',
    button: 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
    icon: 'info',
  },
};

/**
 * ConfirmDialog - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <confirm-dialog open title="Delete project?" tone="danger"></confirm-dialog>
 * Events: confirm, cancel
 */
export class ConfirmDialogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'description', 'confirm-text', 'cancel-text', 'tone', 'require-text', 'loading'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._typed = '';
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
  }

  get isOpen() {
    return this.hasAttribute('open');
  }

  set isOpen(value) {
    if (value) this.setAttribute('open', '');
    else this.removeAttribute('open');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Clear the type-to-confirm field whenever the dialog is (re)opened.
    if (this.isOpen) this._typed = '';
    this.render();
  }

  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      // While a destructive action is in flight, Escape must not dismiss it.
      if (!this.hasAttribute('loading')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cancel'));
    }
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _closeEvent(name) {
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name));
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Are you sure?';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';
    const confirmText = this.getAttribute('confirm-text') || 'Confirm';
    const cancelText = this.getAttribute('cancel-text') || 'Cancel';
    const requireText = this.getAttribute('require-text') || '';
    const loading = this.hasAttribute('loading');
    const tone = TONE_META[this.getAttribute('tone')] ? this.getAttribute('tone') : 'default';
    const meta = TONE_META[tone];

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (!this.isOpen) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
      return;
    }

    const blocked = requireText ? this._typed !== requireText : false;
    const canConfirm = !blocked && !loading;

    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="confirm-overlay fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}">
        <div class="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-5 shadow-2xl">
          <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
            <span class="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${meta.chip}">${uiIcon(meta.icon, { size: 18 })}</span>
            <div class="min-w-0 pt-0.5">
              <h2 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
              ${description ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>

          ${
            requireText
              ? `<div class="mt-4">
            <label class="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Type <span class="font-mono font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(requireText)}</span> to confirm</label>
            <input type="text" class="confirm-typed w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(requireText)}" value="${escapeAttribute(this._typed)}" />
          </div>`
              : ''
          }

          <div class="mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2">
            <button type="button" class="confirm-cancel rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:opacity-50" ${loading ? 'disabled' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(cancelText)}</button>
            <button type="button" class="confirm-accept inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${meta.button}" ${canConfirm ? '' : 'disabled'}>
              ${loading ? `<span class="animate-spin">${uiIcon('loader', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}${escapeAttribute(confirmText)}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    const typedInput = this.querySelector('.confirm-typed');
    if (typedInput) {
      typedInput.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        this._typed = event.target.value;
        const accept = this.querySelector('.confirm-accept');
        if (accept) accept.disabled = this._typed !== requireText || loading;
      });
      typedInput.focus();
    }

    this.querySelector('.confirm-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!loading) this._closeEvent('cancel');
    });

    this.querySelector('.confirm-accept').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const blockedNow = requireText ? this._typed !== requireText : false;
      if (blockedNow || loading) return;
      this._closeEvent('confirm');
    });

    this.querySelector('.confirm-overlay').addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      if (event.target === event.currentTarget && !loading) this._closeEvent('cancel');
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('confirm-dialog')) {
  customElements.define('confirm-dialog', ConfirmDialogElement);
}
export default ConfirmDialogElement;

====/File: vanilla/ContextUsageBadge.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatNumber = (num) => {
  const n = Number(num) || 0;
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(n);
};

export class ContextUsageBadgeElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['used-tokens', 'max-tokens', 'model-name', 'compact'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._breakdown = [];
    this._isOpen = false;
  }

  get breakdown() {
    return this._breakdown;
  }

  set breakdown(val) {
    this._breakdown = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const used = Math.max(0, parseInt(this.getAttribute('used-tokens') || '0', 10) || 0);
    const max = Math.max(1, parseInt(this.getAttribute('max-tokens') || '1', 10) || 1);
    const model = this.getAttribute('model-name') || '';
    const compact = this.hasAttribute('compact');
    const percentage = Math.min(100, Math.round((used / max) * 100));

    let barColor = 'bg-emerald-500';
    if (percentage >= 90) barColor = 'bg-rose-500';
    else if (percentage >= 70) barColor = 'bg-amber-500';

    this._applyHostClass('relative inline-block text-xs font-sans select-none');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <button
        type="button"
        class="ctx-btn flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-colors shadow-sm"
        aria-label="Context Window Usage"
        aria-expanded="${this._isOpen}"
      >
        ${uiIcon('cpu', { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
        ${model && !compact ? `<span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium truncate max-w-[120px]">${escapeAttribute(model)}</span>` : ''}
        <div class="w-16 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
          <div class="h-full transition-all duration-300 ${barColor}" style="width: ${percentage}%"></div>
        </div>
        <span class="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">${percentage}%</span>
      </button>

      <div
        class="ctx-popover ${this._isOpen ? 'block' : 'hidden'} absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-2 w-64 p-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-xl z-30"
      >
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">Context Window</span>
          <span class="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500">${formatNumber(used)} / ${formatNumber(max)}</span>
        </div>
        ${model ? `
          <div class="pt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 flex justify-between">
            <span>Model</span>
            <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium">${escapeAttribute(model)}</span>
          </div>
        ` : ''}
        ${this._breakdown.length > 0 ? `
          <div class="pt-2.5 space-y-1.5">
            <div class="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-zinc-400 tracking-wider">Breakdown</div>
            ${this._breakdown.map((item) => `
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${escapeAttribute(item.colorClass || 'bg-zinc-400')}"></span>
                  ${escapeAttribute(item.label)}
                </span>
                <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">${formatNumber(item.count)}</span>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        ` : ''}
      </div>
    `;

    const btn = this.querySelector('.ctx-btn');
    const pop = this.querySelector('.ctx-popover');
    if (btn && pop) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._isOpen = !this._isOpen;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(this._isOpen));
        if (this._isOpen) pop.classList.remove('hidden');
        else pop.classList.add('hidden');
      });
      btn.addEventListener('blur', () => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          this._isOpen = false;
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          pop.classList.add('hidden');
        }, 200);
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('context-usage-badge')) {
  customElements.define('context-usage-badge', ContextUsageBadgeElement);
}
export default ContextUsageBadgeElement;

====/File: vanilla/DataTable.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const alignClass = (align) => (align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : align === 'center' ? 'text-center' : 'text-left');

export class DataTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['columns', 'rows', 'selectable', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._columns = [];
    this._rows = [];
    this._sortKey = null;
    this._sortDir = 'asc';
    this._selected = new Set();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get columns() {
    if (this._columns.length) return this._columns;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('columns') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set columns(value) {
    this._columns = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get rows() {
    if (this._rows.length) return this._rows;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('rows') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set rows(value) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._selected = new Set();
    this.render();
  }

  get actions() {
    return this._actions || [];
  }

  set actions(value) {
    this._actions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get selectable() {
    return this.hasAttribute('selectable') && this.getAttribute('selectable') !== 'false';
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _sortedRows() {
    const rows = this.rows;
    if (!this._sortKey) return rows;
    const dir = this._sortDir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
    return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
      const av = a[this._sortKey];
      const bv = b[this._sortKey];
      if (av === bv) return 0;
      return (String(av ?? '') > String(bv ?? '') ? 1 : -1) * dir;
    });
  }

  render() {
    const columns = this.columns;
    const rows = this._sortedRows();
    const actions = this.actions;
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No results';
    const selectable = this.selectable;
    const allSelected = rows.length > 0 && this._selected.size === rows.length;

    this._applyHostClass('relative');

    const headCells = columns
      .map((column) => {
        const icon = this._sortKey === column.key ? (this._sortDir === 'asc' ? 'arrow-up' : 'arrow-down') : 'chevron-down';
        return `<th style="${column.width ? `width:${escapeAttribute(column.width)}` : ''}" class="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ${alignClass(column.align)}">
          <button type="button" data-sort="${escapeAttribute(column.key)}" class="sort-btn inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">
            ${escapeAttribute(column.label)}<span class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">${uiIcon(icon, { size: 11 })}</span>
          </button>
        </th>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const bodyRows =
      rows.length === 0
        ? `<tr><td colspan="${columns.length + (selectable ? 1 : 0) + (actions.length ? 1 : 0)}" class="px-3 py-10 text-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</td></tr>`
        : rows
            .map((row, index) => {
              const cells = columns
                .map(
                  (column) =>
                    `<td class="px-3 py-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 ${alignClass(column.align)} ${column.align === 'right' ? 'tabular-nums' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(row[column.key] ?? '—')}</td>`
                )
                .join('');
              const checkbox = selectable
                ? `<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="checkbox" data-row="${index}" ${this._selected.has(index) ? 'checked' : ''} aria-label="Select row ${index + 1}" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600" /></td>`
                : '';
              const actionCell = actions.length
                ? `<td class="px-3 py-2"><div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">${actions
                    .map(
                      (action, ai) =>
                        `<button type="button" data-action="${ai}" data-row="${index}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(action.label)}" title="${escapeAttribute(action.label)}" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">${uiIcon(action.icon || 'more-horizontal', { size: 14 })}</button>`
                    )
                    .join('')}</div></td>`
                : '';
              return `<tr class="group hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors">${checkbox}${cells}${actionCell}</tr>`;
            })
            .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <table class="w-full text-xs">
          <thead class="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60"><tr>
            ${selectable ? `<th class="w-10 px-3 py-2"><input type="checkbox" data-select-all ${allSelected ? 'checked' : ''} aria-label="Select all rows" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600" /></th>` : ''}
            ${headCells}
            ${actions.length ? '<th class="w-20 px-3 py-2"></th>' : ''}
          </tr></thead>
          <tbody class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${bodyRows}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      ${
        selectable && this._selected.size > 0
