          ? `<div class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-20 flex -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 px-4 py-2 shadow-lg">
              <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${this._selected.size} selected</span>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-1">${actions
                .map(
                  (action, ai) =>
                    `<button type="button" data-batch="${ai}" class="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors">${escapeAttribute(action.label)}</button>`
                )
                .join('')}</div>
              <button type="button" data-clear aria-label="Clear selection" class="rounded-full p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700">${uiIcon('x', { size: 13 })}</button>
            </div>`
          : ''
      }`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const key = btn.getAttribute('data-sort');
        this._sortDir = this._sortKey === key && this._sortDir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        this._sortKey = key;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sort', { detail: { key, direction: this._sortDir } }));
        this.render();
      });
    });

    const allBox = this.querySelector('[data-select-all]');
    if (allBox)
      allBox.addEventListener('change', () => {
        this._selected = allBox.checked ? new Set(rows.map((_, i) => i)) : new Set();
        this.render();
      });

    this.querySelectorAll('input[data-row]').forEach((box) => {
      box.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const index = Number(box.getAttribute('data-row'));
        box.checked ? this._selected.add(index) : this._selected.delete(index);
        this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const row = rows[Number(btn.getAttribute('data-row'))];
        const action = actions[Number(btn.getAttribute('data-action'))];
        action?.onClick?.(row);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { action, row } }));
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-batch]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const action = actions[Number(btn.getAttribute('data-batch'))];
        this._selected.forEach((index) => action?.onClick?.(rows[index]));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('batch', { detail: { action, rows: [...this._selected].map((i) => rows[i]) } }));
        this._selected = new Set();
        this.render();
      });
    });

    const clearBtn = this.querySelector('[data-clear]');
    if (clearBtn)
      clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._selected = new Set();
        this.render();
      });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('data-table')) {
  customElements.define('data-table', DataTableElement);
}
export default DataTableElement;

====/File: vanilla/DatePicker.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];
const WEEKDAYS = ['Su', 'Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa'];

const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
const toIso = (year, month, day) => `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-${pad(day)}`;

const parseIso = (iso) => {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(iso || '');
  if (!match) return null;
  return { year: Number(match[1]), month: Number(match[2]) - 1, day: Number(match[3]) };
};

const todayIso = () => {
  const now = new Date();
  return toIso(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
};

/**
 * DatePicker - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <date-picker value="2026-11-14" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31"></date-picker>
 * Events: change (detail: 'YYYY-MM-DD')
 */
export class DatePickerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'min', 'max', 'week-starts-on', 'show-today', 'disabled'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    const initial = parseIso(this.getAttribute('value')) || parseIso(todayIso());
    this._view = { year: initial.year, month: initial.month };
  }

  get value() {
    return this.getAttribute('value') || '';
  }

  set value(next) {
    if (next) this.setAttribute('value', next);
    else this.removeAttribute('value');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const selected = parseIso(this.getAttribute('value'));
    if (selected) this._view = { year: selected.year, month: selected.month };
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    const selected = parseIso(this.getAttribute('value'));
    if (selected) this._view = { year: selected.year, month: selected.month };
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _shift(delta) {
    const next = new Date(this._view.year, this._view.month + delta, 1);
    this._view = { year: next.getFullYear(), month: next.getMonth() };
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const value = this.getAttribute('value') || '';
    const min = this.getAttribute('min') || '';
    const max = this.getAttribute('max') || '';
    const weekStartsOn = Number(this.getAttribute('week-starts-on') || 1) === 0 ? 0 : 1;
    const showToday = this.getAttribute('show-today') !== 'false';
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled') && this.getAttribute('disabled') !== 'false';
    const today = todayIso();

    const iso = (day) => toIso(this._view.year, this._view.month, day);
    const isDisabled = (day) => {
      if (disabled) return true;
      const candidate = iso(day);
      if (min && candidate < min) return true;
      if (max && candidate > max) return true;
      return false;
    };

    const first = new Date(this._view.year, this._view.month, 1).getDay();
    const lead = (first - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
    const total = new Date(this._view.year, this._view.month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const cells = Array.from({ length: lead }, () => null);
    for (let day = 1; day <= total; day += 1) cells.push(day);
    while (cells.length % 7 !== 0) cells.push(null);

    const weekdays = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => WEEKDAYS[(i + weekStartsOn) % 7]);

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="w-full max-w-[17rem] rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-3">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button type="button" class="date-prev rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200" aria-label="Previous month">${uiIcon('chevron-left', { size: 14 })}</button>
          <span class="flex-1 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${MONTHS[this._view.month]} ${this._view.year}</span>
          <button type="button" class="date-next rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200" aria-label="Next month">${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 14 })}</button>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-2 grid grid-cols-7 gap-0.5">
          ${weekdays
            .map((label) => `<span class="py-1 text-center text-[10px] font-medium uppercase text-zinc-400">${label}</span>`)
            .join('')}
          ${cells
            .map((day) => {
              if (day === null) return '<span></span>';
              const date = iso(day);
              const blocked = isDisabled(day);
              const selected = value === date;
              const isToday = date === today;
              const tone = selected
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'
                : isToday
                  ? 'font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
              return `<button type="button" class="date-day flex h-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[11px] tabular-nums transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 disabled:hover:bg-transparent dark:disabled:text-zinc-600 ${tone}"
                data-date="${date}" aria-label="${date}" aria-pressed="${selected}" ${blocked ? 'disabled' : ''}>${day}</button>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </div>

        ${
          showToday
            ? `<div class="mt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <button type="button" class="date-today w-full rounded-md py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40">Today</button>
              </div>`
            : ''
        }
      </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.date-prev').addEventListener('click', () => this._shift(-1));
    this.querySelector('.date-next').addEventListener('click', () => this._shift(1));

    this.querySelectorAll('.date-day').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (button.hasAttribute('disabled')) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: button.getAttribute('data-date') }));
      });
    });

    const todayButton = this.querySelector('.date-today');
    if (todayButton) {
      todayButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (disabled) return;
        if ((min && today < min) || (max && today > max)) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: today }));
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('date-picker')) {
  customElements.define('date-picker', DatePickerElement);
}
export default DatePickerElement;

====/File: vanilla/DiffViewer.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const LINE_STYLE = {
  add: { row: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300', gutter: 'text-emerald-500', sign: '+' },
  remove: { row: 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300', gutter: 'text-rose-500', sign: '-' },
  context: { row: 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400', gutter: 'text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600', sign: ' ' },
};

/**
 * Walks the diff once and produces render rows. Long runs of context lines
 * (> contextSize*2) become a collapsible gap that keeps `contextSize` lines
 * visible on each side; the hidden middle travels with the row so expanding
 * needs no second pass over the source.
 */
const buildRows = (lines, contextSize) => {
  const rows = [];
  let oldNo = 0;
  let newNo = 0;
  let contextRun = [];

  const pushLine = (entry) => {
    rows.push({ kind: 'line', line: entry.line, meta: LINE_STYLE.context, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` });
  };

  const flushContext = (isTail) => {
    if (contextRun.length <= contextSize * 2) {
      contextRun.forEach(pushLine);
    } else {
      const hidden = isTail
        ? contextRun.slice(contextSize)
        : contextRun.slice(contextSize, contextRun.length - contextSize);
      contextRun.slice(0, contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
      rows.push({ kind: 'collapsed', count: hidden.length, hidden, key: `gap-${rows.length}-${hidden.length}` });
      if (!isTail) contextRun.slice(contextRun.length - contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
    }
    contextRun = [];
  };

  lines.forEach((line) => {
    if (line.type !== 'add') oldNo += 1;
    if (line.type !== 'remove') newNo += 1;

    if (line.type === 'context') {
      contextRun.push({ line, oldNo, newNo });
      return;
    }
    flushContext(false);
    rows.push({
      kind: 'line',
      line,
      meta: LINE_STYLE[line.type] || LINE_STYLE.context,
      oldNo: line.type !== 'add' ? oldNo : '',
      newNo: line.type !== 'remove' ? newNo : '',
      key: `c-${rows.length}`,
    });
  });

  flushContext(true);
  return rows;
};

/**
 * DiffViewer - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <diff-viewer filename="app.ts" language="ts"></diff-viewer>
 * Legacy: `lines` property/attr (JSON). Multi-file: `files` property
 * [{ filename, language?, lines }] renders a tab bar. Long unchanged context
 * runs fold into "⋯ N unchanged lines" rows that expand in place
 * (`context-size` attribute, default 3). Toggle state is internal view state.
 */
class DiffViewerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['filename', 'language', 'show-line-numbers', 'context-size', 'lines', 'files'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._lines = [];
    this._files = [];
    this._activeFileIdx = 0;
    this._expandedGaps = new Set();
  }

  get lines() {
    if (this._lines) return this._lines;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('lines') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set lines(val) {
    this._lines = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get files() {
    if (this._files) return this._files;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('files') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set files(val) {
    this._files = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this._activeFileIdx = 0;
    this._expandedGaps = new Set();
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (name === 'lines') this._lines = null; // re-read from attribute
    if (name === 'files') {
      this._files = null; // re-read from attribute
      this._activeFileIdx = 0;
      this._expandedGaps = new Set();
    }
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const multiFile = this.files.length > 0;
    const activeIdx = multiFile ? Math.min(this._activeFileIdx, this.files.length - 1) : 0;
    const active = multiFile ? this.files[activeIdx] : null;
    const activeLines = active ? active.lines || [] : this.lines;
    const activeFilename = active ? active.filename : this.getAttribute('filename') || '';
    const activeLanguage = active ? active.language : this.getAttribute('language') || '';
    const showLineNumbers = this.getAttribute('show-line-numbers') !== 'false';
    const contextSize = Math.max(0, parseInt(this.getAttribute('context-size') || '3', 10) || 0);

    const added = activeLines.filter((l) => l.type === 'add').length;
    const removed = activeLines.filter((l) => l.type === 'remove').length;

    // Multi-file tab bar
    const tabsHtml = multiFile
      ? `<div role="tablist" class="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 px-1.5 pt-1.5">
          ${this.files
            .map((file, idx) => {
              const isActive = idx === activeIdx;
              const fAdded = (file.lines || []).filter((l) => l.type === 'add').length;
              const fRemoved = (file.lines || []).filter((l) => l.type === 'remove').length;
              return `<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="${isActive}" data-file-idx="${idx}"
                  class="diff-tab flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-t-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] transition-colors ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'border border-b-0 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'
                      : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }">
                  <span class="max-w-[10rem] truncate">${escapeAttribute(file.filename)}</span>
                  <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+${fAdded}</span>
                  <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-${fRemoved}</span>
                </button>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : '';

    const headerHtml = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs">
        ${uiIcon('git-branch', { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
        ${activeFilename ? `<span class="font-mono font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 truncate">${escapeAttribute(activeFilename)}</span>` : ''}
        ${activeLanguage ? `<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700/70 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(activeLanguage)}</span>` : ''}
        <span class="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
          <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+${added}</span>
          <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-${removed}</span>
        </span>
      </div>`;

    const rows = buildRows(activeLines, contextSize);

    const lineRow = (line, meta, oldNo, newNo) => `
      <div class="flex ${meta.row}">
        ${
          showLineNumbers
            ? `<span class="w-16 shrink-0 select-none px-2 text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 tabular-nums">${oldNo} ${newNo}</span>`
            : ''
        }
        <span class="w-5 shrink-0 select-none text-center ${meta.gutter}">${meta.sign}</span>
        <span class="flex-1 min-w-0 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words pr-3">${escapeAttribute(line.content)}</span>
      </div>`;

    const rowsHtml = rows
      .map((row) => {
        if (row.kind === 'collapsed') {
          if (!this._expandedGaps.has(row.key)) {
            return `<button type="button" data-gap-key="${escapeAttribute(row.key)}"
                class="diff-gap-toggle flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none">
                ${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 12 })}
                <span class="font-mono">⋯ ${row.count} unchanged lines</span>
              </button>`;
          }
          return `${(row.hidden || [])
            .map((entry) => lineRow(entry.line, LINE_STYLE.context, entry.oldNo, entry.newNo))
            .join('')}
            <button type="button" data-gap-key="${escapeAttribute(row.key)}"
              class="diff-gap-toggle flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none">
              ${uiIcon('minus', { size: 12 })}
              <span class="font-mono">Collapse unchanged lines</span>
            </button>`;
        }
        return lineRow(row.line, row.meta, row.oldNo, row.newNo);
      })
      .join('');

    this._applyHostClass('block rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden');
    this.innerHTML = `
      ${tabsHtml}
      ${headerHtml}
      <div class="overflow-x-auto text-[13px] font-mono leading-relaxed">
        ${rowsHtml || '<div class="p-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No changes</div>'}
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.diff-tab').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._activeFileIdx = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-file-idx') || '0', 10);
        this._expandedGaps = new Set();
        this.render();
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.diff-gap-toggle').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const key = btn.getAttribute('data-gap-key');
        if (this._expandedGaps.has(key)) this._expandedGaps.delete(key);
        else this._expandedGaps.add(key);
        this.render();
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('diff-viewer')) {
  customElements.define('diff-viewer', DiffViewerElement);
}
export default DiffViewerElement;

====/File: vanilla/EmptyState.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class EmptyStateElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['icon', 'title', 'description', 'action-label'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const icon = this.getAttribute('icon') || 'sparkles';
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';
    const actionLabel = this.getAttribute('action-label') || '';

    this._applyHostClass('flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-6 py-12');
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 mb-4">
        ${uiIcon(icon, { size: 24 })}
      </div>
      <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</div>
      ${description ? `<div class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 max-w-xs">${escapeAttribute(description)}</div>` : ''}
      ${
        actionLabel
          ? `<button type="button" class="empty-action mt-4 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors">${escapeAttribute(actionLabel)}</button>`
          : ''
      }`;

    const btn = this.querySelector('.empty-action');
    if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action')));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('empty-state')) {
  customElements.define('empty-state', EmptyStateElement);
}
export default EmptyStateElement;

====/File: vanilla/FileAttachmentList.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatFileSize = (bytes) => {
  if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null || Number.isNaN(bytes)) return '';
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
};

const iconForType = (type, name) => {
  if (type && type.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';
  const ext = (name || '').split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
  if (['js', 'ts', 'tsx', 'jsx', 'py', 'java', 'go', 'rs', 'vue', 'html', 'css', 'json', 'sh'].includes(ext)) return 'code';
  return 'paperclip';
};

export class FileAttachmentListElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._files = [];
  }

  get files() {
    return this._files;
  }

  set files(val) {
    this._files = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    if (this._files.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this._applyHostClass('flex flex-wrap gap-2');
    this.innerHTML = this._files
      .map((f) => {
        const sizeText = formatFileSize(f.size);
        return `
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 pr-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
            ${uiIcon(iconForType(f.type, f.name), { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
            <span class="max-w-40 truncate font-medium">${escapeAttribute(f.name)}</span>
            ${sizeText ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 shrink-0">${escapeAttribute(sizeText)}</span>` : ''}
            <button
              type="button"
              data-file-id="${escapeAttribute(f.id)}"
              aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(f.name)}"
              class="file-remove p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-colors shrink-0"
            >${uiIcon('x', { size: 12 })}</button>
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.querySelectorAll('.file-remove').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-file-id');
        const file = this._files.find((f) => String(f.id) === String(id));
        if (file) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove', { detail: { id: file.id } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('file-attachment-list')) {
  customElements.define('file-attachment-list', FileAttachmentListElement);
}
export default FileAttachmentListElement;

====/File: vanilla/FileDropzone.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatBytes = (bytes) => {
  if (!bytes) return '0 B';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const exp = Math.min(units.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)));
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exp;
  return `${value >= 10 || exp === 0 ? Math.round(value) : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[exp]}`;
};

const matchesAccept = (file, accept) => {
  if (!accept) return true;
  return accept
    .split(',')
    .map((token) => token.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .some((token) => {
      if (token.startsWith('.')) return file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(token);
      if (token.endsWith('/*')) return Boolean(file.type && file.type.toLowerCase().startsWith(token.slice(0, -1)));
      return file.type && file.type.toLowerCase() === token;
    });
};

const fileIcon = (file) => {
  if (file.type && file.type.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';
  if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|rs|json|css|html)$/i.test(file.name)) return 'code';
  return 'paperclip';
};

/**
 * FileDropzone - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <file-dropzone accept="image/*" max-size-mb="5"></file-dropzone>
 * Events: files (detail: File[]), reject (detail: [{name, reason}]), remove (detail: {file, index})
 */
export class FileDropzoneElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['accept', 'multiple', 'max-size-mb', 'hint', 'disabled'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._files = [];
    this._dragging = false;
    this._error = null;
  }

  get files() {
    return this._files;
  }

  set files(value) {
    this._files = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _handleFiles(list) {
    const incoming = Array.from(list || []);
    if (incoming.length === 0) return;

    const accept = this.getAttribute('accept') || '';
    const maxSizeMb = Number(this.getAttribute('max-size-mb') || 0) || 0;
    const multiple = !this.hasAttribute('multiple') || this.getAttribute('multiple') !== 'false';

    const rejected = [];
    const accepted = incoming.filter((file) => {
      if (!matchesAccept(file, accept)) {
        rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'type' });
        return false;
      }
      if (maxSizeMb && file.size > maxSizeMb * 1024 * 1024) {
        rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'size' });
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    if (rejected.length) {
      this._error =
        rejected[0].reason === 'size'
          ? `${rejected[0].name} is larger than ${maxSizeMb} MB`
          : `${rejected[0].name} is not an accepted file type`;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reject', { detail: rejected }));
    } else {
      this._error = null;
    }

    if (accepted.length) {
      this.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('files', { detail: multiple ? accepted : accepted.slice(0, 1) })
      );
    }
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const accept = this.getAttribute('accept') || '';
    const multiple = !this.hasAttribute('multiple') || this.getAttribute('multiple') !== 'false';
    const maxSizeMb = Number(this.getAttribute('max-size-mb') || 0) || 0;
    const hint = this.getAttribute('hint') || '';
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled') && this.getAttribute('disabled') !== 'false';

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const hintText =
      hint ||
      [accept ? `Accepts ${accept}` : null, maxSizeMb ? `up to ${maxSizeMb} MB` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') ||
      'Any file type';

    const dropClass = this._dragging
      ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30'
      : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600';

    const fileRows = this._files
      .map(
        (file, index) => `
        <li class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1.5">
          <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon(fileIcon(file), { size: 14 })}</span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(file.name)}</span>
            <span class="block text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">${formatBytes(file.size)}</span>
          </span>
          <button type="button" class="file-remove shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            data-index="${index}" aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(file.name)}">${uiIcon('x', { size: 12 })}</button>
        </li>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="dropzone flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-7 text-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${dropClass} ${disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : ''}"
        role="button" tabindex="${disabled ? -1 : 0}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(hint || 'Drop files here or browse')}" ${disabled ? 'aria-disabled="true"' : ''}>
        <span class="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('upload', { size: 16 })}</span>
        <p class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Drag &amp; drop ${multiple ? 'files' : 'a file'} here, or <span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">browse</span></p>
        <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(hintText)}</p>
        <input type="file" class="dropzone-input hidden" ${accept ? `accept="${escapeAttribute(accept)}"` : ''} ${multiple ? 'multiple' : ''} ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} />
      </div>

      ${
        this._error
          ? `<p role="alert" class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400"><span>${uiIcon('alert-triangle', { size: 12 })}</span>${escapeAttribute(this._error)}</p>`
          : ''
      }

      ${fileRows ? `<ul class="file-list mt-3 space-y-1.5">${fileRows}</ul>` : ''}
    `;

    const zone = this.querySelector('.dropzone');
    const input = this.querySelector('.dropzone-input');

    zone.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!disabled) input.click();
    });

    zone.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if ((event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') && !disabled) {
        event.preventDefault();
        input.click();
      }
    });

    zone.addEventListener('dragover', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (!disabled && !this._dragging) {
        this._dragging = true;
        this.render();
      }
    });

    zone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
      if (this._dragging) {
        this._dragging = false;
        this.render();
      }
    });

    zone.addEventListener('drop', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      this._dragging = false;
      if (!disabled) this._handleFiles(event.dataTransfer && event.dataTransfer.files);
      else this.render();
    });

    input.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
      this._handleFiles(event.target.files);
      event.target.value = '';
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.file-remove').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        const index = Number(button.getAttribute('data-index'));
        const file = this._files[index];
        if (!file) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove', { detail: { file, index } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('file-dropzone')) {
  customElements.define('file-dropzone', FileDropzoneElement);
}
export default FileDropzoneElement;

====/File: vanilla/FilterBar.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * FilterBar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <filter-bar></filter-bar>
 * Properties: filters (FilterDefinition[]), selected (Record<string, string[]>)
 * Events: change (detail: selected map), clear
 */
export class FilterBarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return [];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._filters = [];
    this._selected = {};
    this._openId = null;
    this._onPointerDown = (event) => {
      if (!this.contains(event.target)) this._close();
    };
    this._onKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') this._close();
    };
  }

  get filters() {
    return this._filters;
  }

  set filters(value) {
    this._filters = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get selected() {
    return this._selected;
  }

  set selected(value) {
    this._selected = value && typeof value === 'object' ? { ...value } : {};
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _close() {
    if (this._openId === null) return;
    this._openId = null;
    this.render();
  }

  _commit(next) {
    this._selected = next;
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: next }));
  }

  _toggleOption(filterId, value) {
    const values = this._selected[filterId] || [];
    const nextValues = values.includes(value) ? values.filter((entry) => entry !== value) : [...values, value];
    const next = { ...this._selected };
    if (nextValues.length > 0) next[filterId] = nextValues;
    else delete next[filterId];
    this._commit(next);
  }

  _clearAll() {
    this._commit({});
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('clear'));
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5');

    const activeCount = Object.values(this._selected).reduce((total, values) => total + values.length, 0);

    const chips = this._filters
      .map((filter) => {
        const values = this._selected[filter.id] || [];
        const active = values.length > 0;
        const open = this._openId === filter.id;
        const options = filter.options
          .map((option) => {
            const checked = values.includes(option.value);
            return `<button type="button" data-filter-id="${escapeAttribute(filter.id)}" data-value="${escapeAttribute(option.value)}" aria-pressed="${checked}"
              class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
              <span class="flex h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border ${
                checked ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600'
              }">${checked ? uiIcon('check', { size: 9, strokeWidth: 3 }) : ''}</span>
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">${escapeAttribute(option.label)}</span>
              ${option.count !== undefined ? `<span class="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(option.count)}</span>` : ''}
            </button>`;
          })
          .join('');
        return `<div class="relative">
          <button type="button" data-filter-toggle="${escapeAttribute(filter.id)}" aria-expanded="${open}" aria-haspopup="true"
            class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              active
                ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300'
                : 'border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600'
            }">
            <span>${escapeAttribute(filter.label)}</span>
            ${active ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-1 text-[9px] tabular-nums text-white">${values.length}</span>` : ''}
            <span class="${open ? 'rotate-180 transition-transform' : 'transition-transform'}">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 11 })}</span>
          </button>
          ${
            open
              ? `<div class="absolute left-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 w-48 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">${options}</div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `${chips}${
      activeCount > 0
        ? `<button type="button" data-filter-clear class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">${uiIcon('x', { size: 11 })}Clear all</button>`
        : ''
    }`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-filter-toggle]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = node.getAttribute('data-filter-toggle');
        this._openId = this._openId === id ? null : id;
        this.render();
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-filter-id]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () =>
        this._toggleOption(node.getAttribute('data-filter-id'), node.getAttribute('data-value'))
      );
    });
    const clear = this.querySelector('[data-filter-clear]');
    if (clear) clear.addEventListener('click', () => this._clearAll());
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('filter-bar')) {
  customElements.define('filter-bar', FilterBarElement);
}
export default FilterBarElement;

====/File: vanilla/FooterSection.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * FooterSection - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <footer-section brand="Acme" tagline="Ship faster" copyright="© 2026 Acme"></footer-section>
 * Properties: columns (FooterColumn[]), socials ({label, icon}[])
 * Events: link-click (detail: link)
 */
export class FooterSectionElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['brand', 'tagline', 'copyright'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._columns = [];
    this._socials = [];
  }

  get columns() {
    return this._columns;
  }

  set columns(value) {
    this._columns = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get socials() {
    return this._socials;
  }

  set socials(value) {
    this._socials = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const brand = this.getAttribute('brand') || '';
    const tagline = this.getAttribute('tagline') || '';
    const copyright = this.getAttribute('copyright') || `© ${new Date().getFullYear()} ${brand}`.trim();

    const brandHtml =
      brand || tagline
        ? `<div class="md:w-56 md:shrink-0">
            ${
              brand
                ? `<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white">${uiIcon('layers', { size: 15 })}</span>
                    <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(brand)}</span>
                  </div>`
                : ''
            }
            ${tagline ? `<p class="mt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tagline)}</p>` : ''}
          </div>`
        : '';

    const columnsHtml = this._columns.length
      ? `<div class="grid flex-1 grid-cols-2 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-3">
          ${this._columns
            .map(
              (column) => `<div>
                <h3 class="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(column.title)}</h3>
                <ul class="mt-3 space-y-2">
                  ${(column.links || [])
                    .map(
                      (link) =>
                        `<li><button type="button" class="footer-link rounded text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:text-indigo-400" data-label="${escapeAttribute(link.label)}">${escapeAttribute(link.label)}</button></li>`
                    )
                    .join('')}
                </ul>
              </div>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : '';

    const socialsHtml = this._socials.length
      ? `<ul class="flex items-center gap-1">
          ${this._socials
            .map(
              (social) =>
                `<li><button type="button" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(social.label)}" title="${escapeAttribute(social.label)}"
                  class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">${uiIcon(social.icon || 'globe', { size: 14 })}</button></li>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </ul>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<footer class="border-t border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950">
      <div class="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col gap-8 px-4 py-10 md:flex-row md:gap-12">
        ${brandHtml}
        ${columnsHtml}
      </div>
      <div class="border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-900">
        <div class="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-4 sm:flex-row">
          <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(copyright)}</p>
          ${socialsHtml}
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.footer-link').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const label = button.getAttribute('data-label');
        const link = this._columns
          .flatMap((column) => column.links || [])
          .find((entry) => entry.label === label);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('link-click', { detail: link || { label } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('footer-section')) {
  customElements.define('footer-section', FooterSectionElement);
}
export default FooterSectionElement;
