import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * HeroSection - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <hero-section title="Ship faster" eyebrow="New" primary-cta="Start" align="center"></hero-section>
 * Properties: highlights (string[])
 * Events: primary, secondary
 */
export class HeroSectionElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['eyebrow', 'title', 'description', 'primary-cta', 'secondary-cta', 'align'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._highlights = [];
  }

  get highlights() {
    return this._highlights;
  }

  set highlights(value) {
    this._highlights = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const eyebrow = this.getAttribute('eyebrow') || '';
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';
    const primaryCta = this.getAttribute('primary-cta') || '';
    const secondaryCta = this.getAttribute('secondary-cta') || '';
    const centered = (this.getAttribute('align') || 'center') !== 'left';

    const eyebrowHtml = eyebrow
      ? `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300">
          ${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 12 })}${escapeAttribute(eyebrow)}</span>`
      : '';

    const descriptionHtml = description
      ? `<p class="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ${centered ? 'mx-auto' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>`
      : '';

    const buttons = [
      primaryCta
        ? `<button type="button" class="hero-primary rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-950">${escapeAttribute(primaryCta)}</button>`
        : '',
      secondaryCta
        ? `<button type="button" class="hero-secondary rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(secondaryCta)}</button>`
        : '',
    ].join('');
    const buttonsHtml = buttons
      ? `<div class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 ${centered ? 'justify-center' : ''}">${buttons}</div>`
      : '';

    const highlightsHtml = this._highlights.length
      ? `<ul class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-2 ${centered ? 'justify-center' : ''}">
          ${this._highlights
            .map(
              (item) =>
                `<li class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('check', { size: 13, className: 'shrink-0 text-emerald-500' })}${escapeAttribute(item)}</li>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </ul>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<section class="flex flex-col ${centered ? 'items-center text-center' : 'items-start text-left'}">
      ${eyebrowHtml}
      <h1 class="mt-4 max-w-2xl text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 sm:text-4xl dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h1>
      ${descriptionHtml}
      ${buttonsHtml}
      ${highlightsHtml}
    </section>`;

    const primary = this.querySelector('.hero-primary');
    if (primary) primary.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('primary')));
    const secondary = this.querySelector('.hero-secondary');
    if (secondary) secondary.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('secondary')));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('hero-section')) {
  customElements.define('hero-section', HeroSectionElement);
}
export default HeroSectionElement;

====/File: vanilla/HomepageDashboard.js/====

/**
 * HomepageDashboard — Vanilla Web Component
 * A copy-paste, zero-backbox single-file dashboards with the iconic gethomepage/homepage
 * look: header (title + live clock + search) + responsive grouped service cards with
 * status dots/pills + version footer.
 *
 * This is an ORIGINAL implementation of the visual design language of
 * https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage (GPL-3.0). No GPL source is copied.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <homepage-dashboard title="Homepage" subtitle="My homelab" status-style="pill"></homepage-dashboard>
 *   <script>
 *     const dash = document.querySelector("homepage-dashboard");
 *     dash.groups = [
 *       { name: "Media", icon: "🎬", services: [
 *         { name: "Jellyfin", description: "Streaming", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/walkxcode/dashboard-icons/png/jellyfin.png", href: "https://jellyfin.local", status: "up", pingText: "12ms" },
 *         ...
 *       ]}
 *     ];
 *   </script>
 */
class HomepageDashboardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return [
      "title",
      "subtitle",
      "version",
      "header-style",
      "status-style",
      "search-placeholder",
      "collapsible",
      "show-search",
      "show-clock",
    ];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._groups = [];
    this._collapsedGroups = new Set();
    this._clockTimer = null;
    this._search = "";
  }

  // ----- public API -----
  get groups() {
    return this._groups;
  }

  set groups(value) {
    this._groups = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._collapsedGroups.clear();
    this._render();
  }

  // ----- lifecycle -----
  connectedCallback() {
    this._manageClock();
    this.addEventListener("click", this._handleClick);
    this.addEventListener("input", this._handleInput);
    this._render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this._clearClock();
    this.removeEventListener("click", this._handleClick);
    this.removeEventListener("input", this._handleInput);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === "show-clock") this._manageClock();
    if (this.isConnected) this._render();
  }

  // ----- clock ✓ toggled dynamically, never leaks -----
  _clearClock() {
    if (this._clockTimer) clearInterval(this._clockTimer);
    this._clockTimer = null;
  }

  _manageClock() {
    this._clearClock();
    if (this._attrBool("show-clock", true) && this.isConnected) {
      this._clockTimer = setInterval(() => this._updateClock(), 1000);
    }
  }

  // convenience reads
  _attr(name, fallback) {
    const v = this.getAttribute(name);
    return v === null ? fallback : v;
  }

  _attrBool(name, fallback) {
    const v = this.getAttribute(name);
    if (v === null) return fallback;
    return v !== "false" && v !== "0";
  }

  _headerStyle() {
    return this._attr("header-style", "underlined");
  }

  _statusStyle() {
    const s = this._attr("status-style", "pill");
    return ["dot", "pill", "none"].includes(s) ? s : "pill";
  }

  _collapsible() {
    return this._attrBool("collapsible", true);
  }

  // ----- helpers -----
  _esc(str) {
    return String(str ?? "")
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
      .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
  }

  /**
   * Only allow safe URL protocols into <a href>. Blocks javascript:, data:, vbscript:,
   * file: and any other unsupported scheme while allowing http(s), mailto, protocol-
   * relative, root-relative and dot-relative URLs.
   */
  static isSafeHref(href) {
    if (typeof href !== "string") return false;
    const t = href.trim();
    if (t.length === 0) return false;
    // protocol-relative //host, absolute path /x, relative ./ or ../
    if (t.startsWith("//") || t.startsWith("/") || t.startsWith("./") || t.startsWith("../")) return true;
    // intentional helper name
    return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
  }

  _iconHTML(service) {
    const icon = service?.icon;
    const name = service?.name || "?";
    const letter = this._esc((name || "?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase());
    const wrap = `class="shrink-0 my-1.5 ml-1.5 w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-white/10 service-icon"`;
    if (!icon) {
      return `<div ${wrap}><span class="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300">${letter}</span></div>`;
    }
    if (/^(https?:|data:|\.|\/)/i.test(icon)) {
      return `<div ${wrap}><img src="${this._esc(icon)}" alt="" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="w-8 h-8 object-contain" onerror="this.style.display='none'"/></div>`;
    }
    // emoji or short glyph
    return `<div ${wrap}><span class="text-xl leading-none">${this._esc(icon)}</span></div>`;
  }

  _statusHTML(service) {
    const style = this._statusStyle();
    const s = (service?.status || "unknown").toLowerCase();
    const map = {
      up: { dot: "bg-emerald-500", pill: "text-emerald-500/90", label: "UP" },
      online: { dot: "bg-emerald-500", pill: "text-emerald-500/90", label: "ONLINE" },
      down: { dot: "bg-rose-500", pill: "text-rose-500/90", label: "DOWN" },
      offline: { dot: "bg-rose-500", pill: "text-rose-500/90", label: "OFFLINE" },
      warn: { dot: "bg-amber-500", pill: "text-amber-500", label: "WARN" },
      error: { dot: "bg-orange-500", pill: "text-orange-500", label: "ERROR" },
      unknown: { dot: "bg-zinc-400/60 dark:bg-zinc-500/60", pill: "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400", label: "—" },
    };
    const cfg = map[s] || map.unknown;

    if (style === "none") return "";

    if (style === "dot") {
      return `<span title="${this._esc(service.pingText || cfg.label)}" role="img" aria-label="${this._esc(service.pingText || cfg.label)}" class="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 h-3 w-3 rounded-full ${cfg.dot} service-status-dot"></span>`;
    }

    const text = this._esc(service.pingText || cfg.label);
    return `<span class="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 text-[8px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-1.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-zinc-500/10 dark:bg-zinc-400/10 ${cfg.pill} service-status-pill" role="img" aria-label="${text}">${text}</span>`;
  }

  _serviceHTML(service) {
    const query = this._search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matched =
      !query ||
      (service.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      (service.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(query);
    const outer = [
      "service-card",
      "relative overflow-clip rounded-md shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 dark:shadow-zinc-900/20",
      "bg-white hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-white/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 transition-all mb-2 p-0.5",
      matched ? "" : "hidden",
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ");

    const safeHref = HomepageDashboardElement.isSafeHref(service.href) ? service.href : "";
    const linkAttrs = safeHref ? `href="${this._esc(safeHref)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"` : "";

    return `
      <li class="${outer}" data-name="${this._esc(service.name || "")}">
        <div class="flex select-none items-center service-title">
          <a ${linkAttrs} class="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">${this._iconHTML(service)}</a>
          <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 px-2 py-2.5 text-sm text-left z-10">
            <div class="truncate font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 service-name">${this._esc(service.name || "")}</div>
            ${service.description ? `<div class="truncate mt-0.5 text-xs font-light text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 service-description">${this._esc(service.description)}</div>` : ""}
          </div>
        </div>
        ${this._statusHTML(service)}
      </li>
    `;
  }

  _groupHTML(group, groupIndex) {
    const isCollapsed = this._collapsedGroups.has(group.name);
    const services = (group.services || []).map((s) => this._serviceHTML(s)).join("");
    const chevron = `
      <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
        class="w-5 h-5 transition-transform duration-200 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 ml-auto ${isCollapsed ? "rotate-180" : ""}">
        <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/>
      </svg>`;
    const groupName = this._esc(group.name || `Group ${groupIndex + 1}`);
    const groupIcon = group.icon
      ? `<span class="mr-2 inline-flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-white/10 text-sm leading-none">${this._esc(group.icon)}</span>`
      : "";

    return `
      <div class="services-group w-full md:w-1/2 lg:w-1/3 xl:w-1/4 p-1 pb-0" data-group="${this._esc(group.name)}">
        <button type="button" class="group-header flex w-full select-none items-center gap-1 py-0.5 ${!this._collapsible() ? "cursor-default" : ""}" data-toggle-group="${this._esc(group.name)}" aria-expanded="${isCollapsed ? "false" : "true"}">
          ${groupIcon}
          <h2 class="text-xl font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 service-group-name">${groupName}</h2>
          ${this._collapsible() ? chevron : ""}
        </button>
        ${isCollapsed ? "" : `<ul class="mt-2">${services}</ul>`}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  _clockHTML() {
    if (!this._attrBool("show-clock", true)) return "";
    return `
      <div class="text-right shrink-0 block min-w-28" data-el="clock">
        <div class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 leading-tight" data-el="clock-time"></div>
        <div class="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" data-el="clock-date"></div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  _headerHTML() {
    const title = this._esc(this._attr("title", "Homepage"));
    const subtitle = this._esc(this._attr("subtitle", "A highly customizable homelab dashboard"));
    const style = this._headerStyle();
    const headerCls =
      style === "boxed"
        ? "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-0 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-white/5 shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 p-4"
        : style === "clean"
          ? "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-0"
          : "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-1 border-b-2 border-zinc-300/70 dark:border-zinc-700 pb-4";

    const search = this._attrBool("show-search", false)
      ? `
        <div class="relative w-full sm:w-64">
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" class="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400">
            <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M9 3.5a5.5 5.5 0 1 0 0 11 5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-11ZM2 9a7 7 0 1 1 12.452 4.391l2.328 2.328a.75.75 0 1 1-1.06 1.06l-2.328-2.328A7 7 0 0 1 2 9Z" clip-rule="evenodd"/>
          </svg>
          <input type="search" data-el="search" value="${this._esc(this._search)}" placeholder="${this._esc(this._attr("search-placeholder", "Search services…"))}" aria-label="Search services"
            class="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-white/5 px-9 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-400 dark:focus:ring-zinc-500"/>
        </div>`
      : "";

    return `
      <header class="${headerCls} homepage-header">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-x-6 gap-y-4">
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50 homepage-title">${title}</h1>
            ${subtitle ? `<p class="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 homepage-subtitle">${subtitle}</p>` : ""}
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
            ${search}
            ${this._clockHTML()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
    `;
  }

  _footerHTML() {
    const version = this._esc(this._attr("version", "Homepage · awesome-ui"));
    return `
      <footer class="px-5 py-6 text-right">
        <a href="https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">
          <span>${version}</span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </a>
      </footer>
    `;
  }

  _render() {
    if (!this.isConnected) return;
    const emptyNote =
      this._search.trim()
        ? `<p class="p-4 text-sm text-zinc-400">No matching services for “${this._esc(this._search.trim())}”.</p>`
        : `<p class="p-4 text-sm text-zinc-400">No groups configured — assign <code>dash.groups = […]</code>.</p>`;
    const hasGroups = this._groups.length > 0;
    const mainContent =
      !hasGroups
        ? emptyNote
        : this._groups.map((g, i) => this._groupHTML(g, i)).join("");
    // persistent no-match note (shown only while a live search matches nothing)
    const noMatchNote = hasGroups
      ? `<p data-el='empty-search-note' class="px-3.5 pt-1 pb-2 text-sm text-zinc-400 hidden">No matching services for \u201c${this._esc(this._search.trim())}\u201d.</p>`
      : "";

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="homepage-dashboard relative w-full rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 overflow-hidden"
        style="font-family: 'Manrope', 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;">
        ${this._headerHTML()}
        <main class="flex flex-wrap items-start px-3 sm:px-5 pb-4">
          ${mainContent}
          ${noMatchNote}
        </main>
        ${this._footerHTML()}
      </div>
    `;

    this._updateClock();
    this._applySearchFiltering();
  }

  _updateClock() {
    const timeEl = this.querySelector("[data-el='clock-time']");
    if (!timeEl || !this._attrBool("show-clock", true)) return;
    const now = new Date();
    timeEl.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
    const dateEl = this.querySelector("[data-el='clock-date']");
    if (dateEl) dateEl.textContent = now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
  }

  // Hide non-matching cards AND sync group visibility so a no-match search leaves
  // no empty group headers behind (parity with React/Vue filtering). ClassList-only;
  // never rebuilds the DOM on keystroke.
  _applySearchFiltering() {
    const q = this._search.trim().toLowerCase();
    this.querySelectorAll(".service-card").forEach((card) => {
      const name = (card.dataset.name || "").toLowerCase();
      const desc = (card.querySelector(".service-description")?.textContent || "").toLowerCase();
      const matched = q.length === 0 || name.includes(q) || desc.includes(q);
      card.classList.toggle("hidden", !matched);
    });
    this.querySelectorAll(".services-group").forEach((group) => {
      const cards = [...group.querySelectorAll(".service-card")];
      const anyVisible = cards.some((c) => !c.classList.contains("hidden"));
      group.hidden = q.length > 0 && !anyVisible;
    });
    const note = this.querySelector("[data-el='empty-search-note']");
    if (note) {
      const cards = [...this.querySelectorAll(".service-card")];
      const everythingHidden = cards.length > 0 && cards.every((c) => c.classList.contains("hidden"));
      const show = q.length > 0 && everythingHidden;
      note.classList.toggle("hidden", !show);
      if (show) note.textContent = `No matching services for \u201c${this._search.trim()}\u201d.`;
    }
  }

  // ----- interactions (event delegation on root) -----
  _handleClick = (event) => {
    const groupBtn = event.target.closest("[data-toggle-group]");
    if (!groupBtn) return;
    const name = groupBtn.dataset.toggleGroup;
    if (!name || !this._collapsible()) return;
    const was = this._collapsedGroups.has(name);
    if (was) this._collapsedGroups.delete(name);
    else this._collapsedGroups.add(name);
    this._render();
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("group-toggle", { detail: { group: name, collapsed: !was } })
    );
  };

  _handleInput = (event) => {
    if (event.target.dataset?.el !== "search") return;
    this._search = event.target.value;
    this._applySearchFiltering();
  };
}

if (typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !customElements.get("homepage-dashboard")) {
  customElements.define("homepage-dashboard", HomepageDashboardElement);
}
export default HomepageDashboardElement;

====/File: vanilla/KanbanBoard.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const PRIORITY_META = {
  low: { label: 'Low', cls: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400' },
  medium: { label: 'Medium', cls: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400' },
  high: { label: 'High', cls: 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400' },
};

const initials = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/**
 * KanbanBoard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <kanban-board></kanban-board>
 * Properties: columns (KanbanColumn[]), cards (KanbanCard[])
 * Events: move-card (detail: {cardId, from, to}), card-click (detail: card), add-card (detail: columnId)
 */
export class KanbanBoardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._columns = [];
    this._cards = [];
    this._draggingId = null;
    this._overColumn = null;
  }

  get columns() {
    return this._columns;
  }

  set columns(value) {
    this._columns = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get cards() {
    return this._cards;
  }

  set cards(value) {
    this._cards = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _move(cardId, toColumnId) {
    const card = this._cards.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(cardId));
    if (!card || card.columnId === toColumnId) return;
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('move-card', { detail: { cardId: card.id, from: card.columnId, to: toColumnId } })
    );
  }

  _renderCard(card) {
    const priority = card.priority ? PRIORITY_META[card.priority] : null;
    const tags = (card.tags || [])
      .slice(0, 2)
      .map(
        (tag) =>
          `<span class="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(tag)}</span>`
      )
      .join('');
    const assignee = card.assignee
      ? `<span title="${escapeAttribute(card.assignee)}" class="ml-auto flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[8px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(initials(card.assignee))}</span>`
      : '';

    return `<div role="button" tabindex="0" draggable="true" data-card="${escapeAttribute(card.id)}"
      class="kanban-card cursor-grab rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-2.5 text-left shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-zinc-300 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 active:cursor-grabbing dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600 ${
        String(this._draggingId) === String(card.id) ? 'opacity-40' : ''
      }">
      <div class="flex items-start gap-1.5">
        <p class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[11px] font-medium leading-snug text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(card.title)}</p>
        ${priority ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium ${priority.cls}">${priority.label}</span>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${
        card.description
          ? `<p class="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(card.description)}</p>`
          : ''
      }
      ${tags || assignee ? `<div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">${tags}${assignee}</div>` : ''}
    </div>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'Drop cards here';

    const columns = this._columns
      .map((column) => {
        const cards = this._cards.filter((card) => card.columnId === column.id);
        const count = column.limit ? `${cards.length}/${column.limit}` : String(cards.length);
        const isOver = String(this._overColumn) === String(column.id);
        return `<section data-column="${escapeAttribute(column.id)}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(column.title)}"
          class="kanban-column flex w-64 shrink-0 flex-col rounded-xl border p-2 transition-colors dark:bg-zinc-900/40 ${
            isOver
              ? 'border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/20'
              : 'border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800'
          }">
          <header class="mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1">
            <span class="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${escapeAttribute(column.accent || 'bg-zinc-400')}" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <h3 class="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(column.title)}</h3>
            <span class="column-count ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-200/70 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${count}</span>
            <button type="button" class="column-add shrink-0 rounded-md p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              data-column="${escapeAttribute(column.id)}" aria-label="Add card to ${escapeAttribute(column.title)}">${uiIcon('plus', { size: 12 })}</button>
          </header>
          <div class="flex min-h-[3rem] flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
            ${
              cards.length === 0
                ? `<p class="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-2 py-4 text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>`
                : cards.map((card) => this._renderCard(card)).join('')
            }
          </div>
        </section>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">${columns}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.kanban-column').forEach((section) => {
      const columnId = section.getAttribute('data-column');
      section.addEventListener('dragover', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (this._overColumn !== columnId) {
          this._overColumn = columnId;
          this.render();
        }
      });
      section.addEventListener('dragleave', (event) => {
        if (event.target === section && this._overColumn === columnId) {
          this._overColumn = null;
          this.render();
        }
      });
      section.addEventListener('drop', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const cardId = (event.dataTransfer && event.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain')) || this._draggingId;
        this._overColumn = null;
        this._draggingId = null;
        if (cardId) this._move(cardId, columnId);
        else this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.kanban-card').forEach((node) => {
      const cardId = node.getAttribute('data-card');
      const card = this._cards.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(cardId));
      if (!card) return;

      node.addEventListener('dragstart', (event) => {
        if (event.dataTransfer) {
          event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(card.id));
          event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        }
        this._draggingId = card.id;
      });
      node.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
        this._draggingId = null;
        this._overColumn = null;
        this.render();
      });
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('card-click', { detail: card })));
      node.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('card-click', { detail: card }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
        const index = this._columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === card.columnId);
        const next = this._columns[index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1)];
        if (!next) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        this._move(card.id, next.id);
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.column-add').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-card', { detail: button.getAttribute('data-column') }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('kanban-board')) {
  customElements.define('kanban-board', KanbanBoardElement);
}
export default KanbanBoardElement;

====/File: vanilla/KnowledgeDrawer.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

/**
 * Vanilla Web Component: <knowledge-drawer>
 */
export class KnowledgeDrawerElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._data = {
      isOpen: false,
      index: "01",
      title: "",
      subtitle: "",
      themeColor: "#c2410c",
      conceptText: "",
      dependencies: [],
      actionLabel: "开始该阶段练习",
    };
  }

  set data(val) {
    this._data = { ...this._data, ...val };
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    if (!this._data.isOpen) {
      this.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    const { index, title, subtitle, themeColor, conceptText, dependencies, actionLabel } = this._data;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-hidden flex justify-end font-sans">
        <div class="drawer-backdrop fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity duration-300"></div>

        <div
          style="border-left-color: ${themeColor};"
          class="relative z-10 w-full max-w-md bg-[#faf8f1] dark:bg-[#1b1f26] h-full shadow-2xl border-l-4 flex flex-col transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-out"
        >
          <div class="p-5 border-b border-[#d6d2c2] dark:border-[#2b3038] flex items-start justify-between gap-4 bg-[#f1efe7]/50 dark:bg-[#14171c]/50">
            <div class="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0">
              <span class="font-mono text-2xl font-black leading-none" style="color: ${themeColor};">${index}</span>
              <div class="min-w-0">
                <h3 class="font-serif text-lg font-bold text-[#22262d] dark:text-[#e9e6db] leading-snug truncate">${title}</h3>
                ${subtitle ? `<p class="text-xs text-[#545b64] dark:text-[#a9a89c] mt-0.5">${subtitle}</p>` : ""}
              </div>
            </div>

            <button type="button" class="drawer-close p-1.5 rounded-sm hover:bg-[#e7e4d7] dark:hover:bg-[#0f1216] text-[#545b64] dark:text-[#a9a89c] transition-colors">
              ${uiIcon('x', { size: 18 })}
            </button>
          </div>

          <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-6">
            ${
              conceptText
                ? `
              <div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold tracking-widest text-[#8d9298] dark:text-[#6f7268] uppercase mb-2">
                  <span>核心要点与认知</span>
                </div>
                <p class="text-sm leading-relaxed text-[#22262d] dark:text-[#e9e6db] bg-[#f1efe7]/60 dark:bg-[#14171c]/60 p-3.5 rounded-sm border border-[#d6d2c2]/80 dark:border-[#2b3038]">
                  ${conceptText}
                </p>
              </div>
            `
                : ""
            }

            ${
              dependencies && dependencies.length > 0
                ? `
              <div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold tracking-widest text-[#8d9298] dark:text-[#6f7268] uppercase mb-2">
                  <span>拓扑前置与分支关系</span>
                </div>
                <div class="space-y-2">
                  ${dependencies
                    .map(
                      (dep) => `
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs p-2 rounded border border-[#d6d2c2] dark:border-[#2b3038] bg-white/50 dark:bg-black/20">
                      <span class="font-mono text-[10px] uppercase px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border tracking-wider" style="border-color: ${
                        dep.type === "dependency" ? "#8d9298" : dep.type === "branch" ? "#1d4ed8" : themeColor
                      }; color: ${dep.type === "dependency" ? "#545b64" : dep.type === "branch" ? "#1d4ed8" : themeColor};">${dep.type}</span>
                      <span class="text-[#545b64] dark:text-[#a9a89c] font-medium">${dep.label}</span>
                    </div>
                  `
                    )
                    .join("")}
                </div>
              </div>
            `
                : ""
            }
          </div>

          <div class="p-4 border-t border-[#d6d2c2] dark:border-[#2b3038] bg-[#f1efe7]/30 dark:bg-[#14171c]/30">
            <button
              type="button"
              class="drawer-action w-full py-2.5 px-4 text-white font-serif font-bold text-sm rounded-sm shadow-sm hover:brightness-105 active:scale-[0.99] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              style="background-color: ${themeColor}; border-color: ${themeColor};"
            >
              <span>${actionLabel}</span>
              ${uiIcon('arrow-right', { size: 16 })}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    this.querySelector(".drawer-backdrop")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("close"));
    });
    this.querySelector(".drawer-close")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("close"));
    });
    this.querySelector(".drawer-action")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("action"));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !customElements.get("knowledge-drawer")) {
  customElements.define("knowledge-drawer", KnowledgeDrawerElement);
}

====/File: vanilla/MessageActionToolbar.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

/**
 * MessageActionToolbar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <message-action-toolbar content="Hello" total-branches="3" branch-index="0"></message-action-toolbar>
 */
class MessageActionToolbar extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["content", "role", "total-branches", "branch-index"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const content = this.getAttribute("content") || "";
    const role = this.getAttribute("role") || "assistant";
    const totalBranches = parseInt(this.getAttribute("total-branches") || "0", 10);
    const branchIndex = parseInt(this.getAttribute("branch-index") || "0", 10);

    const hasBranches = totalBranches > 1;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 text-xs mt-1.5 select-none">
        ${hasBranches ? `
          <div class="flex items-center gap-0.5 mr-2 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <button type="button" id="prev-branch" ${branchIndex <= 0 ? 'disabled' : ''} class="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5" title="Previous version">${uiIcon('chevron-left', { size: 14 })}</button>
            <span>${branchIndex + 1}/${totalBranches}</span>
            <button type="button" id="next-branch" ${branchIndex >= totalBranches - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} class="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5" title="Next version">${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 14 })}</button>
          </div>
        ` : ''}
        <button type="button" id="copy-btn" class="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors" title="Copy response">${uiIcon('copy', { size: 16 })}</button>
        <button type="button" id="retry-btn" class="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors" title="Regenerate response">${uiIcon('refresh', { size: 16 })}</button>
        ${role === 'assistant' ? `
          <button type="button" id="thumb-up" class="p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700" title="Good response">${uiIcon('thumbs-up', { size: 16 })}</button>
          <button type="button" id="thumb-down" class="p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700" title="Bad response">${uiIcon('thumbs-down', { size: 16 })}</button>
        ` : ''}
      </div>
    `;

    this.querySelector("#copy-btn")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
      const btn = this.querySelector("#copy-btn");
      btn.innerHTML = uiIcon("check", { size: 16 });
      setTimeout(() => (btn.innerHTML = uiIcon("copy", { size: 16 })), 2000);
    });

    this.querySelector("#retry-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("retry"));
    });

    this.querySelector("#prev-branch")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("branchChange", { detail: branchIndex - 1 }));
    });

    this.querySelector("#next-branch")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("branchChange", { detail: branchIndex + 1 }));
    });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("message-action-toolbar")) {
  customElements.define("message-action-toolbar", MessageActionToolbar);
}
export default MessageActionToolbar;

====/File: vanilla/ModelSelector.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ModelSelectorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['selected-id', 'placeholder', 'show-search', 'disabled'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._models = [];
    this._isOpen = false;
    this._searchQuery = '';
    this._handleDocClick = this._handleDocClick.bind(this);
  }

  get models() {
    return this._models;
  }

  set models(val) {
    this._models = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get selectedId() {
    return this.getAttribute('selected-id') || '';
  }

  set selectedId(val) {
    this.setAttribute('selected-id', val);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', this._handleDocClick);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._handleDocClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _handleDocClick(event) {
    if (!this.contains(event.target)) {
      if (this._isOpen) {
        this._isOpen = false;
        this.render();
      }
    }
  }

  _getFilteredModels() {
    if (!this._searchQuery.trim()) return this._models;
    const q = this._searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return this._models.filter(
      (m) =>
        (m.name && m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.provider && m.provider.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.description && m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.tags && m.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    );
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const selectedId = this.selectedId;
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Select model...';
    const showSearch = this.getAttribute('show-search') !== 'false';
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled');

    const selectedModel = this._models.find((m) => m.id === selectedId) || null;
    const filtered = this._getFilteredModels();

    this._applyHostClass('relative inline-block text-xs font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <button
        type="button"
        class="model-sel-btn flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-all shadow-sm ${
          disabled ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : 'cursor-pointer'
        }"
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded="${this._isOpen}"
        ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
      >
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <div class="p-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 shrink-0">
            ${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 14 })}
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-col text-left truncate">
            <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 truncate">
              ${selectedModel ? escapeAttribute(selectedModel.name) : escapeAttribute(placeholder)}
            </span>
            ${selectedModel?.provider ? `
              <span class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                ${escapeAttribute(selectedModel.provider)}
                ${selectedModel.contextLength ? ` · ${escapeAttribute(selectedModel.contextLength)}` : ''}
              </span>
            ` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>

        <span class="text-zinc-400 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${this._isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}">
          ${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 14 })}
        </span>
      </button>

      ${this._isOpen ? `
        <div class="absolute left-0 mt-1.5 w-72 max-h-80 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl z-40 flex flex-col">
          ${showSearch ? `
            <div class="p-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100/80 dark:bg-zinc-800/80">
                ${uiIcon('search', { size: 13, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
                <input
                  type="text"
                  class="model-search-input w-full bg-transparent border-none text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
                  placeholder="Search models..."
                  value="${escapeAttribute(this._searchQuery)}"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          ` : ''}

          <div class="overflow-y-auto p-1.5 space-y-1 max-h-60" role="listbox">
            ${filtered.length === 0 ? `
              <div class="p-3 text-center text-zinc-400 text-xs">No models found</div>
            ` : filtered.map((m) => {
              const isSelected = m.id === selectedId;
              return `
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-model-id="${escapeAttribute(m.id)}"
                  class="model-option-btn w-full flex items-start justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
                      : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
                  }"
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected="${isSelected}"
                >
                  <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                      <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">${escapeAttribute(m.name)}</span>
                      ${m.contextLength ? `<span class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono">${escapeAttribute(m.contextLength)}</span>` : ''}
                      ${(m.tags || []).map((t) => `<span class="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800/50">${escapeAttribute(t)}</span>`).join('')}
                    </div>
                    ${m.description ? `<p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">${escapeAttribute(m.description)}</p>` : ''}
                  </div>
                  ${isSelected ? `<span class="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5">${uiIcon('check', { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
                </button>
              `;
            }).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      ` : ''}
    `;

    const toggleBtn = this.querySelector('.model-sel-btn');
    if (toggleBtn) {
      toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._isOpen = !this._isOpen;
        this.render();
        if (this._isOpen) {
          const input = this.querySelector('.model-search-input');
          if (input) input.focus();
        }
      });
    }

    const searchInput = this.querySelector('.model-search-input');
    if (searchInput) {
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        this._searchQuery = e.target.value;
        const listbox = this.querySelector('[role="listbox"]');
        if (listbox) {
          const filtered = this._getFilteredModels();
          if (filtered.length === 0) {
            listbox.innerHTML = '<div class="p-3 text-center text-zinc-400 text-xs">No models found</div>';
          } else {
            listbox.innerHTML = filtered.map((m) => {
              const isSelected = m.id === this.selectedId;
              return `
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-model-id="${escapeAttribute(m.id)}"
                  class="model-option-btn w-full flex items-start justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
                      : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
                  }"
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected="${isSelected}"
                >
                  <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                      <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">${escapeAttribute(m.name)}</span>
                      ${m.contextLength ? `<span class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono">${escapeAttribute(m.contextLength)}</span>` : ''}
                      ${(m.tags || []).map((t) => `<span class="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800/50">${escapeAttribute(t)}</span>`).join('')}
                    </div>
                    ${m.description ? `<p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">${escapeAttribute(m.description)}</p>` : ''}
                  </div>
                  ${isSelected ? `<span class="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5">${uiIcon('check', { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
                </button>
              `;
            }).join('');
            this._bindOptionClicks();
          }
        }
      });
    }

    this._bindOptionClicks();
  }

  _bindOptionClicks() {
    this.querySelectorAll('.model-option-btn').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-model-id');
        const model = this._models.find((m) => m.id === id);
        if (model) {
          this.selectedId = model.id;
          this._isOpen = false;
          this._searchQuery = '';
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: model }));
          this.render();
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('model-selector')) {
  customElements.define('model-selector', ModelSelectorElement);
}
export default ModelSelectorElement;

====/File: vanilla/NotificationCenter.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TYPE_META = {
  info: { chip: 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400', icon: 'info' },
  success: { chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', icon: 'check-circle' },
  warning: { chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', icon: 'alert-triangle' },
  error: { chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', icon: 'circle-x' },
};

/**
 * NotificationCenter - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <notification-center open></notification-center>
 * Properties: notifications (NotificationItem[])
 * Events: select (detail: item), mark-read (detail: ids[]), mark-all-read, close
 */
export class NotificationCenterElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'empty-text', 'show-filter'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._notifications = [];
    this._filter = 'all';
  }

  get notifications() {
    return this._notifications;
  }

  set notifications(value) {
    this._notifications = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this.hasAttribute('open')) this._filter = 'all';
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _unreadIds() {
    return this._notifications.filter((item) => item.unread).map((item) => item.id);
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (!this.hasAttribute('open')) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Notifications';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || "You're all caught up";
    const showFilter = this.getAttribute('show-filter') !== 'false';
    const unreadIds = this._unreadIds();
    const visible =
      this._filter === 'unread' ? this._notifications.filter((item) => item.unread) : this._notifications;

    const filterRow = showFilter
      ? `<div class="flex gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-1.5">
          ${['all', 'unread']
            .map((key) => {
              const active = this._filter === key;
              const count = key === 'all' ? this._notifications.length : unreadIds.length;
              return `<button type="button" class="notif-filter rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium capitalize transition-colors ${
                active
                  ? 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'
                  : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
              }" data-filter="${key}" aria-pressed="${active}">${key}<span class="ml-1 tabular-nums text-zinc-400">${count}</span></button>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : '';

    const body = visible.length
      ? `<ul class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
          ${visible
            .map((item) => {
              const meta = TYPE_META[item.type] || TYPE_META.info;
              return `<li>
                <button type="button" class="notif-item flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50" data-id="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}">
                  <span class="mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${meta.chip}">${uiIcon(item.icon || meta.icon, { size: 13 })}</span>
                  <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span class="truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}</span>
                      ${item.unread ? '<span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" aria-label="Unread"></span>' : ''}
                    </span>
                    ${item.description ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.description)}</span>` : ''}
                    ${item.time ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.time)}</span>` : ''}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </li>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </ul>`
      : `<div class="px-3 py-8 text-center">
          <span class="mx-auto mb-1.5 block text-emerald-500">${uiIcon('check-circle', { size: 20 })}</span>
          <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>
        </div>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="w-full max-w-sm overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg" role="region" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-2.5">
          <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('bell', { size: 14 })}</span>
          <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h3>
          ${
            unreadIds.length
              ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-indigo-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400">${unreadIds.length} new</span>`
              : ''
          }
          <button type="button" class="notif-mark-all ml-auto text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:disabled:text-zinc-600" ${unreadIds.length ? '' : 'disabled'}>Mark all read</button>
          <button type="button" class="notif-close rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200" aria-label="Close notifications">${uiIcon('x', { size: 12 })}</button>
        </div>
        ${filterRow}
        <div class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">${body}</div>
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.notif-filter').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._filter = button.getAttribute('data-filter');
        this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.notif-item').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-id');
        const item = this._notifications.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (!item) return;
        if (item.unread) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mark-read', { detail: [item.id] }));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: item }));
      });
    });

    const markAll = this.querySelector('.notif-mark-all');
    markAll.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!this._unreadIds().length) return;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mark-all-read'));
    });

    this.querySelector('.notif-close').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('notification-center')) {
  customElements.define('notification-center', NotificationCenterElement);
}
export default NotificationCenterElement;

====/File: vanilla/OnboardingChecklist.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class OnboardingChecklistElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tasks', 'title'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get tasks() {
    if (this._tasks) return this._tasks;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('tasks') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set tasks(value) {
    this._tasks = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const tasks = this.tasks;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Get started';
    const total = tasks.length;
    const doneCount = tasks.filter((task) => task.done).length;
    const percent = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((doneCount / total) * 100);
    const allDone = total > 0 && doneCount === total;

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const items = tasks
      .map(
        (task) => `
        <li class="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3">
          <button type="button" data-toggle="${escapeAttribute(task.id)}" aria-pressed="${task.done}"
            aria-label="${task.done ? `Mark ${escapeAttribute(task.title)} as not done` : `Mark ${escapeAttribute(task.title)} as done`}"
            class="mt-0.5 flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              task.done
                ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white'
                : 'border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 text-transparent hover:border-indigo-500'
            }">${uiIcon('check', { size: 10 })}</button>
          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div class="text-xs ${task.done ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 line-through' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(task.title)}</div>
            ${task.description ? `<div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(task.description)}</div>` : ''}
          </div>
          ${
            !task.done && task.actionText
              ? `<button type="button" data-action="${escapeAttribute(task.id)}" class="shrink-0 rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(task.actionText)}</button>`
              : ''
          }
        </li>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</span>
            <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${doneCount}/${total}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
            <div class="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-all duration-300" style="width: ${percent}%"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
            ${
              allDone
                ? `<span class="text-emerald-500">${uiIcon('check-circle', { size: 12 })}</span><span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">All set — nothing left to do.</span>`
                : `<span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${percent}% complete · ${total - doneCount} left</span>`
            }
          </div>
        </div>
        <ul class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${items}</ul>
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const task = tasks.find((entry) => entry.id === btn.getAttribute('data-toggle'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: task }));
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const task = tasks.find((entry) => entry.id === btn.getAttribute('data-action'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: task }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('onboarding-checklist')) {
  customElements.define('onboarding-checklist', OnboardingChecklistElement);
}
export default OnboardingChecklistElement;

====/File: vanilla/Pagination.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const BASE =
  'inline-flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40';
const EDGE_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';

export const paginationSlots = (page, pageCount, siblingCount = 1) => {
  if (pageCount <= 0) return [];
  const seen = new Set([1, pageCount, page]);
  for (let offset = 1; offset <= siblingCount; offset += 1) {
    seen.add(page - offset);
    seen.add(page + offset);
  }
  const sorted = Array.from(seen)
    .filter((entry) => entry >= 1 && entry <= pageCount)
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const slots = [];
  let previous = 0;
  for (const entry of sorted) {
    if (previous > 0 && entry - previous > 1) slots.push('gap');
    slots.push(entry);
    previous = entry;
  }
  return slots;
};

/**
 * Pagination - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <pagination-bar page="3" page-count="12"></pagination-bar>
 * Properties: page, pageCount
 * Attributes: page, page-count, sibling-count, show-edges, aria-label
 * Events: change (detail: { page })
 */
export class PaginationElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['page', 'page-count', 'sibling-count', 'show-edges', 'aria-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._page = null;
    this._pageCount = null;
  }

  get page() {
    const value = Number(this._page ?? this.getAttribute('page'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 1;
  }

  set page(value) {
    this._page = value;
    this.render();
  }

  get pageCount() {
    const value = Number(this._pageCount ?? this.getAttribute('page-count'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 0;
  }

  set pageCount(value) {
    this._pageCount = value;
    this.render();
  }

  get siblingCount() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('sibling-count');
    if (raw === null) return 1;
    const value = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 1;
  }

  get showEdges() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('show-edges');
    return raw !== 'false';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _go(next) {
    if (next < 1 || next > this.pageCount || next === this.page) return;
    this._page = next;
    this.setAttribute('page', String(next));
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { page: next } }));
  }

  _edgeButton(target, label, icon, disabled) {
    return `<button type="button" data-page="${target}" aria-label="${label}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} class="${BASE} ${EDGE_CLASS}">${uiIcon(icon, { size: 13 })}</button>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex items-center gap-1');
    const page = this.page;
    const pageCount = this.pageCount;
    const slots = paginationSlots(page, pageCount, this.siblingCount);
    const ariaLabel = this.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Pagination';

    const numbers = slots
      .map((slot, index) => {
        if (slot === 'gap') {
          return `<span aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">…</span>`;
        }
        const active = slot === page;
        return `<button type="button" data-page="${slot}" aria-label="Page ${slot}" ${active ? 'aria-current="page"' : ''}
          class="${BASE} tabular-nums ${active ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : EDGE_CLASS}">${slot}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const edges = this.showEdges
      ? this._edgeButton(1, 'First page', 'chevron-left', page <= 1)
      : '';
    const tail = this.showEdges
      ? this._edgeButton(pageCount, 'Last page', 'chevron-right', page >= pageCount)
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<nav aria-label="${escapeAttribute(ariaLabel)}" class="flex items-center gap-1">${edges}${this._edgeButton(page - 1, 'Previous page', 'chevron-left', page <= 1)}${numbers}${this._edgeButton(page + 1, 'Next page', 'chevron-right', page >= pageCount)}${tail}</nav>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this._go(Number(node.getAttribute('data-page'))));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('pagination-bar')) {
  customElements.define('pagination-bar', PaginationElement);
}
export default PaginationElement;

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class PricingTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['plans'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get plans() {
    if (this._plans) return this._plans;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('plans') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set plans(value) {
    this._plans = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const plans = this.plans;
    this._applyHostClass('grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-3 items-start');

    this.innerHTML = plans
      .map((plan, index) => {
        const highlighted = !!plan.highlighted;
        const cardClass = highlighted
          ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 ring-2 ring-indigo-600 shadow-sm'
          : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:shadow-sm';
        const buttonClass = highlighted
          ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'
          : 'border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
        const features = (plan.features || [])
          .map(
            (feature) => `
            <li class="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              <span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-500">${uiIcon('check', { size: 14 })}</span>
              <span>${escapeAttribute(feature)}</span>
            </li>`
          )
          .join('');

        return `
          <div class="relative flex flex-col rounded-2xl border p-6 transition-shadow ${cardClass}">
            ${
              highlighted
                ? `<span class="absolute -top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-white">${escapeAttribute(plan.badge || 'Most popular')}</span>`
                : ''
            }
            <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(plan.name || '')}</div>
            ${
              plan.description
                ? `<div class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(plan.description)}</div>`
                : ''
            }
            <div class="mt-5 flex items-baseline gap-1">
              <span class="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(plan.price ?? '')}</span>
              <span class="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">/${escapeAttribute(plan.period || 'mo')}</span>
            </div>
            <ul class="mt-5 space-y-2.5 flex-1">${features}</ul>
            <button type="button" data-index="${index}" class="plan-cta mt-6 w-full rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 ${buttonClass}">
              ${escapeAttribute(plan.ctaText || 'Get started')}
            </button>
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.querySelectorAll('.plan-cta').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-index'));
        const plan = plans[index];
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: plan }));
      });
    });
  }
}

  customElements.define('pricing-table', PricingTableElement);
