====/File: vanilla/PromptChips.js/====

/**
 * PromptChips - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <prompt-chips suggestions='["Summarize this article", "Find bugs in code"]'></prompt-chips>
 */
class PromptChips extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["suggestions"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    let suggestions = [];
    try {
      suggestions = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute("suggestions") || "[]");
    } catch {
      suggestions = [];
    }

    if (!suggestions || suggestions.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 my-3">
        ${suggestions.map((item, idx) => `
          <button type="button" data-idx="${idx}" class="chip-item group flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/60 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 shadow-xs hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 transition-all text-left">
            <span class="text-amber-500/70 group-hover:text-amber-500 transition-colors">✨</span>
            <span class="truncate max-w-[280px]">${item}</span>
          </button>
        `).join("")}
      </div>
    `;

    this.querySelectorAll(".chip-item").forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const idx = parseInt(btn.getAttribute("data-idx") || "0", 10);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("select", { detail: suggestions[idx] }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("prompt-chips")) {
  customElements.define("prompt-chips", PromptChips);
}
export default PromptChips;

====/File: vanilla/PromptLibrary.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * PromptLibrary - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <prompt-library searchable></prompt-library>
 * Properties: prompts (PromptItem[]), categories (string[])
 * Events: use (detail: prompt), toggle-favorite (detail: prompt)
 */
export class PromptLibraryElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['searchable'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._prompts = [];
    this._categories = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._category = 'all';
  }

  get prompts() {
    return this._prompts;
  }

  set prompts(value) {
    this._prompts = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get categories() {
    return this._categories;
  }

  set categories(value) {
    this._categories = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _categoryOptions() {
    const seen = new Set(this._categories);
    for (const prompt of this._prompts) if (prompt.category) seen.add(prompt.category);
    return ['all', ...Array.from(seen)];
  }

  _visible() {
    const needle = this._query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return this._prompts.filter((prompt) => {
      const inCategory = this._category === 'all' || prompt.category === this._category;
      if (!inCategory) return false;
      if (!needle) return true;
      return [prompt.title, prompt.description, prompt.prompt, ...(prompt.tags || [])]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(needle);
    });
  }

  _chips() {
    return this._categoryOptions()
      .map((category) => {
        const active = this._category === category;
        return `<button type="button" class="prompt-chip rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
          active
            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
            : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700'
        }" data-category="${escapeAttribute(category)}" aria-pressed="${active}">${category === 'all' ? 'All' : escapeAttribute(category)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');
  }

  _list() {
    const visible = this._visible();
    if (visible.length === 0) {
      return `<p class="px-3 py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">No prompts match your filters.</p>`;
    }
    const items = visible
      .map((prompt) => {
        const tags = (prompt.tags || [])
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map((tag) => `<span class="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tag)}</span>`)
          .join('');
        return `<li class="prompt-card group flex flex-col rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:border-indigo-700" data-prompt="${escapeAttribute(prompt.id)}">
          <div class="flex items-start gap-1.5">
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span class="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(prompt.title)}</span>
                ${prompt.category ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(prompt.category)}</span>` : ''}
              </div>
              ${prompt.description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(prompt.description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="prompt-fav shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              prompt.favorite ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-300 hover:text-amber-500 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-amber-400'
            }" aria-label="${prompt.favorite ? 'Unfavorite' : 'Favorite'} ${escapeAttribute(prompt.title)}" aria-pressed="${!!prompt.favorite}" data-prompt-id="${escapeAttribute(prompt.id)}">${uiIcon('star', { size: 13 })}</button>
          </div>

          <p class="mt-2 line-clamp-2 rounded bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(prompt.prompt)}</p>

          <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">${tags}</div>
            <button type="button" class="prompt-use inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500" data-prompt-id="${escapeAttribute(prompt.id)}">
              Use${uiIcon('arrow-right', { size: 10 })}
            </button>
          </div>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');
    return `<ul class="grid gap-2 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2">${items}</ul>`;
  }

  _updateCount() {
    const count = this.querySelector('.prompt-count');
    if (count) count.textContent = String(this._visible().length);
  }

  _renderRegion() {
    const chips = this.querySelector('.prompt-chips');
    const list = this.querySelector('.prompt-body');
    if (chips) chips.innerHTML = this._chips();
    if (list) list.innerHTML = this._list();
    this._updateCount();
    this._bindItems();
  }

  _bindItems() {
    this.querySelectorAll('.prompt-chip').forEach((chip) => {
      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._category = chip.getAttribute('data-category');
        this._renderRegion();
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.prompt-use').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-prompt-id');
        const prompt = this._prompts.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (prompt) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('use', { detail: prompt }));
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.prompt-fav').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-prompt-id');
        const prompt = this._prompts.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (prompt) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle-favorite', { detail: prompt }));
      });
    });
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const searchable = this.hasAttribute('searchable');
    const search = searchable
      ? `<div class="relative sm:ml-auto sm:w-56">
          <span class="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('search', { size: 12 })}</span>
          <input type="search" class="prompt-search w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 pl-6 pr-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
            placeholder="Search prompts…" aria-label="Search prompts" value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}" />
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          <span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 14 })}</span>
          <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold">Prompt library</h3>
          <span class="prompt-count rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${this._visible().length}</span>
        </div>
        ${search}
      </div>
      <div class="prompt-chips flex flex-wrap gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800">${this._chips()}</div>
      <div class="prompt-body">${this._list()}</div>
    </div>`;

    const input = this.querySelector('.prompt-search');
    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        this._query = input.value;
        this._renderRegion();
      });
    }

    this._bindItems();
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('prompt-library')) {
  customElements.define('prompt-library', PromptLibraryElement);
}
export default PromptLibraryElement;

====/File: vanilla/PromptTemplateGrid.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class PromptTemplateGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._templates = [];
  }

  get templates() {
    return this._templates;
  }

  set templates(val) {
    this._templates = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    if (this._templates.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this._applyHostClass('grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3');
    this.innerHTML = this._templates
      .map(
        (t) => `
        <button
          type="button"
          data-template-id="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}"
          class="template-card group flex flex-col text-left p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:border-indigo-300 dark:hover:border-indigo-700 hover:shadow-md transition-all"
        >
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
            <span class="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 truncate">${escapeAttribute(t.title)}</span>
            ${
              t.tag
                ? `<span class="ml-auto px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0">${escapeAttribute(t.tag)}</span>`
                : ''
            }
          </div>
          ${t.description ? `<div class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 line-clamp-2">${escapeAttribute(t.description)}</div>` : ''}
          <div class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
            ${uiIcon('arrow-right', { size: 12 })}
            Use template
          </div>
        </button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.querySelectorAll('.template-card').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-template-id');
        const template = this._templates.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(id));
        if (template) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('use', { detail: template }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('prompt-template-grid')) {
  customElements.define('prompt-template-grid', PromptTemplateGridElement);
}

====/File: vanilla/RichToolbar.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const BASE_BUTTON =
  'flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40';

/**
 * RichToolbar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <rich-toolbar></rich-toolbar>
 * Properties: groups (RichToolbarGroup[])
 * Events: action (detail: item id)
 */
export class RichToolbarElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._groups = [];
  }

  get groups() {
    return this._groups;
  }

  set groups(value) {
    this._groups = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const groups = this._groups
      .map((group, groupIndex) => {
        const buttons = group.items
          .map((item) => {
            const tone = item.active
              ? 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400'
              : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
            const title = item.shortcut ? `${item.label} (${item.shortcut})` : item.label;
            const inner = item.text
              ? `<span class="font-semibold leading-none">${escapeAttribute(item.text)}</span>`
              : uiIcon(item.icon || 'square', { size: 15 });
            return `<button type="button" class="toolbar-item ${BASE_BUTTON} ${tone}"
              data-action="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(item.label)}"
              ${item.active ? 'aria-pressed="true"' : ''} ${item.disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
              title="${escapeAttribute(title)}">${inner}</button>`;
          })
          .join('');
        const divider =
          groupIndex > 0
            ? '<span aria-hidden="true" class="mx-0.5 h-5 w-px shrink-0 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>'
            : '';
        return `${divider}<div role="group" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(group.label || group.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-0.5">${buttons}</div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div role="toolbar" aria-label="Formatting"
      class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${groups}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.toolbar-item').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (button.hasAttribute('disabled')) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: button.getAttribute('data-action') }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('rich-toolbar')) {
  customElements.define('rich-toolbar', RichToolbarElement);
}
export default RichToolbarElement;

====/File: vanilla/RoadmapTimeline.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

/**
 * Vanilla Web Component: <roadmap-timeline>
 */
export class RoadmapTimelineElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._nodes = [];
    this._activeId = null;
  }

  set data({ nodes = [], activeId = null }) {
    this._nodes = nodes;
    this._activeId = activeId;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto py-8 font-sans">
        <div class="relative flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch justify-between gap-4 md:gap-2">
          <div class="hidden md:block absolute top-6 left-[4%] right-[4%] h-[2px] bg-[#b3ac97] dark:bg-[#3e444e] -z-0"></div>
          <div class="md:hidden absolute top-4 bottom-4 left-6 w-[2px] bg-[#b3ac97] dark:bg-[#3e444e] -z-0"></div>

          ${this._nodes
            .map((node) => {
              const isActive = this._activeId === node.id || node.status === "active";
              const isDone = node.status === "completed";
              const color = node.stageColor || "#c2410c";

              return `
              <div
                data-id="${node.id}"
                class="roadmap-node-item relative z-10 flex md:flex-col items-center md:items-start gap-4 md:gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 group flex-1 ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-[#faf8f1] dark:bg-[#1b1f26] shadow-sm border border-[#b3ac97]/60 dark:border-[#3e444e]"
                    : "hover:bg-[#faf8f1]/50 dark:hover:bg-[#1b1f26]/50"
                }"
              >
                <div
                  style="border-color: ${isActive || isDone ? color : ""}; background-color: ${isDone ? color : isActive ? "#faf8f1" : ""};"
                  class="w-11 h-11 flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center rotate-45 border-2 rounded-xs transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:scale-105 ${
                    isDone
                      ? "text-white"
                      : isActive
                      ? "border-2 shadow-xs"
                      : "border-[#b3ac97] dark:border-[#3e444e] bg-[#f1efe7] dark:bg-[#14171c] text-[#8d9298] dark:text-[#6f7268]"
                  }"
                >
                  <div class="-rotate-45 font-mono text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center">
                    ${isDone ? uiIcon("check", { size: 16 }) : node.status === "locked" ? uiIcon("lock", { size: 16 }) : `<span style="color: ${isActive ? color : ""}">${node.index}</span>`}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span class="font-mono text-xs tracking-wider uppercase font-semibold" style="color: ${color};">
                      STEP ${node.index}
                    </span>
                    ${
                      node.tags && node.tags.length > 0
                        ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-xs border border-[#d6d2c2] dark:border-[#2b3038] text-[#545b64] dark:text-[#a9a89c]">${node.tags[0]}</span>`
                        : ""
                    }
                  </div>

                  <h4 class="mt-1 font-serif text-sm md:text-base font-bold truncate leading-tight ${
                    isActive
                      ? "text-[#22262d] dark:text-[#e9e6db]"
                      : "text-[#22262d]/80 dark:text-[#e9e6db]/80 group-hover:text-[#22262d] dark:group-hover:text-[#e9e6db]"
                  }">
                    ${node.title}
                  </h4>

                  ${
                    node.subtitle
                      ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-[#545b64] dark:text-[#a9a89c] truncate">${node.subtitle}</p>`
                      : ""
                  }
                </div>
              </div>
            `;
            })
            .join("")}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    this.querySelectorAll(".roadmap-node-item").forEach((el) => {
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const id = el.getAttribute("data-id");
        const node = this._nodes.find((n) => String(n.id) === id);
        if (node) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("node-click", { detail: node }));
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

  customElements.define("roadmap-timeline", RoadmapTimelineElement);
