====/File: vanilla/SchedulerSlots.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const PERIODS = [
  { key: 'morning', label: 'Morning', range: [6, 12] },
  { key: 'afternoon', label: 'Afternoon', range: [12, 17] },
  { key: 'evening', label: 'Evening', range: [17, 24] },
];

const humanDate = (iso) => {
  const [year, month, day] = String(iso || '').split('-').map(Number);
  if (!year || !month || !day) return iso || '';
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
};

const hourOf = (time) => {
  const [hour] = String(time || '').split(':').map(Number);
  return Number.isFinite(hour) ? hour : -1;
};

const amPm = (time) => {
  const [hour, minute] = String(time || '').split(':').map(Number);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || !Number.isFinite(minute)) return time;
  const suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const display = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
  return `${display}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')} ${suffix}`;
};

/**
 * SchedulerSlots - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <scheduler-slots date="2026-11-20" timezone="GMT+8"></scheduler-slots>
 * Properties: slots (SchedulerSlot[])
 * Events: select (detail: slot)
 */
export class SchedulerSlotsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['date', 'selected-id', 'timezone', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._slots = [];
  }

  get slots() {
    return this._slots;
  }

  set slots(value) {
    this._slots = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const date = this.getAttribute('date') || '';
    const selectedId = this.getAttribute('selected-id') || '';
    const timezone = this.getAttribute('timezone') || '';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No slots available for this day.';

    const groups = PERIODS.map((period) => ({
      period,
      slots: this._slots.filter((slot) => {
        const hour = hourOf(slot.time);
        return hour >= period.range[0] && hour < period.range[1];
      }),
    })).filter((group) => group.slots.length > 0);

    const openCount = this._slots.filter((slot) => slot.available !== false).length;

    const body = groups.length
      ? `<div class="mt-2 space-y-3">
          ${groups
            .map(({ period, slots }) => {
              const buttons = slots
                .map((slot) => {
                  const disabled = slot.available === false;
                  const selected = String(slot.id) === String(selectedId);
                  const tone = selected
                    ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 font-medium text-white'
                    : disabled
                      ? 'cursor-not-allowed border-zinc-100 text-zinc-300 line-through dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-600'
                      : 'border-zinc-200 text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:border-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/20';
                  return `<button type="button" class="slot flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${tone}"
                    data-slot="${escapeAttribute(slot.id)}" aria-pressed="${selected}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                    <span class="tabular-nums">${escapeAttribute(amPm(slot.time))}</span>
                    ${selected ? uiIcon('check', { size: 11 }) : disabled ? uiIcon('lock', { size: 11 }) : ''}
                  </button>`;
                })
                .join('');
              const notes = slots.filter((slot) => slot.note).map((slot) => slot.note);
              return `<fieldset>
                <legend class="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${period.label}</legend>
                <div class="mt-1 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">${buttons}</div>
                ${notes.length ? `<p class="mt-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(notes.join(' · '))}</p>` : ''}
              </fieldset>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : `<p class="py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <header class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon('calendar', { size: 14 })}</span>
          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(humanDate(date))}</h3>
            ${timezone ? `<p class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">All times in ${escapeAttribute(timezone)}</p>` : ''}
          </div>
          <span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${openCount} open</span>
        </header>
        ${body}
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (button.hasAttribute('disabled')) return;
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-slot');
        const slot = this._slots.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (slot) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: slot }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('scheduler-slots')) {
  customElements.define('scheduler-slots', SchedulerSlotsElement);
}
export default SchedulerSlotsElement;

====/File: vanilla/SettingsPanel.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class SettingsPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['sections', 'active-id', 'saving', 'save-text', 'allow-save'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'active-id' && this._sections) this._current = this.getAttribute('active-id') || this._current;
    this.render();
  }

  get sections() {
    if (this._sections) return this._sections;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('sections') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set sections(value) {
    this._sections = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    if (!this._current) this._current = this.getAttribute('active-id') || this._sections[0]?.id || '';
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const sections = this.sections;
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (!sections.length) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    if (!this._current) this._current = this.getAttribute('active-id') || sections[0].id;
    const current = sections.find((item) => item.id === this._current) || sections[0];
    const saving = this.getAttribute('saving') === 'true';
    const saveText = this.getAttribute('save-text') || 'Save changes';
    const allowSave = this.hasAttribute('allow-save') ? this.getAttribute('allow-save') !== 'false' : true;

    const nav = sections
      .map((item) => {
        const active = item.id === current.id;
        return `<button type="button" data-section="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" aria-current="${active ? 'page' : 'false'}"
          class="settings-nav flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors ${
            active
              ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
              : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
          }">
          ${item.icon ? uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 14 }) : ''}
          <span class="whitespace-nowrap">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}</span>
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const items = (current.items || [])
      .map(
        (item) => `
        <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3">
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <div class="text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</div>
            ${item.description ? `<div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.description)}</div>` : ''}
          </div>
          <div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
            ${item.value ? `<span class="max-w-[12rem] truncate text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.value)}</span>` : ''}
            ${
              item.actionText
                ? `<button type="button" data-item="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(item.actionText)}</button>`
                : ''
            }
          </div>
        </div>`)
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="md:flex md:gap-6">
        <nav class="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-2 md:w-44 md:shrink-0 md:flex-col md:overflow-visible md:pb-0">${nav}</nav>
        <div class="mt-3 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 md:mt-0">
          <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
            <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(current.title)}</div>
            ${current.description ? `<div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(current.description)}</div>` : ''}
          </div>
          <div class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${items}</div>
          ${
            allowSave
              ? `<div class="flex justify-end border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
                   <button type="button" data-save ${saving ? 'disabled' : ''}
                     class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900">
                     ${saving ? `<span class="animate-spin inline-flex">${uiIcon('loader', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}
                     ${escapeAttribute(saveText)}
                   </button>
                 </div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-section');
        this._current = id;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('section-change', { detail: { id } }));
        this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-item]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const item = (current.items || []).find((entry) => entry.id === btn.getAttribute('data-item'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('item-action', { detail: { sectionId: current.id, item } }));
      });
    });

    const save = this.querySelector('[data-save]');
    if (save) {
      save.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('save', { detail: { id: current.id } })));
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('settings-panel')) {
  customElements.define('settings-panel', SettingsPanelElement);
}
export default SettingsPanelElement;

====/File: vanilla/ShortcutsOverlay.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const kbd = (key) =>
  `<kbd class="inline-flex min-w-[1.4rem] items-center justify-center rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(key)}</kbd>`;

/**
 * ShortcutsOverlay - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <shortcuts-overlay open></shortcuts-overlay>
 * Properties: groups (ShortcutGroup[]) | shortcuts (ShortcutItem[])
 * Events: close
 */
export class ShortcutsOverlayElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'placeholder'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._groups = [];
    this._shortcuts = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
  }

  get isOpen() {
    return this.hasAttribute('open');
  }

  set isOpen(value) {
    if (value) this.setAttribute('open', '');
    else this.removeAttribute('open');
  }

  get groups() {
    return this._groups;
  }

  set groups(value) {
    this._groups = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get shortcuts() {
    return this._shortcuts;
  }

  set shortcuts(value) {
    this._shortcuts = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this.isOpen) this._query = '';
    this.render();
  }

  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    }
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  /** Flat list → groups bucketed by item.group, or the provided groups. */
  _normalized() {
    if (this._groups.length > 0) return this._groups;
    const buckets = [];
    this._shortcuts.forEach((item) => {
      const label = item.group || 'General';
      const bucket = buckets.find((group) => group.label === label);
      if (bucket) bucket.items.push(item);
      else buckets.push({ id: label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'), label, items: [item] });
    });
    return buckets;
  }

  _filtered(groups) {
    const query = this._query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return groups;
    return groups
      .map((group) => ({
        ...group,
        items: group.items.filter(
          (item) =>
            String(item.label).toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            (item.keys || []).join('').toLowerCase().includes(query)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Keyboard shortcuts';
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Search shortcuts...';
    const normalized = this._normalized();
    const filtered = this._filtered(normalized);
    const total = normalized.reduce((sum, group) => sum + (group.items || []).length, 0);

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (!this.isOpen) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
      return;
    }

    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);

    const body = filtered.length
      ? `<div class="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
          ${filtered
            .map(
              (group) => `
            <section>
              <h3 class="mb-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(group.label)}</h3>
              <ul class="space-y-1.5">
                ${(group.items || [])
                  .map(
                    (item) => `
                  <li class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                    <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
                    <span class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5">${(item.keys || []).map(kbd).join('')}</span>
                  </li>`
                  )
                  .join('')}
              </ul>
            </section>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : `<div class="py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No shortcuts match &ldquo;${escapeAttribute(this._query)}&rdquo;</div>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="shortcuts-overlay fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center bg-black/40 p-4 pt-[10vh] backdrop-blur-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}">
        <div class="flex max-h-[75vh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
            <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('terminal', { size: 16 })}</span>
            <h2 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
            <span class="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">${total}</span>
            <button type="button" class="shortcuts-close ml-auto rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200" aria-label="Close">${uiIcon('x', { size: 14 })}</button>
          </div>

          <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 px-2.5 py-1.5">
              <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('search', { size: 13 })}</span>
              <input type="text" class="shortcuts-search w-full border-none bg-transparent text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}" value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}" />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">${body}</div>

          <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/30 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
            <span class="flex items-center gap-1">${kbd('esc')}<span>Close</span></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    const search = this.querySelector('.shortcuts-search');
    if (search) {
      search.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        this._query = event.target.value;
        // Keep focus + caret while re-rendering the list.
        const caret = event.target.selectionStart;
        this.render();
        const next = this.querySelector('.shortcuts-search');
        if (next) {
          next.focus();
          if (caret != null) next.setSelectionRange(caret, caret);
        }
      });
      search.focus();
    }

    this.querySelector('.shortcuts-close').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });

    this.querySelector('.shortcuts-overlay').addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      if (event.target === event.currentTarget) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('shortcuts-overlay')) {
  customElements.define('shortcuts-overlay', ShortcutsOverlayElement);
}
export default ShortcutsOverlayElement;

====/File: vanilla/SideDrawer.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * SideDrawer - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <side-drawer open title="Filters" side="right"><p>Body</p></side-drawer>
 * Attributes: open, title, description, side (left|right), size (sm|md|lg)
 * Events: close
 * Light-DOM children are moved into the scrollable body; an element with
 * slot="footer" becomes the sticky footer row.
 */
export class SideDrawerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'description', 'side', 'size'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    // Capture light-DOM children before the first render moves them.
    this._bodyNodes = Array.from(this.childNodes);
    this.render();
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this._bodyNodes) this.render();
  }

  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;
    if (!this.hasAttribute('open')) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    // Re-capture the host's own nodes: after the first render they live inside
    // our slots, so pull them back out before the shell is rebuilt.
    const existingBody = this.querySelector('.drawer-body-content');
    const existingFooter = this.querySelector('.drawer-footer');
    if (existingBody || existingFooter) {
      this._bodyNodes = [
        ...(existingBody ? Array.from(existingBody.childNodes) : []),
        ...(existingFooter ? Array.from(existingFooter.childNodes) : []),
      ];
    }

    const open = this.hasAttribute('open') && this.getAttribute('open') !== 'false';
    if (!open) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Drawer';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';
    const side = this.getAttribute('side') === 'left' ? 'left' : 'right';
    const size = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'].includes(this.getAttribute('size')) ? this.getAttribute('size') : 'md';

    const nodes = this._bodyNodes || [];
    const footerNodes = nodes.filter((node) => node.nodeType === 1 && node.getAttribute('slot') === 'footer');
    const bodyNodes = nodes.filter((node) => !footerNodes.includes(node));
    const hasFooter = footerNodes.length > 0;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex">
        <div class="drawer-backdrop absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-950/40 backdrop-blur-[1px]" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}"
          class="relative z-10 flex h-full w-full flex-col border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${
            size === 'sm' ? 'max-w-xs' : size === 'lg' ? 'max-w-xl' : 'max-w-md'
          } ${side === 'right' ? 'ml-auto border-l' : 'mr-auto border-r'}">
          <header class="flex items-start gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <h2 class="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
              ${description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="drawer-close shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              aria-label="Close drawer">${uiIcon('x', { size: 14 })}</button>
          </header>
          <div class="drawer-body-content flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300"></div>
          ${hasFooter ? '<footer class="drawer-footer border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800"></footer>' : ''}
        </div>
      </div>`;

    const bodySlot = this.querySelector('.drawer-body-content');
    bodyNodes.forEach((node) => bodySlot.appendChild(node));

    if (hasFooter) {
      const footerSlot = this.querySelector('.drawer-footer');
      footerNodes.forEach((node) => footerSlot.appendChild(node));
    }

    this.querySelector('.drawer-backdrop').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });
    this.querySelector('.drawer-close').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('side-drawer')) {
  customElements.define('side-drawer', SideDrawerElement);
}
export default SideDrawerElement;

====/File: vanilla/SourcesCitation.js/====

/**
 * SourcesCitation - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <sources-citation sources='[{"title": "OpenAI Docs", "url": "https://openai.com"}]'></sources-citation>
 */
class SourcesCitation extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["sources"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    let sources = [];
    try {
      sources = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute("sources") || "[]");
    } catch {
      sources = [];
    }

    if (!sources || sources.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="my-3 space-y-2">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span>🌐</span>
          <span>Sources (${sources.length})</span>
        </div>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          ${sources.map((item, idx) => {
            let domain = "web";
            try {
              domain = new URL(item.url).hostname.replace("www.", "");
            } catch {
              domain = item.siteName || "web";
            }
            return `
              <a href="${item.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="group relative flex flex-col justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/60 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 shadow-xs transition-all no-underline">
                <div class="space-y-1">
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                    <span class="flex items-center justify-center w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 font-bold text-[10px]">${idx + 1}</span>
                    <span class="truncate max-w-[120px]">${domain}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors">${item.title}</div>
                </div>
                ${item.snippet ? `<div class="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 line-clamp-2 leading-tight">${item.snippet}</div>` : ''}
                <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-end text-[10px] text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-zinc-600 dark:group-hover:text-zinc-300">
                  <span class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">↗</span>
                </div>
              </a>
            `;
          }).join("")}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("sources-citation")) {
  customElements.define("sources-citation", SourcesCitation);
}
export default SourcesCitation;

====/File: vanilla/StatCard.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const sparkline = (data, positive) => {
  if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length < 2) return '';
  const width = 96;
  const height = 28;
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const span = max - min || 1;
  const points = data
    .map((value, index) => {
      const x = (index / (data.length - 1)) * width;
      const y = height - ((value - min) / span) * (height - 4) - 2;
      return `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`;
    })
    .join(' ');
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" class="h-7 w-24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="${points}" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="${positive ? 'stroke-emerald-500' : 'stroke-red-500'}"/></svg>`;
};

export class StatCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'value', 'delta', 'delta-label', 'trend', 'icon'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const value = this.getAttribute('value') || '';
    const deltaAttr = this.getAttribute('delta');
    const delta = deltaAttr === null || deltaAttr === '' ? undefined : Number(deltaAttr);
    const deltaLabel = this.getAttribute('delta-label') || '';
    const icon = this.getAttribute('icon') || '';
    let trend;
    try {
      trend = this.getAttribute('trend') ? JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('trend')) : undefined;
    } catch {
      trend = undefined;
    }

    const hasDelta = typeof delta === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(delta);
    const positive = (delta ?? 0) >= 0;

    this._applyHostClass('rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>
        ${icon ? `<span class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${uiIcon(icon, { size: 16 })}</span>` : ''}
      </div>
      <div class="mt-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div class="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(value)}</div>
          ${
            hasDelta
              ? `<div class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="${positive ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-500'}">${uiIcon(positive ? 'trending-up' : 'trending-down', { size: 13 })}</span>
                  <span class="text-[11px] font-medium ${positive ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-500'}">${positive ? '+' : ''}${delta}%</span>
                  ${deltaLabel ? `<span class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(deltaLabel)}</span>` : ''}
                </div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>
        ${sparkline(trend, positive)}
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('stat-card')) {
  customElements.define('stat-card', StatCardElement);
}
export default StatCardElement;

====/File: vanilla/StatusIndicator.js/====

/**
 * StatusIndicator - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <status-indicator status="online" label="VPS Connected" ping-ms="24"></status-indicator>
 */
class StatusIndicator extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["status", "label", "ping-ms", "show-dot"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const status = this.getAttribute("status") || "online";
    const label = this.getAttribute("label");
    const pingMs = this.getAttribute("ping-ms");
    const showDot = this.getAttribute("show-dot") !== "false";

    let dotBg = "bg-emerald-500", pingBg = "bg-emerald-400", text = "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400", badgeBg = "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-200/80 dark:border-emerald-800/60", defaultLabel = "Online";
    if (status === "connecting" || status === "busy") {
      dotBg = "bg-amber-500";
      pingBg = "bg-amber-400";
      text = "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";
      badgeBg = "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800/60";
      defaultLabel = status === "busy" ? "Busy" : "Connecting";
    } else if (status === "error" || status === "offline") {
      dotBg = "bg-rose-500";
      pingBg = "bg-rose-400";
      text = "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400";
      badgeBg = "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800/60";
      defaultLabel = status === "error" ? "Error" : "Offline";
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border text-xs font-medium ${badgeBg} ${text}">
        ${showDot ? `
          <span class="relative flex h-2 w-2">
            ${status === 'online' ? `<span class="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75 ${pingBg}"></span>` : ''}
            <span class="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 ${dotBg}"></span>
          </span>
        ` : ''}
        <span class="font-semibold">${label || defaultLabel}</span>
        ${pingMs !== null && pingMs !== undefined ? `<span class="font-mono text-[10px] opacity-75 ml-0.5">(${pingMs}ms)</span>` : ''}
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("status-indicator")) {
  customElements.define("status-indicator", StatusIndicator);
}
export default StatusIndicator;

====/File: vanilla/StreamMarkdown.js/====

/**
 * StreamMarkdown - Vanilla Web Component (Powered by marked & Prism CDN)
 * Usage: <stream-markdown is-streaming content="# Hello World"></stream-markdown>
 */
class StreamMarkdown extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["content", "is-streaming"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    this.bindEvents();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._clickHandler) {
      this.removeEventListener("click", this._clickHandler);
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const isStreaming = this.hasAttribute("is-streaming");
    const content = this.getAttribute("content") || this.textContent || "";
    
    // Parse Markdown safely (falls back to text if marked not loaded)
    let parsedHtml = content;
    if (window.marked) {
      const renderer = new window.marked.Renderer();
      renderer.code = function ({ text, lang }) {
        const language = lang && window.Prism && window.Prism.languages[lang] ? lang : "javascript";
        let highlighted = text;
        try {
          if (window.Prism && window.Prism.languages[language]) {
            highlighted = window.Prism.highlight(text, window.Prism.languages[language], language);
          }
        } catch {
          highlighted = text;
        }

        return `
          <div class="relative group my-4 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900/80 border-b border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">
              <span>${lang || "code"}</span>
              <button 
                type="button" 
                data-code="${encodeURIComponent(text)}" 
                class="copy-btn hover:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
              >
                Copy
              </button>
            </div>
            <pre class="p-4 overflow-x-auto text-sm text-zinc-100 font-mono leading-normal m-0 bg-transparent"><code>${highlighted}</code></pre>
          </div>
        `;
      };
      parsedHtml = window.marked.parse(content, { renderer, breaks: true, gfm: true });
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="prose prose-zinc dark:prose-invert max-w-none text-sm leading-relaxed">
        <div class="inline-block w-full">${parsedHtml}</div>
        ${isStreaming ? '<span class="inline-block w-2 h-4 ml-1 -mb-0.5 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 animate-pulse rounded-sm"></span>' : ''}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  bindEvents() {
    this._clickHandler = (e) => {
      const target = e.target.closest(".copy-btn");
      if (!target) return;
      const rawCode = target.getAttribute("data-code");
      if (rawCode) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(decodeURIComponent(rawCode));
        target.textContent = "Copied";
        setTimeout(() => {
          target.textContent = "Copy";
        }, 2000);
      }
    };
    this.addEventListener("click", this._clickHandler);
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("stream-markdown")) {
  customElements.define("stream-markdown", StreamMarkdown);
}
export default StreamMarkdown;

====/File: vanilla/StreamingProgressBar.js/====

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const STATUS_BAR = {
  streaming: 'bg-indigo-500',
  done: 'bg-emerald-500',
  error: 'bg-rose-500',
};

export class StreamingProgressBarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'label', 'status'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const rawValue = this.getAttribute('value');
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const status = this.getAttribute('status') || 'streaming';
    const barColor = STATUS_BAR[status] || STATUS_BAR.streaming;

    const parsed = rawValue === null ? null : Number(rawValue);
    const indeterminate = parsed === null || Number.isNaN(parsed);
    const clamped = indeterminate ? null : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parsed));

    const labelHtml =
      label || !indeterminate
        ? `<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
             <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>
             ${!indeterminate ? `<span class="tabular-nums shrink-0">${Math.round(clamped)}%</span>` : ''}
           </div>`
        : '';

    const barHtml = indeterminate
      ? `<div class="h-full w-1/3 rounded-full ${barColor} animate-pulse"></div>`
      : `<div class="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${barColor}" style="width: ${clamped}%"></div>`;

    this._applyHostClass('block w-full');
    this.innerHTML = `
      ${labelHtml}
      <div
        role="progressbar"
        aria-valuemin="0"
        aria-valuemax="100"
        ${indeterminate ? '' : `aria-valuenow="${Math.round(clamped)}"`}
        aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label || 'Progress')}"
        class="h-1 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden"
      >${barHtml}</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('streaming-progress-bar')) {
  customElements.define('streaming-progress-bar', StreamingProgressBarElement);
}
export default StreamingProgressBarElement;

====/File: vanilla/Tabs.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * Tabs - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tabs-bar active-id="overview" variant="underline"></tabs-bar>
 * Properties: tabs (TabItem[])
 * Events: change (detail: { id })
 */
export class TabsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['active-id', 'variant', 'aria-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tabs = [];
    this._internalId = null;
  }

  get tabs() {
    return this._tabs;
  }

  set tabs(value) {
    this._tabs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    if (this._internalId === null) this._internalId = this._tabs[0] ? this._tabs[0].id : '';
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _current() {
    return this.getAttribute('active-id') ?? this._internalId ?? '';
  }

  _select(tab) {
    if (!tab || tab.disabled) return;
    if (!this.hasAttribute('active-id')) this._internalId = tab.id;
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { id: tab.id } }));
  }

  _move(event, index) {
    const keys = ['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End'];
    if (!keys.includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const enabled = this._tabs.map((tab, i) => ({ tab, i })).filter((entry) => !entry.tab.disabled);
    if (enabled.length === 0) return;
    const position = enabled.findIndex((entry) => entry.i === index);
    let next = position;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') next = (position + 1) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = (position - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === 'Home') next = 0;
    if (event.key === 'End') next = enabled.length - 1;
    const target = enabled[next];
    if (target) {
      this._select(target.tab);
      const node = this.querySelector(`[data-tab-id="${target.tab.id}"]`);
      if (node) node.focus();
    }
  }

  render() {
    const pills = this.getAttribute('variant') === 'pills';
    this._applyHostClass(pills ? 'inline-flex' : 'flex');

    const current = this._current();
    const label = this.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Tabs';

    const buttons = this._tabs
      .map((tab, index) => {
        const active = tab.id === current;
        const tone = pills
          ? active
            ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
            : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
          : active
            ? '-mb-px border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400'
            : '-mb-px border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200';
        const shape = pills ? 'rounded-md px-3 py-1.5' : 'border-b-2 px-3 py-2';
        return `<button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" data-tab-id="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}"
          aria-selected="${active}" aria-controls="panel-${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" tabindex="${active ? 0 : -1}"
          ${tab.disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${shape} ${tone}">
          ${tab.icon ? uiIcon(tab.icon, { size: 13 }) : ''}
          <span>${escapeAttribute(tab.label)}</span>
          ${tab.badge !== undefined ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tab.badge)}</span>` : ''}
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div role="tablist" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label)}" class="${
      pills
        ? 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800'
        : 'flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
    }">${buttons}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-id]').forEach((node, index) => {
      const tab = this._tabs.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === node.getAttribute('data-tab-id'));
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this._select(tab));
      node.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => this._move(event, index));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('tabs-bar')) {
  customElements.define('tabs-bar', TabsElement);
}
export default TabsElement;

====/File: vanilla/TestimonialGrid.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const initials = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

const ratingOf = (testimonial) => Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.round(testimonial.rating ?? 0)));

/**
 * TestimonialGrid - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <testimonial-grid columns="3"></testimonial-grid>
 * Properties: testimonials (Testimonial[])
 * Events: select (detail: testimonial)
 */
export class TestimonialGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['columns'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._testimonials = [];
  }

  get testimonials() {
    return this._testimonials;
  }

  set testimonials(value) {
    this._testimonials = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (this._testimonials.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-zinc-200 p-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">No testimonials yet.</div>`;
      return;
    }

    const columns = this.getAttribute('columns') === '2' ? 2 : 3;
    const gridClass = columns === 2 ? 'sm:grid-cols-2' : 'sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3';

    const cards = this._testimonials
      .map((testimonial) => {
        const rating = ratingOf(testimonial);
        const stars =
          rating > 0
            ? `<div class="flex items-center gap-0.5" aria-label="${rating} out of 5 stars">${Array.from(
                { length: 5 },
                (_, index) =>
                  uiIcon('star', {
                    size: 13,
                    className: index < rating ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-200 dark:text-zinc-700',
                  })
              ).join('')}</div>`
            : '';
        const avatar = testimonial.avatar
          ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(testimonial.avatar)}" alt="" class="h-7 w-7 shrink-0 rounded-full object-cover" />`
          : `<span class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(initials(testimonial.name))}</span>`;
        const meta = [testimonial.role, testimonial.company].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
        return `<figure class="testimonial-card flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 transition-shadow hover:shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
          data-testimonial="${escapeAttribute(testimonial.id)}">
          ${stars}
          <blockquote class="mt-2 flex-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">“${escapeAttribute(testimonial.quote)}”</blockquote>
          <figcaption class="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            ${avatar}
            <span class="min-w-0">
              <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(testimonial.name)}</span>
              ${meta ? `<span class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(meta)}</span>` : ''}
            </span>
          </figcaption>
        </figure>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="grid gap-4 ${gridClass}">${cards}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.testimonial-card').forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = card.getAttribute('data-testimonial');
        const testimonial = this._testimonials.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (testimonial) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: testimonial }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('testimonial-grid')) {
  customElements.define('testimonial-grid', TestimonialGridElement);
}
export default TestimonialGridElement;

====/File: vanilla/ThemeToggle.js/====

/**
 * ThemeToggle - Vanilla Web Component (Auto / Light / Dark)
 * Usage: <theme-toggle storage-key="mango-theme"></theme-toggle>
 */
class ThemeToggle extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["storage-key"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.storageKey = this.getAttribute("storage-key") || "mango-theme";
    this.mode = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey) || "auto";
    this.render();
    this.applyTheme(this.mode);
    this.bindEvents();
  }

  resolveTheme(m) {
    if (m === "light" || m === "dark") return m;
    const hour = new Date().getHours();
    const isNight = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches || hour >= 19 || hour < 7;
    return isNight ? "dark" : "light";
  }

  applyTheme(nextMode) {
    this.mode = nextMode;
    const resolved = this.resolveTheme(nextMode);
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextMode;
    document.documentElement.dataset.resolvedTheme = resolved;
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = resolved;
    if (resolved === "dark") {
      document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
    }
    localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, nextMode);
    this.updateActiveButtons();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("change", { detail: { mode: nextMode, resolved } }));
  }

  updateActiveButtons() {
    this.querySelectorAll("[data-mode]").forEach((btn) => {
      const isCurrent = btn.dataset.mode === this.mode;
      btn.className = `flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all ${
        isCurrent
          ? "bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold"
          : "hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
      }`;
    });
  }

  render() {
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="inline-flex items-center p-1 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 select-none" role="group" aria-label="Theme toggle">
        <button type="button" data-mode="auto" title="Follow System/Time">
          <span>💻</span>
          <span>Auto</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-mode="light" title="Light Mode">
          <span>☀️</span>
          <span>Light</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-mode="dark" title="Dark Mode">
          <span>🌙</span>
          <span>Dark</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  bindEvents() {
    this.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const btn = e.target.closest("[data-mode]");
      if (btn) {
        this.applyTheme(btn.dataset.mode);
      }
    });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("theme-toggle")) {
  customElements.define("theme-toggle", ThemeToggle);
}
export default ThemeToggle;

====/File: vanilla/ThinkingBlock.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatDuration = (ms) => {
  if (typeof ms !== 'number') return '';
  return ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`;
};

/**
 * ThinkingBlock - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <thinking-block is-thinking duration="3.2"></thinking-block>
 * Optional: steps property [{ id, label, durationMs? }] renders a vertical
 * step timeline with connectors; collapsed state shows a one-line summary.
 */
class ThinkingBlock extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["content", "is-thinking", "duration"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._expanded === undefined) this._expanded = this.hasAttribute("is-thinking");
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get steps() {
    if (this._steps) return this._steps;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('steps') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const isThinking = this.hasAttribute("is-thinking");
    const duration = this.getAttribute("duration");
    const content = this.getAttribute("content") || this.textContent || "";
    const steps = this.steps;
    const expanded = !!this._expanded;

    const runningStep = steps.find((step) => step.durationMs === undefined);
    const lastStep = steps[steps.length - 1];

    let summaryHtml = '';
    if (!expanded && steps.length) {
      summaryHtml = runningStep
        ? `<div class="px-3.5 pb-2.5 -mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
             <span class="inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-pulse"></span>
             <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(runningStep.label)}</span>
           </div>`
        : `<div class="px-3.5 pb-2.5 -mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
             <span class="inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>
             <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(lastStep.label)}</span>
             ${lastStep.durationMs !== undefined ? `<span class="tabular-nums">${formatDuration(lastStep.durationMs)}</span>` : ''}
           </div>`;
    }

    const stepsHtml = steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;
        const done = step.durationMs !== undefined;
        return `
          <li class="relative pl-5">
            ${isLast ? '' : '<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[5px] top-4 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>'}
            <span class="absolute left-0 top-1.5">
              ${
                done
                  ? '<span class="block h-[11px] w-[11px] rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>'
                  : '<span class="block h-[11px] w-[11px] rounded-full border-2 border-amber-400 animate-pulse"></span>'
              }
            </span>
            <div class="pb-2.5 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="truncate ${done ? 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300' : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500'}">${escapeAttribute(step.label)}</span>
              ${done ? `<span class="ml-auto shrink-0 tabular-nums text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${formatDuration(step.durationMs)}</span>` : ''}
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="my-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 text-xs overflow-hidden transition-all">
        <button type="button" id="toggle-btn" aria-expanded="${expanded}" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 hover:bg-zinc-100/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-medium transition-colors select-none text-left">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="${isThinking ? 'animate-spin text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-400'} inline-flex">${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 14 })}</span>
            <span>${isThinking ? "Deeply thinking..." : duration ? `Thought for ${duration}s` : "Thought process"}</span>
          </div>
          <span id="chevron" class="inline-flex text-zinc-400 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 14 })}</span>
        </button>
        ${summaryHtml}
        <div id="content-body" class="${expanded ? '' : 'hidden'} border-t border-zinc-200/50 dark:border-zinc-800/50 bg-white/40 dark:bg-zinc-950/20">
          ${
            steps.length
              ? `<ol class="px-4 pt-3 pb-1">${stepsHtml}</ol><div class="px-4 py-3 border-t border-zinc-200/50 dark:border-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap text-[13px]">${escapeAttribute(content) || '<span class="italic text-zinc-400">Processing thoughts...</span>'}</div>`
              : `<div class="px-4 py-3 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap text-[13px]">${escapeAttribute(content) || '<span class="italic text-zinc-400">Processing thoughts...</span>'}</div>`
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    this.querySelector("#toggle-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      this._expanded = !this._expanded;
      this.querySelector("#content-body").classList.toggle("hidden", !this._expanded);
      this.querySelector("#chevron").classList.toggle("rotate-180", this._expanded);
    });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("thinking-block")) {
  customElements.define("thinking-block", ThinkingBlock);
}
export default ThinkingBlock;

====/File: vanilla/ToastStack.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TYPE_META = {
  success: { icon: 'check-circle', color: 'text-emerald-500', bar: 'bg-emerald-500' },
  error: { icon: 'circle-x', color: 'text-rose-500', bar: 'bg-rose-500' },
  warning: { icon: 'alert-triangle', color: 'text-amber-500', bar: 'bg-amber-500' },
  info: { icon: 'sparkles', color: 'text-sky-500', bar: 'bg-sky-500' },
};

/**
 * ToastStack - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <toast-stack duration="4000"></toast-stack>
 * JS API: el.push(message, type); el.dismiss(id); el.toasts = [...]
 * Events: dismiss (detail: { id })
 * Each toast carries a bottom countdown bar (h-0.5) that shrinks to 0 over
 * `duration` ms and pauses while hovered. duration="0" = sticky toasts.
 */
export class ToastStackElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['duration'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._toasts = [];
    this._clocks = new Map(); // id -> { started, startPct, total, timer, ticker }
    this._seq = 0;
    this._appliedLayout = '';
  }

  get toasts() {
    return this._toasts;
  }

  set toasts(val) {
    this._toasts = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this._syncClocks();
    this.render();
  }

  get duration() {
    const parsed = parseInt(this.getAttribute('duration') || '4000', 10);
    return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? 4000 : parsed;
  }

  push(message, type = 'info') {
    const id = ++this._seq;
    this._toasts = [...this._toasts, { id, message, type }];
    this._syncClocks();
    this.render();
    return id;
  }

  dismiss(id) {
    this._stopClock(id);
    this._toasts = this._toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id);
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss', { detail: { id } }));
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this._syncClocks();
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    for (const id of [...this._clocks.keys()]) this._stopClock(id);
  }

  _stopClock(id) {
    const clock = this._clocks.get(id);
    if (clock) {
      if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
      if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
      this._clocks.delete(id);
    }
  }

  _startClock(id) {
    const clock = this._clocks.get(id);
    if (!clock || clock.total <= 0 || this.duration <= 0) return;
    const started = Date.now();
    clock.started = started;
    clock.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      clock.pct = 0;
      this._updateBar(id, 0);
      this._stopClock(id);
      this.dismiss(id);
    }, clock.total);
    clock.ticker = setInterval(() => {
      const pct = Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - (Date.now() - started) / clock.total));
      clock.pct = pct;
      this._updateBar(id, pct);
    }, 100);
  }

  _updateBar(id, pct) {
    const bar = this.querySelector(`[data-bar-id="${id}"]`);
    if (bar) bar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
  }

  _pauseClock(id) {
    const clock = this._clocks.get(id);
    if (!clock) return;
    if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
    if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
    const elapsed = Date.now() - clock.started;
    clock.startPct = Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - elapsed / clock.total));
    clock.total = Math.max(0, clock.total - elapsed);
  }

  _syncClocks() {
    if (this.duration <= 0) {
      for (const id of [...this._clocks.keys()]) this._stopClock(id);
      return;
    }
    const alive = new Set(this._toasts.map((t) => t.id));
    for (const id of [...this._clocks.keys()]) {
      if (!alive.has(id)) this._stopClock(id);
    }
    for (const t of this._toasts) {
      if (!this._clocks.has(t.id)) {
        this._clocks.set(t.id, { started: Date.now(), startPct: 100, total: this.duration, pct: 100 });
        this._startClock(t.id);
      }
    }
  }

  render() {
    if (this._toasts.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const layoutClass = 'fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]';
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
    this.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');

    this.innerHTML = this._toasts
      .map((t) => {
        const meta = TYPE_META[t.type] || TYPE_META.info;
        const clock = this._clocks.get(t.id);
        const pct = clock ? (clock.pct ?? 100) : 100;
        return `
          <div class="toast-card relative overflow-hidden flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200" role="alert" data-toast-id="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}">
            ${uiIcon(meta.icon, { size: 16, className: `${meta.color} shrink-0` })}
            <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">${escapeAttribute(t.message)}</span>
            <button type="button" data-dismiss-id="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}" class="toast-dismiss text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors shrink-0" aria-label="Dismiss">
              ${uiIcon('x', { size: 14 })}
            </button>
            ${this.duration > 0 ? `<span data-bar-id="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}" aria-hidden="true" class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 ${meta.bar} transition-[width] duration-100 ease-linear" style="width:${pct}%"></span>` : ''}
          </div>
        `;
      })
      .join('');

    this.querySelectorAll('.toast-card').forEach((card) => {
      const id = card.getAttribute('data-toast-id');
      const toast = this._toasts.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(id));
      if (!toast) return;
      card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => this._pauseClock(toast.id));
      card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => this._startClock(toast.id));
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.toast-dismiss').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-dismiss-id');
        const toast = this._toasts.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(id));
        if (toast) this.dismiss(toast.id);
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('toast-stack')) {
  customElements.define('toast-stack', ToastStackElement);
}
export default ToastStackElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ToolApprovalCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tool-name', 'description', 'risk', 'status'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._args = null;
  }

  get args() {
    return this._args;
  }

  set args(val) {
    this._args = val;
    this.render();
  }

  get status() {
    return this.getAttribute('status') || 'pending';
  }

  set status(val) {
    this.setAttribute('status', String(val));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _resolve(nextStatus, eventName) {
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(eventName));
    this.status = nextStatus;
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const toolName = this.getAttribute('tool-name') || '';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';
    const isHigh = this.getAttribute('risk') === 'high';
    const status = this.status;

    const argsText =
      typeof this._args === 'string' ? this._args : this._args ? JSON.stringify(this._args, null, 2) : '';

    const actionsHtml =
      status === 'pending'
        ? `
          <button type="button" class="approval-approve flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-medium transition-colors">
            ${uiIcon('check', { size: 13 })}
            Approve
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="approval-reject flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 text-xs font-medium transition-colors">
            ${uiIcon('x', { size: 13 })}
            Reject
          </button>`
        : `
          <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium ${
            status === 'approved' ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400'
          }">
            ${uiIcon(status === 'approved' ? 'check-circle' : 'circle-x', { size: 14 })}
            ${status === 'approved' ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected'}
          </span>`;

    this._applyHostClass(`block rounded-xl border bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden ${
      isHigh ? 'border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700/60' : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700'
    }`);
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5">
        <span class="p-1.5 rounded-lg shrink-0 ${
          isHigh
            ? 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'
            : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'
        }">${uiIcon(isHigh ? 'lock' : 'tool', { size: 15 })}</span>
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
            <span class="font-mono truncate">${escapeAttribute(toolName)}</span>
            ${
              isHigh
                ? '<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0">high risk</span>'
                : ''
            }
          </div>
          ${description ? `<div class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate">${escapeAttribute(description)}</div>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
      ${
        argsText
          ? `<pre class="mx-3.5 mb-2.5 max-h-40 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 border border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">${escapeAttribute(argsText)}</pre>`
          : ''
      }
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 pb-3">${actionsHtml}</div>`;

    const approveBtn = this.querySelector('.approval-approve');
    const rejectBtn = this.querySelector('.approval-reject');
    if (approveBtn) approveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this._resolve('approved', 'approve'));
    if (rejectBtn) rejectBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this._resolve('rejected', 'reject'));
  }
}

  customElements.define('tool-approval-card', ToolApprovalCardElement);
}

/**
 * ToolCallBadge - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tool-call-badge name="web_search" status="running"></tool-call-badge>
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

class ToolCallBadge extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["name", "status", "args", "output", "error"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.isOpen = false;
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const name = this.getAttribute("name") || "tool";
    const status = this.getAttribute("status") || "running";
    const args = this.getAttribute("args");
    const output = this.getAttribute("output");
    const error = this.getAttribute("error");

    let statusHtml = `<span class="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1">${uiIcon('loader', { size: 14, className: 'animate-spin' })} Running...</span>`;
    if (status === "success") {
      statusHtml = `<span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1">${uiIcon('check-circle', { size: 14 })} Success</span>`;
    } else if (status === "error") {
      statusHtml = `<span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1">${uiIcon('circle-x', { size: 14 })} Failed</span>`;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="my-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/80 shadow-sm overflow-hidden text-xs transition-all">
        <button type="button" id="toggle-btn" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors text-left select-none">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div class="p-1 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${uiIcon('tool', { size: 14 })}</div>
            <span class="font-mono font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${name}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            ${statusHtml}
            ${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 14, className: `tool-call-chevron text-zinc-400 transition-transform ${this.isOpen ? 'rotate-90' : ''}` })}
          </div>
        </button>
        <div id="drawer" class="${this.isOpen ? '' : 'hidden'} px-3.5 py-2.5 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-950/40 space-y-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
          ${args ? `<div><div class="text-zinc-400 font-semibold mb-1">Arguments:</div><pre class="p-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 overflow-x-auto m-0">${args}</pre></div>` : ''}
          ${output ? `<div><div class="text-zinc-400 font-semibold mb-1">Output:</div><pre class="p-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 overflow-x-auto max-h-48 m-0">${output}</pre></div>` : ''}
          ${error ? `<div><div class="text-rose-500 font-semibold mb-1">Error:</div><pre class="p-2 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 overflow-x-auto m-0">${error}</pre></div>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    this.querySelector("#toggle-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.isOpen = !this.isOpen;
      this.querySelector("#drawer").classList.toggle("hidden", !this.isOpen);
      this.querySelector(".tool-call-chevron")?.classList.toggle("rotate-90", this.isOpen);
    });
  }
}

====/File: vanilla/Tooltip.js/====

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const SIDE_CLASS = {
  top: 'bottom-full left-1/2 mb-1.5 -translate-x-1/2',
  bottom: 'top-full left-1/2 mt-1.5 -translate-x-1/2',
  left: 'right-full top-1/2 mr-1.5 -translate-y-1/2',
  right: 'left-full top-1/2 ml-1.5 -translate-y-1/2',
};

let tooltipSeq = 0;

/**
 * Tooltip - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tooltip-hint content="Save changes"><button>…</button></tooltip-hint>
 * Attributes: content, side (top|bottom|left|right)
 */
export class TooltipElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['content', 'side'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._content = null;
    this._side = null;
    this._tooltipId = `tooltip-${++tooltipSeq}`;
  }

  get content() {
    return this._content ?? this.getAttribute('content') ?? '';
  }

  set content(value) {
    this._content = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get side() {
    const value = this._side ?? this.getAttribute('side') ?? 'top';
    return SIDE_CLASS[value] ? value : 'top';
  }

  set side(value) {
    this._side = value;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const existing = this.querySelector(`#${this._tooltipId}`);
    const slots = Array.from(this.childNodes).filter((node) => node !== existing);

    this._applyHostClass('group relative inline-flex');
    this.setAttribute('aria-describedby', this._tooltipId);

    this.innerHTML = `<span id="${this._tooltipId}" role="tooltip"
      class="pointer-events-none absolute z-30 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white opacity-0 shadow-lg transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-within:opacity-100 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 ${SIDE_CLASS[this.side]}">${escapeAttribute(this.content)}</span>`;

    const tooltip = this.firstChild;
    slots.forEach((node) => this.insertBefore(node, tooltip));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('tooltip-hint')) {
  customElements.define('tooltip-hint', TooltipElement);
}
export default TooltipElement;

====/File: vanilla/TypingIndicator.js/====

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class TypingIndicatorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'variant', 'size'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const variant = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'dots';
    const size = this.getAttribute('size') || 'md';

    const dotClass = size === 'sm' ? 'w-1.5 h-1.5' : size === 'lg' ? 'w-2.5 h-2.5' : 'w-2 h-2';
    const gapClass = size === 'sm' ? 'gap-1' : size === 'lg' ? 'gap-2' : 'gap-1.5';
    const animClass = variant === 'pulse' ? 'animate-pulse' : 'animate-bounce';

    const dots = [0, 1, 2]
      .map(
        (i) =>
          `<span class="${dotClass} rounded-full bg-current ${animClass}" style="animation-delay: ${i * 160}ms"></span>`
      )
      .join('');

    this._applyHostClass('inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400');
    this.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    this.setAttribute('aria-label', label || 'Loading');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <span class="inline-flex items-center ${gapClass}">${dots}</span>
      ${label ? `<span class="text-xs font-sans">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>` : ''}
    `;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('typing-indicator')) {
  customElements.define('typing-indicator', TypingIndicatorElement);
}
export default TypingIndicatorElement;
