const ICONS = {
  'alert-triangle':'<path d="M12 9v4"/><path d="M12 17h.01"/><path d="M10.29 3.86 1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0Z"/>',
  'arrow-down':'<path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/>','arrow-left':'<path d="m15 6-6 6 6 6"/>','arrow-right':'<path d="m9 6 6 6-6 6"/>','arrow-up':'<path d="m6 15 6-6 6 6"/>',
  check:'<path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6"/>','check-circle':'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="m8 12 2.5 2.5L16 9"/>','chevron-down':'<path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/>','chevron-left':'<path d="m14 6-6 6 6 6"/>','chevron-right':'<path d="m10 6 6 6-6 6"/>','chevron-up':'<path d="m6 15 6-6 6 6"/>','circle-x':'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="m9 9 6 6m0-6-6 6"/>',

const escapeAttribute = (value) => String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[char]));

export function uiIcon(name, { size = 20, strokeWidth = 1.8, label = '', className = '' } = {}) {
  const aria = label ? `aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label)}"` : 'aria-hidden="true"';
  return `<svg width="${escapeAttribute(size)}" height="${escapeAttribute(size)}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="${escapeAttribute(strokeWidth)}" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="${escapeAttribute(className)}" ${aria}>${ICONS[name] || ''}</svg>`;
}
export default uiIcon;

====/File: vanilla/UpgradePromptCard.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatNumber = (value) => (typeof value === 'number' ? value.toLocaleString('en-US') : String(value));

export class UpgradePromptCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['used', 'limit', 'plan-name', 'unit', 'title', 'features', 'cta-text'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get features() {
    if (this._features) return this._features;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('features') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set features(value) {
    this._features = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const used = Number(this.getAttribute('used') || 0);
    const limit = Number(this.getAttribute('limit') || 0);
    const planName = this.getAttribute('plan-name') || 'Free';
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || 'requests';
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Upgrade to keep going';
    const ctaText = this.getAttribute('cta-text') || 'See plans';
    const features = this.features;

    const safeLimit = limit > 0 ? limit : 1;
    const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((used / safeLimit) * 100)));
    const tone =
      percent >= 90
        ? { bar: 'bg-red-500', text: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40' }
        : percent >= 70
          ? { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40' }
          : { bar: 'bg-emerald-500', text: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40' };

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const featureItems = features
      .map(
        (feature) => `
        <li class="flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          <span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-500">${uiIcon('check', { size: 12 })}</span>
          <span>${escapeAttribute(feature)}</span>
        </li>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4">
        <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
          <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${tone.chip} ${tone.text}">${uiIcon('zap', { size: 16 })}</span>
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</div>
            <div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">You're on the ${escapeAttribute(planName)} plan — ${percent}% of your ${escapeAttribute(unit)} used.</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-3 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <div class="h-full rounded-full ${tone.bar} transition-all duration-300" style="width: ${percent}%"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span class="tabular-nums">${formatNumber(used)} / ${formatNumber(limit)} ${escapeAttribute(unit)}</span>
          <span class="ml-auto tabular-nums ${tone.text}">${percent}%</span>
        </div>

        ${featureItems ? `<ul class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">${featureItems}</ul>` : ''}

        <button type="button"
          class="upgrade-cta mt-3 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900">
          ${escapeAttribute(ctaText)}
        </button>
      </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.upgrade-cta').addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('upgrade')));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('upgrade-prompt-card')) {
  customElements.define('upgrade-prompt-card', UpgradePromptCardElement);
}
export default UpgradePromptCardElement;

====/File: vanilla/VoiceModePanel.js/====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const STATE_META = {
  idle: {
    label: 'Tap to speak',
    hint: 'Voice mode is ready',
    ring: 'bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/40',
    orb: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300',
    inner: 'bg-zinc-200/50 dark:bg-zinc-700/40',
  },
  listening: {
    label: 'Listening…',
    hint: 'Speak now — tap again to stop',
    ring: 'bg-indigo-400/40',
    orb: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white',
    inner: 'bg-indigo-400/40',
  },
  thinking: {
    label: 'Thinking…',
    hint: 'Working on a response',
    ring: 'bg-amber-400/40',
    orb: 'bg-amber-500 text-white',
    inner: 'animate-pulse bg-amber-400/50',
  },
  speaking: {
    label: 'Speaking…',
    hint: 'Tap to interrupt',
    ring: 'bg-emerald-400/40',
    orb: 'bg-emerald-500 text-white',
    inner: 'bg-emerald-400/40',
  },
};

const BAR_COUNT = 9;

/**
 * VoiceModePanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <voice-mode-panel state="listening" transcript="Hey there"></voice-mode-panel>
 * Events: toggle, end
 */
export class VoiceModePanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['state', 'transcript', 'reply', 'show-end'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const rawState = this.getAttribute('state') || 'idle';
    const state = STATE_META[rawState] ? rawState : 'idle';
    const meta = STATE_META[state];
    const transcript = this.getAttribute('transcript') || '';
    const reply = this.getAttribute('reply') || '';
    const showEnd = this.hasAttribute('show-end');

    const animated = state === 'listening' || state === 'speaking';
    const bars = Array.from({ length: BAR_COUNT }, (_, index) => {
      const style = animated ? `animation-delay:${(index * 0.07).toFixed(2)}s;` : '';
      const cls = animated
        ? 'w-1 rounded-full animate-[voice-bar_0.9s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate] bg-indigo-500'
        : 'w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700';
      return `<span class="${cls}" style="${style}"></span>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="flex flex-col items-center rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-6 py-8 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="relative flex h-28 w-28 items-center justify-center">
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-full ${meta.ring} ${animated ? 'animate-ping' : 'opacity-0'}"></span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute inset-3 rounded-full ${meta.ring} opacity-60"></span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute inset-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${meta.inner}"></span>
        <button type="button" class="voice-toggle relative flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 ${meta.orb}"
          aria-label="${state === 'idle' ? 'Start voice mode' : 'Stop voice mode'}" aria-pressed="${state !== 'idle'}">
          ${uiIcon(state === 'idle' ? 'mic' : 'square', { size: 24 })}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="mt-4 flex h-6 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">${bars}</div>

      <p class="mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${meta.label}</p>
      <p class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${meta.hint}</p>

      ${transcript ? `<p class="mt-4 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">“${escapeAttribute(transcript)}”</p>` : ''}
      ${reply ? `<p class="mt-2 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(reply)}</p>` : ''}

      ${
        showEnd
          ? `<button type="button" class="voice-end mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
              ${uiIcon('x', { size: 12 })}End voice session
            </button>`
          : ''
      }
    </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.voice-toggle').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle'));
    });
    const end = this.querySelector('.voice-end');
    if (end) end.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('end')));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('voice-mode-panel')) {
  customElements.define('voice-mode-panel', VoiceModePanelElement);
}
export default VoiceModePanelElement;
